title: Service Delivery Project Manager
description:
Closing Date

2026-09-18

Job Title: Service Delivery Project Manager

Location: Kent, Hampshire, Sussex

Contract Type: Permanent

Positions available: x4

Hours: 37

Salary: Up to £53k based on skills and experience, plus business needs car

About the role:

We’re looking for a driven and commercially astute Project Manager to join Southern Water’s Contractor Service Delivery team, helping to deliver cost-effective maintenance and operational capital projects across our critical assets.

You’ll own projects end-to-end identifying value-led solutions, defining scope, managing contractors, and ensuring safe, high-quality delivery to time and budget.

What you will be responsible for:

The role involves managing multiple projects, with responsibility for contract administration, cost and budget control, compliance, reporting, and contractor H&S performance. Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of 10 x Project Managers delivering operational capital projects valued at around £100m.

This is a key role within Southern Water, offering real influence, accountability, and the opportunity to apply strong governance, financial control, and delivery expertise in a fast-paced operational environment.

  • Leading project delivery with an uncompromising commitment to health, safety, and environmental excellence, setting clear expectations for contractors and suppliers.
  • Managing and controlling contractor performance across H&S, scope, cost, and quality, supported by strong governance, audits, site inspections, and commercial negotiations.
  • Owning budget and cost management across multiple workstreams, producing accurate forecasts, final cost projections, and budget vs. actual analysis using robust management information.
  • Developing practical, value-led solutions that balance operational needs with cost constraints ensuring essential works are delivered while avoiding unnecessary “gold-plating”
  • Reviewing and approving contractor payment applications, ensuring costs align with agreed scope and that works are completed to the required standard.
  • Attend operational sites to undertake cost verification, assurance checks, and stakeholder meetings as required.
  • Driving performance against milestones, KPIs, and delivery targets, contributing to Southern Water’s SIM and wider operational objectives.
  • Building strong, collaborative relationships with operational site owners, contractors, and internal stakeholders, acting as a trusted delivery and commercial partner.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • Proven Project Management experience preferably within a utility environment Solid technical and operational background with demonstrable experience delivering maintenance or operational projects.
  • Strong understanding of the regulatory and legislative framework relevant to utility operations.
  • Thorough knowledge of contractual and commercial conditions, with confidence managing cost, scope, and contractor performance.
  • A track record of delivering cost-effective solutions that balance operational needs, customer outcomes, and financial control.
  • Highly effective stakeholder management skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with operational site owners, customers, and contractors.
  • Comfortable working in a highly autonomous role, using strong influencing, negotiating, and networking skills to drive performance and secure high service standards.
  • Strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental compliance, ensuring contractor awareness and adherence at all times.

Desirable

  • Formal Project Management qualifications such as APM or PRINCE2
  • Health & Safety qualifications (IOSH, NEBOSH or equivalent)
  • Experience delivering projects within operational capital or planned maintenance frameworks
  • Willingness to work towards relevant project or H&S qualifications if not already held

Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation

"Our mission is to protect and enhance life through water—and we need passionate people to help us achieve it. If you’re inspired by our purpose and believe you can contribute, apply today. You don’t need to meet every criterion; what matters most is your drive to make a difference."

If this role isn’t quite what you’re looking for but are keen to be contacted about opportunities at Southern Water, you can register your details here: Introduce Yourself (myworkdaysite.com- Introduce Yourself)

Our Commitment to Diversity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Additional information:

In line with Southern Water’s security requirements, successful candidates will be required to provide evidence of their identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record check (DBS) and verification of their employment and/or education history for the past three years.

Appointment to this role is subject to the successful completion of all pre‑employment checks, including security vetting.

Please note that if a candidate does not meet the required security standards or fails to pass the vetting process, Southern Water reserves the right to withdraw the offer of employment.

Some positions may also require higher levels of security vetting, which may involve providing additional documentation.

title: Return to Work Specialist
description:
We’re excited about your interest in pursuing the next step in your career with US Foods! Your continuous growth and development is critical to our success.

US Foods is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our US Foods Application Accommodation Line at 855-873-2468. You will be prompted to leave a message. Please state the specifics of the assistance needed and your contact information. A member of our HR department will return your call within two business days.

NOTE: Before you begin your internal job search, please review the criteria you will need to start the process.

The Return-to-Work Specialist manages ADA accommodations and return-to-work programs, serving as the primary point of contact for associates, managers, and HR throughout the accommodation and transitional duty process. The role ensures timely case management, effective communication, regulatory compliance, and successful reintegration of associates into the workplace.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

ADA:

  • Facilitate the interactive process for reasonable accommodation in accordance with state and federal laws.

  • Review of medical information for ADA management.

  • Prepare letter(s) to associates informing them of accommodation decision(s).

  • Document all aspects of case coordination such as claimant discussions and decision tracking within the leave management system to ensure proper reporting and compliance.

  • Coordinate return-to-work planning and ADA Accommodation discussions with managers and HR

  • Prepare correspondence to medical providers for clarified/additional information relevant to the interactive process.

  • Maintain regular contact with associates, managers and HR regarding progress and status as appropriate to the case.

  • Monitor implemented accommodations for effectiveness.

  • Consult with Counsel on undue hardship analysis and comprehensive management of complex cases.

Transitional Duty:

  • Collect Work Status Notice(s) from clinics and associates and provide updates to managers, HR, and third-party Examiners regarding restrictions and status changes.

  • Coordinate return-to-work planning and Transitional Duty discussions with onsite manager and HR.

  • Monitor implemented transitional duty assignments for effectiveness.

  • Other duties as assigned by manager.

RELATIONSHIPS

  • Internal: Region HR Business Leaders, Area HRD, Support Office HR, Legal, Risk Management, Safety, Frontline Leaders, Managers and Associates.

  • External: Third Party Vendors and HR Managed Services providers.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Remote: This role is fully remote, and the associate is expected to perform assigned responsibilities from a home-based environment.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2 years of experience in human resources or leave administration.

  • Knowledge of leave administration requirements and applicable federal and state employment laws, including the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Pregnant Workers Fairness Act (PWFA), and Workers' Compensation regulations.

  • Strong customer service, organizational and analytical skills; demonstrate effective time management, computer, and decision-making skills; and be able to successfully work independently.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, or equivalent work experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Certified Leave Management Specialist (CLMS) certification.

  • Workday and absence management system experience.

  • Call center experience.

This role will also receive annual incentive plan bonus.​

​Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. To review available benefits, please click here: https://www.usfoods.com/careers/benefits.html.

Grade: 11

$50,000 - $80,000

title: Advisor III, CSU
description:
Venture Global LNG (“Venture Global”) is a long-term, low-cost provider of American-produced liquefied natural gas. The company’s Louisiana-based export projects service the global demand for North American natural gas and support the long-term development of clean and reliable North American energy supplies. Using reliable, proven technology in an innovative plant design configuration, Venture Global’s modular, mid-scale plant design will replace traditional designs as it allows for the same efficiency and operational reliability at significantly lower capital cost.

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position:

Advisor III, CSU

Located:

CP2

Summary

The CSU IC Advisor will report directly to the CSU IC Director or Designee. They promote and provide leadership for Safety and direct/coordinate daily activities of the instrument Technicians, and construction support craft. They assume the direct responsibility of assigned instrumentation and systems for completion with the highest degree of safety and quality. They mentor and provide positive feedback to employees. They assist with the coordination of client personnel for OJT and Maintenance training.

General Description Duties & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:

  • Hold and/or attend Daily Safety Meetings
  • Attend or conduct Daily Leads Meeting
  • Lead and require strict adherence to Lock Out / Tag Out Procedures (LOTO), work permits, and company policies
  • Review and spot check Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) audits for department
  • Utilize scope packages and necessary forms for completed turnover packages
  • Utilize work packages associated with system testing
  • Utilize test procedures for component and system testing
  • Redline all drawings and specification data sheets to ensure accurate “As-Built” information and drawings
  • Promote and require good housekeeping in the office and on the project site
  • Review and update min/max and available spare parts and consumables for commissioning
  • Troubleshoot and isolate system problems and propose solutions to CSU IC Field Specialist
  • Checkout installed systems and equipment adhering to OEM requirements, system descriptions, and good industry standard practice
  • Track the progress of assigned systems and provide CSU IC Field Specialist with timely reports on progress and activities
  • Perform construction process assessments during system pre-Mechanical Complete (MC) walk-downs and identify exceptions, and deficiencies
  • Directs commissioning and testing of individual components, systems, and the station as a complete integrated unit to meet all contractual obligations

Basic Qualifications: Level 3

Associate degree in electronics or Instrumentation from a University or Technical School, and/or job-related experience and minimum of 2-3 years’ experience Must have the ability to read and understand P&ID’s, Loop Drawings, Cause & Effect’s, Electrical One-Lines, and Schematics Smart Plant Instrumentation (SPI), MS Office Suite Must have recent knowledge of (PLC, DCS, SIS, etc.) and Field Instrumentation Experience with electrical, instrumentation and control systems codes and standards, including ISA, NEC, and API is required

Basic Qualifications: Level 2

Associate degree in electronics or Instrumentation from a University or Technical School, and/or job-related experience and minimum of 5 years’ experience Must have the ability to read and understand P&ID’s, Loop Drawings, Cause & Effect’s, Electrical One-Lines, and Schematics Smart Plant Instrumentation (SPI), MS Office Suite Must have recent knowledge of (PLC, DCS, SIS, etc.) and Field Instrumentation Experience with electrical, instrumentation and control systems codes and standards, including ISA, NEC, and API is required

Basic Qualifications: Level 1

Associate degree in electronics or Instrumentation from a University or Technical School, and/or job-related experience and minimum of 7-9 years’ experience Must have the ability to read and understand P&ID’s, Loop Drawings, Cause & Effect’s, Electrical One-Lines, and Schematics Smart Plant Instrumentation (SPI), MS Office Suite Must have recent knowledge of (PLC, DCS, SIS, etc.) and Field Instrumentation Experience with electrical, instrumentation and control systems codes and standards, including ISA, NEC, and API is required Experience as an Instrument Supervisor on at least (1) mid to large size project during the construction, commissioning, and initial start-up phases of a project is preferred

Job Description

MUSC Health – Kershaw Medical Center is seeking a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist Leader to join a high-performing Anesthesia Care Team model in Camden, SC. The chosen candidate will report to the Director of CRNA Services and collaborates with the Anesthesiology Medical Director and Team, as well as other support staff to oversee the day-to-day CRNA operations in Camden, South Carolina.

This role offers the opportunity to work alongside CRNAs and board-certified Anesthesiologists within a collaborative Anesthesia Care Team, delivering high-quality care across a diverse case mix in Camden, South Carolina. In this model, CRNAs play a vital role in delivering hands-on anesthesia care across a wide range of procedures, while benefiting from physician partnership and resources. Enjoy a shared commitment of support and outstanding patient outcomes.

About MUSC Health – Kershaw Medical Center:

MUSC Health – Kershaw Medical Center is a comprehensive community hospital in Camden, South Carolina, part of the larger MUSC Health system. Providing a range of diagnostic, medical, surgical, rehabilitation, and post-acute care services, it includes the 119-bed MUSC Health Kershaw Medical Center in Camden, MUSC Health Elgin Medical Pavilion and Urgent Care in Elgin, MUSC Health Lugoff Medical Pavilion in Lugoff, MUSC Health Camden Medical Pavilion, MUSC Health Sleep Diagnostics Center, and MUSC Health Hospice care.

Required Qualifications:

  • Provides clinical anesthesia care and

  • Promotes interprofessional collaboration and manages initiatives, strategic priorities, and program development which impact the culture, organization, and community.

  • Plans, organizes, facilitates, monitors, and evaluates activities and functions of the division-based employee and organizational goals.

  • Collaborates with leaders to establish operating procedures, enhance clinical and non-clinical workflows, increase productivity, and improve overall patient safety and quality outcomes and operational efficiencies within various anesthesia delivery settings.

  • Identifies improvements to practices, clinical process(es), scope of practice, and other areas which could affect patient management and clinical process.

  • Works to hire and empower and motivate team members to their highest potential.

  • Experience administering vascular, minimal pediatric, neuro, regional, and orthopedic anesthesia, as well as anesthesia for outpatient surgery.

  • Graduate of a program approved by the Council on Accreditation of Nurse Anesthesia Educational Programs

  • The minimum education requirement for those hired after March 1, 2019, is a master’s degree, or higher, with the concentration in Nurse Anesthesia.

  • Insurable by the medical malpractice insurer of MUSC for the required limits.

  • Must be recognized as an APRN to be eligible, with current license to practice, or eligibility to obtain practice in the state of South Carolina.

  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), and Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) require either a certification from an American Health Association (AHA) for Healthcare Providers or an American Red Cross CPR/AED for Professional Rescuers and Healthcare Provider.

Position Highlights:

  • Anesthesia Care Team/Medical Supervision Model for Kershaw

  • Cases: Urology, General Surgery, Orthopedics, GYN, ENT, Endoscopy, Cardioversions.

  • 8, 10, & 12-hour shifts with separate dedicated night and weekend call staff.

  • USGRA, SAB, LE, central lines.

  • Collaborative Practice Environment.

  • Team-oriented culture focused on patient-centered care.

Benefits & Resources for Providers:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Commencement bonus

  • Employer-funded retirement plans

  • Paid occurrence malpractice coverage

  • Paid parental leave

  • Epic EHR with provider-centered optimization and robust user support

  • AI-enabled documentation and workflow tools integrated into Epic to reduce administrative burden and support clinical decision-making at the point of care

  • Team-based care models that support sustainable workloads, shared responsibility, and provider well-being

Life in Camden / Kershaw County SC:

Practice in one of South Carolina’s fastest-growing regions, offering year-round recreational activities, a vibrant arts and cultural scene, and affordable real estate - including lakeside living along beautiful Lake Wateree. With an impressive 242 miles of shoreline, Lake Wateree is Kershaw County’s most attractive place for water sports, relaxation, and unforgettable sunsets.

Kershaw County blends rich history with a strong sense of community, home to approximately 73,000 residents. The convenient location provides easy access to Columbia, South Carolina’s capital city, allowing residents to enjoy both small-town charm and metropolitan amenities.

Travel is equally accessible, with Columbia Metropolitan Airport just 40 miles away, and Charlotte Douglas International Airport, approximately 90 miles away. Centrally located on the East Coast between New York and Miami, Kershaw County is nestled in South Carolina’s Midlands area – making it an ideal place to live, work, and practice.

South Carolina’s leading academic health system, MUSC Health serves patients across the state through a growing network of hospitals, clinics, and specialty services. As the clinical enterprise of the Medical University of South Carolina, MUSC Health integrates academic medicine, research, and education with a strong commitment to patient care. Providers who join MUSC Health become part of a mission-driven organization recognized for clinical excellence, innovation, and meaningful investment in providers’ success. With opportunities in both academic and community settings, MUSC Health provides the scale, resources, and infrastructure to support meaningful, long-term provider careers.

If you like working with energetic enthusiastic individuals, you will enjoy your career with us!

title: Community Mobilizer

Networking and Communication:

Monitoring of volunteer movement, Sensitization at block level

80% field-based work / field visit and 20% Office based

title: Superintendent
description:
Job Description

At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.

As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.

Job Summary:
Manages field operations individuals to deliver high-quality results and foster professional growth. Position Summary:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Pads up to 1500 empty chick boxes weighing approximately 2 pounds. (15%)
  • Lift box of 100 chicks weighing approximately 15 pounds and stacks into stacks of 10, 1500 times. (15%)
  • Pushes 10 stacked boxes with birds averaging 15 pounds per box into a row approximately 150 times. (15%)
  • Push/pull hatcher baskets on casters full of chicks into Pull Room weighing approximately 500 – 1000 pounds. (15%)

This does require overhead lifting. Putting empty trays (48 inches x 16.8 inches) weighing approximately 6.25 pounds into tray wash machine. (15%)
  • Take clean, empty trays out of tray washer and restack into stacks of 15 high approximately 1300 times. (15%)

Other duties, responsibilities and activities

  • These may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice; such as: read temperatures and turn failures in setters and read temperature and humidity in incubators every three hours, wash and foam pull and traywash rooms using a high pressure hose and regular water hose, pulls loaded setter buggies on casters weighing approximately 700-1300 pounds, operates box washer, maintains a clean and organized work area, properly euthanize weak/ill birds in accordance with company policy. (10%)

Biosecurity/Animal Welfare Requirements/Safety

title: Utility Service Worker I PT
description:
SALARY


$18.79 - $23.49

JOB SUMMARY


Under general supervision, coordinates crew activities on a daily basis to complete assigned work orders and acts as lead in the repair, replacement, or adjustment of meters. Provides maintenance services on automated meter infrastructure to include the diagnosis of issues, repair, or replacement of automated meter infrastructure (AMI) infrastructure. Will perform additional duties under direct supervision which include performing repairs and preventative of all water and wastewater infrastructure. This includes, but is not limited to, water mains, water services, water taps, fire hydrants, valves, sewer mains, sewer services, manholes, and cleanouts.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead crew in repairing, replacing, or adjusting small to medium size meters (2" and greater in size).
  • Perform meter accuracy testing, pressure/flow testing, installation, or replacement of meter vaults.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance services and aged meter replacements as scheduled.
  • Investigate service connection problems and resolves customer complaints.
  • Spot checks the work and job site locations of the people they are leading.
  • Supervise multiple subordinates including the hiring, discipline, evaluating and training of subordinates.

OTHER JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Assisting the Meter Services Crew Chief in tasks related to large meters.
  • Perform chlorine residual testing, re-size service connections and assist Meter Reading in facilitating safe access to metering sites.
  • Assist other meter service workers with more difficult tasks, as needed or directed.
  • Performs emergency repairs and preventative services on all water and wastewater infrastructure including but is not limited to:
    • Water services
    • AMI infrastructure
    • Fire hydrants
    • Valves
    • Manholes

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Knowledge of supervisory practices and principles.
  • Knowledge of Water Utilities operations; policies, procedures, ordinances.
  • Knowledge of specifications for all size meters and metering sites, metering functions and related terminology.
  • Skill in the maintenance and repair of water meters.
  • Skill in communicating policies and procedures.
  • Skill in quickly ascertaining problems with malfunctioning meters and determining quick resolutions.
  • Ability to understand and visualize combined metering scenarios.
  • Ability to lift or exert forces equivalent to lifting up to 100 pounds.
  • Ability to work in confined spaces under extreme weather conditions.
  • Ability to respond on a scheduled on-call basis and to work extended periods of time under imposed emergency assignments.
  • Ability to operate a variety of equipment, including, but not limited to PC, calculator, two-way radio, jack hammer, port-a-power wench, and acetylene torch.
  • Ability to perform a variety of physical skills including, but not limited to carrying, data entry, dragging, driving, holding, kneeling, lifting, pulling, pushing, seeing, sitting, sorting, squatting, standing, stooping, twisting body.
  • Ability to prepare for and cope with both passive and active environmental hazards.

Qualifying Education and Experience:

  • Possession of a Class A CDL with Tanker Endorsement or ability to obtain within 6 months.
  • Possession of a Class II Wastewater Collection license or ability to obtain within 18 months.
  • Possession of a Class C Water Distribution Operator’s License.
  • High School diploma/GED.
  • Two years relevant vocational/technical school in plumbing or related field.
  • OR Two years’ experience in water utility or meter operations.
  • OR any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Employment Screenings Required:

  • Criminal background check
  • Physical Exam
  • Human performance Evaluation
  • Motor Vehicle Review
  • Drug & Alcohol screening

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

As a Site Reliability Engineer on the Intersight Team you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our cloud platforms. The broader team is composed of experienced engineers who value innovation and accountability. You will represent the Intersight SRE team, working in a dynamic environment, tackling challenges with creativity, and delivering on the team's technical roadmap. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software development, product management, customers and security teams, to design, influence, build, and maintain SaaS systems operating at multi-region scale. Your work will directly impact the success of our initiatives by ensuring the underlying platform infrastructure is robust, efficient, and aligned with operational excellence.

Your Impact

We are seeking an SRE to represent a high-performing team dedicated to ensuring the reliability and scalability of cloud services, with a focus on a rapidly growing next-generation project. This role involves close collaboration across product engineering, service engineering, and SRE teams in a high-trust, well-coordinated environment. If you are looking to excel in a fast-paced environment creating innovative solutions and want to make a significant long-lasting impact, this job is for you.

  • Build, deploy and optimize cloud and data infrastructure to ensure the high availability, reliability, and scalability of services to meet customer needs.
  • Utilize your strong programming skills to integrate software and systems engineering, building core data platform capabilities and automation to meet customer needs and roadmap objectives.
  • Monitor production systems, participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts through postmortem reviews and proactive performance optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including development, product management, and security teams, to create secure, scalable solutions and enhance operational efficiency through automation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) with 1-3 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering/ DevOps, Cloud Operations, or a related role.
  • Practical experience of working in Kubernetes (EKS or self-managed) , Docker and cloud (preferably AWS).
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation and operational tasks.
  • Hands-on experience coding with infrastructure as code tools like Ansible or Terraform.
  • Foundational understanding of Linux systems, CI/CD pipelines, and familiarity with observability tools (ELK, Splunk, Prometheus or any other related tool) .

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building/managing a cloud-based data platform, automation and orchestration of their infrastructure and maintaining high availability, system reliability at scale.
  • Experience applying AI-assisted or automation-first approaches to SRE tooling and workflows.
  • Strong personal interest in learning, research, and integrate new technologies with high customer impact
  • Excellent collaboration and strong communication skills
  • Certifications: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or equivalent certifications are good to have.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Staff AI/ML Engineer - Controllable Biology
description:
Business Introduction


At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more:
Our approach to R&D

Job Title: Staff AI/ML Engineer - Controllable Biology

At GSK, we see a world in which advanced applications of machine learning and AI will allow us to develop novel therapies for existing diseases and respond quickly to emerging or changing diseases with personalized drugs, driving better outcomes at reduced cost and with fewer side effects. It is an ambitious vision that will require the development of products and solutions at the cutting edge of machine learning and AI. If that excites you, we’d love to chat.

Job Purpose:

The AI/ML Controllable Biology Team applies machine learning and AI methods to biological networks and sequence data from large-scale human genetic, functional genomic, and single-cell experiments. Models that control biological networks have the potential to be transformative in drug discovery, empowering us to find new life-saving medicines.

We are looking for a Staff AI/ML Engineer – Controllable Biology. Competitive candidates will have a track record of developing SOTA deep learning models to solve challenging real-world scientific problems. You should be an outstanding scientist with in-depth knowledge of modern machine learning. You can convert vaguely described biological and drug discovery challenges into well-defined machine learning problems. You can independently execute and deliver full AI/ML-driven solutions: from sourcing training data, designing and implementing SOTA machine learning models, and benchmarking, to shipping stable, tested, performant code and services in an agile environment.

The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Staff AI/ML Engineer - Controllable Biology you will:

  • Convert complex biological questions into tractable mathematical problems that can be solved by modern computational methods.

  • Be adept at decomposing large problems into quarterly, measurable results and consistently working towards delivering these through engineering sprints.

  • Be a technical mentor in a multidisciplinary engineering team, including delegating tasks to junior colleagues and guiding them through delivery, while fostering an inclusive, supportive team culture.

  • Be comfortable demoing early and often, balancing research and engineering velocity.

  • Be a standard-bearer for machine learning, software engineering, code review and agentic development best practices within the organisation.

  • Define technical strategy and roadmaps for AI/ML products, balancing scientific needs, safety, and operational reliability.

  • Operate in a transparent way, communicating clearly and accurately to leadership and the broader organisation.

  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure models are explainable, safe, and relevant.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a related field (e.g. computer science, mathematics or natural sciences).

  • 7+ years’ experience with standard deep learning algorithms, model architectures, machine learning best practices, scalable training and deployment.

  • 7+ years’ experience in software development, including code reviews, version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, software testing, technical documentation and Agile delivery methodologies.

  • 5+ years’ experience in a technical lead or engineering manager role with direct reports, mentoring software engineers or machine learning practitioners.

  • 7+ years’ experience with Python and PyTorch, or an equivalent machine learning framework.

  • Experience working with biological sequence and network data, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, gene regulatory networks or related biological datasets.

  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple teams, functions and geographic regions.

Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • PhD in a quantitative or computational field.

  • Background in modelling disease biology, systems biology, molecular biology and biochemistry.

  • Track record of delivering high-quality, research-level machine learning and robust software solutions.

  • Peer-reviewed publications in major AI conferences.

#GSK-LI

Work Arrangements:

The role is hybrid, requiring on-site work 2 days per week. Remote or fully home-working arrangements are not available for this role.

How to apply
If this role speaks to your skills and ambitions, please submit your CV and a brief note about your relevant work. We look forward to hearing about how you would help us advance sequence learning in research.


Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation• If you are based in Cambridge, MA; Waltham, MA; Rockville, MD; or San Francisco, CA, the annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges $200,475 to $334,125. Type of Contract: Fixed Term
Unit/Division: Programme Unit
Duty Station: Dili, Timor-Leste
Duration: One year

BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

Since gaining independence in 2002, Timor-Leste has made significant progress in reconciliation, reconstruction, human rights, and democracy. However, its economy remains highly dependent on dwindling oil and gas revenues, necessitating urgent investments in socioeconomic development. With a population of 1.3 million, Timor-Leste faces a 45.8% multidimensional poverty rate—the highest in Southeast Asia. Vulnerable groups, including women, persons with disabilities, and rural communities, are disproportionately affected.

A 2022 analysis revealed that only 25% of the population enjoys food security. While most can afford an energy-sufficient diet, a nutritious diet remains out of reach. As a food-deficit nation importing 60% of its food, Timor-Leste struggles with low agricultural productivity and persistent malnutrition. Stunting affects 47.1% of children under five, posing long-term health and economic risks.

Timor-Leste’s non-oil agrarian economy faces additional obstacles from climate change, disaster risks, and economic contractions. Moreover, severe food shortages persist, particularly during the lean season (November to February), with 62% of farmers experiencing at least one month of food insecurity annually.

The National School Feeding Programme (SFP) ‘Merenda Scholar’ in Timor-Leste has been an essential initiative aimed at addressing multiple challenges related to nutrition and education. In Timor-Leste, malnutrition and food insecurity remain significant concerns, particularly among children. The Government of Timor-Leste (GoTL), with support from the World Food Programme (WFP), has been working to improve the nutritional status of school-age children, focusing on providing nutritious meals to enhance both health and educational outcomes.

The WFP Timor‑Leste Country Office (TLCO) Strategic Plan 2026–2030 (CSP) is fully aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework 2026–2030 for Timor‑Leste as well as national government priorities and strategies. It reflects the shared ambitions of WFP, the United Nations, and the Government of Timor‑Leste to advance nutrition, food security, and sustainable development.

Within this framework, the purpose of the assignment is to support in nutrition and strengthen the overall effectiveness of the National School Feeding Programme. The assignment will support to contribute to improving dietary diversity, promoting local produce, ensuring safe and nutritious meals in schools, and reinforcing the role of National school feeding as a cornerstone of social protection and human capital development in Timor‑Leste.

The Programme Assistant will be reporting to School Health and Nutrition Project Coordinator and accountable for:

ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Regular coordination with relevant technical staff from the Ministry of Education (MOE), Ministry of State Administration (MSA), and other ministries at national and municipal levels on KOICA funded project implementation.

  • Support implementation of the National School Feeding Programme in close collaboration with school managers and Field Support Units/Coordinators, in ensuring KOICA project interventions are integrated into planning, execution, and monitoring.

  • Support capacity building through training and workshop activities jointly with relevant ministries focusing on KOICA funded project processes.

  • Joint monitoring with ministries at municipal level to collect data, track progress, and monitor KOICA funded project implementation.

  • Provide support for updates and reports on the progress under KOICA funded project school feeding implementation on a monthly basis.

  • Provide technical assistance to stakeholders and ministries, including schools at municipal level, on planning, programme delivery, and monitoring and evaluation under KOICA funded project.

  • Support programme studies, reviews, and assessments related to school feeding.

  • Promote local purchase of safe and nutritious foods, support strengthening linkages between schools and local farmers to improve sustainability and dietary diversity.

  • Ensure food safety standards are integrated into KOICA funded project design and implementation, including training on safe food handling and monitoring of compliance

  • Perform any other tasks as assigned by supervisor.

title: Operations Executive
description:
Job Description

Operations Control Center requires a dedicated staff member to oversee both international and domestic shipment monitoring to ensure the timely progression of all logistics activities across the supply chain. This role is responsible for proactively tracking shipments against key operational milestones, identifying potential delays, coordinating with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, and internal stakeholders, and implementing corrective actions to minimize service disruptions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor international and domestic shipments from origin to final delivery using carrier portals and tracking platforms.

  • Track shipment progress against predefined operational milestones, including pickup, departure, customs clearance, transshipment, arrival, warehouse processing, and final delivery.

  • Proactively identify shipment delays, exceptions, and potential risks, and initiate timely escalation to the relevant operational teams.

  • Coordinate closely with freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, transport providers, warehouses, and internal departments to resolve shipment issues promptly.

  • Ensure all shipment milestones are updated accurately and in a timely manner within the systems.

  • Investigate shipment exceptions and implement corrective actions to minimize service disruptions and prevent recurrence.

  • Maintain continuous communication with sales team and internal stakeholders by providing shipment status updates and expected recovery plans where required.

  • Monitor compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific delivery requirements.

  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports on shipment status, milestone performance, delays, exceptions, and recovery actions.

  • Provide visibility to Sales team and management during operational disruptions, including transportation delays, customs issues, weather events, and capacity constraints.

  • Analyze shipment trends and recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, shipment visibility, and on-time delivery performance.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, regulatory standards, and safety procedures.

Requirements

  • Minimum ITE qualification and above

  • Experience in logistics, shipment tracking, or supply chain operations is an advantage.

  • Good communication, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; knowledge of Power BI and Google Sheets is an advantage.

  • Able to work in a fast-paced operational environment and manage multiple priorities.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

Join a hands-on lab-focused engineering team responsible for bringing advanced ASIC evaluation boards (EVBs) to life. You will work closely with ASIC, Board Design, SI/PI, FPGA, BSP/SW, Test, Thermal, Mechanical, and Manufacturing teams to validate and qualify cutting‑edge silicon platforms.

Your Impact

You will own the complete EVB hardware bring-up process from initial power‑on through release to internal engineering teams. This role is highly practical and technical, responsible for identifying and resolving complex board- and ASIC-level hardware issues, documenting findings, and driving corrective actions.

Key responsibilities

  • Own and execute complete EVB hardware bring-up, validation, and qualification activities in the lab.

  • Perform initial board power‑up, verify power rails and sequencing, validate clocks and resets, and exercise interfaces.

  • Lead hands‑on debugging and root‑cause analysis of board‑level and ASIC-related hardware failures.

  • Read and use complex hardware schematics and PCB layout data as primary debugging tools; review PCB manufacturing data when investigating failures.

  • Perform detailed lab measurements (oscilloscopes, VNAs, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads) and correlate results with schematics, layout, ASIC requirements, and simulations.

  • Collaborate with SI and PI teams to investigate signal-quality, channel-loss, reflections, power-delivery, and noise issues.

  • Work with FPGA and BSP/SW engineers during initial system bring-up and debugging.

  • Document bring-up procedures, debug findings, measurements, known issues, workarounds, and solutions.

  • Support manufacturing and assembly debug (PCB, SMT, soldering, component and assembly-related failures).

  • Drive hardware issues through identification, root‑cause analysis, corrective action, implementation, and final validation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of hands‑on hardware engineering experience focused on board bring‑up and debugging of ASIC/FPGA platforms.

  • At least 3 years actively performing measurements and analysis. Demonstrated experience using lab equipment (oscilloscope, multimeter, logic analyzer, VNA, power supplies)

  • Proven ability to read and interpret complex multi‑sheet hardware schematics and correlate schematic signals to PCB layout.

  • Experience with high‑speed PCB design principles and signal integrity / power integrity troubleshooting on boards with >6 layers or multi‑gigabit interfaces.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ASIC EVBs, validation platforms, or high‑speed networking hardware.

  • Familiarity with PCB layout review, stack‑up, power planes, and critical routing constraints.

  • Experience working with SI and PI teams and tools for channel loss/reflection and PDN analysis.

  • Hands‑on experience supporting manufacturing/SMT assembly failure analysis.

  • Strong documentation skills and experience producing bring‑up procedures, debug reports, and validation artifacts.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Director, Engineering (Customer Engineering - AI Team)
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/10/2026

Meet the Team

Cisco’s AI Software & Platform Group builds enterprise AI platforms and developer tooling, integrating our networking, security, and observability portfolio with modern AI to power autonomous systems. We improve reinforcement learning, simulation, and predictive analytics to make enterprise AI accurate, grounded, and trustworthy.

Within this group, we are building Customer Engineering (CE) as a strategic, AI-native engineering organization designed to revolutionize how we diagnose, resolve, and prevent complex technical escalations for our most demanding global enterprise customers. Sitting at the direct intersection of Engineering, Product Management, Customer Experience (CX/TAC), and Sales, this founding leadership role will define, scale, and lead the global operating model from the ground up.

In this role, you will be the senior engineering voice when top-tier customers need answers during high-stakes production events, while pioneering AI-driven diagnostic automation and developer tooling that allows our engineering organization to scale non-linearly.

Your Impact

As the Head of Customer Engineering, you will:

  • Build & Scale the Operating Model: Establish the end-to-end CE function from scratch, defining triage tiers, response/resolution SLAs, and a "treat and discharge" motion that empowers engineers to write, test, and ship hotfixes/patches directly under rigorous safety guardrails.

  • Lead High-Stakes Escalations & RCAs: Serve as the senior engineering authority for strategic enterprise accounts, leading the resolution of complex multi-tenant production issues and presenting Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) directly to customer C-suite and technical executives.

  • Drive AI-Native Automation: Architect and deploy AI agents, intelligent diagnostic tooling, and automated workflows that dramatically reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and eliminate repetitive triage without linear headcount growth.

  • Bridge CE and Core Engineering: Establish a high-integrity escalation interface where handoffs to core R&D arrive fully pre-triaged (reproduced, scoped, and root-caused); negotiate and enforce bidirectional SLAs between CE and core engineering teams.

  • Pioneer the Core Engineering Rotation Program: Design and lead a continuous rotation program embedding core R&D engineers into CE for live customer troubleshooting, facilitating two-way knowledge transfer and real-world system resilience insights.

  • Close the Product Feedback Loop: Partner with Product Management and R&D to translate recurring field telemetry, incident post-mortems, and customer pain points into platform-level roadmap enhancements that permanently eliminate repeat escalations.

  • Recruit & Develop Top Talent: Hire, mentor, and lead a high-caliber team of customer-facing engineers and frontline managers, establishing on-call protocols, runbooks, and clear technical career pathways.

  • Drive Operational Metrics: Own and report on key operational health indicators including time-to-triage, time-to-resolution, % resolved at CE vs. escalated, repeat-issue rates, escalation SLA adherence, and customer CSAT/NPS.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of software, cloud, or security engineering experience, with significant hands-on depth in customer-facing engineering, escalation engineering, or SRE/incident response roles.

  • People management experience, including proven success building, structuring, and scaling engineering teams that debugs and triage complex distributed, multi-tenant cloud systems across the full stack.

  • Proven track record partnering directly with enterprise technical leadership and C-level executives during critical production incidents.

  • Experience designing triage models, severity frameworks, SLA definitions, and on-call runbook rotations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-backed diagnostic tools, or intelligent workflow automation within engineering or support environments.

  • Proven experience founding or standing up a Customer Engineering, Tier-3 Escalation, or Production Operations organization from ground zero in a fast-scaling cloud or SaaS business.

  • Track record of managing people managers and scaling distributed, multi-region engineering teams.

  • Deep domain expertise in Cloud Security, SaaS architectures, Microservices, and Distributed systems.

  • Experience designing and executing engineering rotation programs that bridge product R&D with field support.

  • Strong executive gravitas with the ability to act as the decisive tiebreaker between rapid hotfix deployment and long-term architectural platform health.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The IP Specialist is responsible for supporting the functions of the Americas Intellectual Property team. This position is responsible for all aspects of patent prosecution, with particular emphasis on tracking and coordinating fulfillment of all deadlines (foreign and domestic) with a diverse team of IP Specialists in multiple jurisdictions.

Preparation of formal documents and filing of US and PCT applications, as well as coordination of prosecution activities with in-house attorneys and foreign associates are key responsibilities.

This is a billable position requiring accurate and timely submission of matters attributable to billable hours. Other responsibilities include a variety of IP-related administrative tasks. Importantly, this position requires proactively completing tasks and following through with the speedy resolution of issues with minimal supervision, including the ability to meet deadlines under very tight time constraints and other demands.

PRIMARY RESPONSBILITIES

  • Daily tracking and clearance of patent prosecution docket for both foreign and domestic matters, ensuring all statutory and non-statutory deadlines are met without fail and providing timely reminders to attorneys and patent agents regarding upcoming deadlines as needed.

  • Prepare and file documents such as issue fees, responses, amendments, provisional and non-provisional utility, national stage and design applications, PCT applications, information disclosure statements, declarations, statements of use, and extensions in compliance with USPTO guidelines and reporting filings to clients.

  • Prepare formal documents for review, including declarations, powers of attorney, and assignments, for execution by the applicant or inventor.

  • Coordinate filing of sequence listings and formal drawings prepared by outside vendors.

  • Confirm the status of patent and trademark cases with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

  • Review face and claims of Letters Patent for accuracy.

  • Prepare responses to notices (missing parts, office actions, disclosure statements, etc.).

  • Prepare Notice of Allowance checklists for attorney review.

  • Prepare and file Information Disclosure Statements, and maintain prior art reference spreadsheets and tracking documents.

  • Act as an advocate for the IP team. This position supports the IP team by identifying and proposing innovative solutions to any IP or firm-wide areas for improvement and then following through on associated action items to completion.

  • Review and submission of IP-related third-party invoices and USPTO deposit account fees.

  • Maintain tracking documents for client portfolios to indicate priority and subject-matter-related applications, including monitoring pending claims across global patent portfolios and coordinating cross-citing of prior art references.

  • Assist with researching issues relating to monthly client billing, such as client inquiries, estimates, budget tracking, or invoice discrepancies.

  • Work directly with the Billing Department to apply fixed-fee patent prosecution schedules to monthly proformas.

  • All members of the firm are encouraged to participate in our Global Responsible Business program.

  • Other duties and projects as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Excellent demonstrated attention to detail

  • Strong communication (written and verbal), interpersonal, and organizational skills.

  • Proactive, with the ability to follow through with the resolution of issues with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to meet deadlines under tight time constraints and other demands.

  • Flexible attitude, with the ability to multitask and deal well with changing assignments and priorities.

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS, AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • Five (5)+ years of patent prosecution support experience required.

  • Experience with the prosecution of technology and energy portfolios preferred.

  • Billing experience, including electronic billing, preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

HOURS

Core hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. – 5:30 p.m., including one hour for lunch. Willingness and ability to work overtime as needed.

title: Flagship Store Director
description:
Simons was founded in 1840 by John Simons in Quebec City. Originally a dry goods store, the family company is known today for accessible and inspired fashion. It is committed to cultivating creativity and building meaningful relationships with its staff, partners, and clientele. The company cares about the environment and about the communities in which it does business.

Simons is recognized as a fashion authority with an original shopping concept. Exclusive collections, emerging local and nationally recognized brands, and pieces by top designer names are all available under one roof in the store’s distinctive zones.




Join The Simons Team as the Flagship Store Director!

Are you ready to embark on a new adventure and step into an exciting leadership role? Simons is thrilled and honoured to be making our long-awaited debut in downtown Vancouver at CF Pacific Centre Shopping Mall. Simons is committed to our legacy of retail excellence in Canada, and we are on the lookout for a strategic Store Director to take on the challenge of leading one of our largest flagship locations in a top-tier shopping destination. If you’re passionate about retail leadership, creativity, and exceptional customer service, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

What You’ll Do
As our Store Director, you will steer and inspire all departments across the store, each contributing to the dynamic and fast-paced atmosphere. You will be the driving force in leading the day-to-day functions of our store, with an entrepreneurial mindset to elevate along the way. You will proudly represent Simons by leading Area Directors, Department managers, and employees to deliver exceptional customer service, embodying the Simons vision. Most importantly, you will foster an inviting atmosphere where customers love to shop, and employees love to work!

  • Lead & Inspire: Build a high-performance team by navigating the management team’s development to enhance their leadership skills, drive customer engagement, and foster an innovative sense of purpose.

  • Drive the Simons Experience: Set the bar high and show your team what success looks like in the downtown Vancouver market, ensuring that all teams master the art of delivering the exceptional Simons service experience to every visitor.

  • Optimize Performance: Achieve or exceed sales targets by implementing innovative strategies that drive profitability for the store, while actively pursuing operational efficiencies and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Deploy the Fashion Vision: You will ensure store presentation and merchandising delivers on our fashion leadership mission. You will lead the creation of captivating displays and manage inventory to ensure the store looks and feels exceptional every day.

  • Amplify the E-commerce Strategies: Enhance the growth of e-commerce shopping services through rigorous execution, delivering a cohesive multi-channel experience that seamlessly integrates both online and in-store shopping.

  • Maximize Relationships: Cultivate and strengthen relationships with cross-functional partners, internal and external vendors, and the downtown Vancouver community. You will be a true ambassador and represent the Simons brand with ease.

What We’re Looking For
We are seeking a natural leader who can seamlessly lead the excitement of fast-paced store operations, while upholding the renowned Simons family reputation since 1840. Your innovative outlook, passion for service, and knowledge of the Vancouver landscape will be key to your success.

  • Experience in Retail Leadership: With 10-15 years in retail (minimum of 7 years in a leadership role), you have a proven ability to manage both people and processes effectively, particularly in fast-paced, high-traffic, demanding stores. A bachelor's degree or equivalent is required for this role; bilingualism is an asset.

  • Agile Leadership: With your aptitude for exceptional planning and adaptability, you excel at managing large cross-functional teams in a busy setting. Your autonomous and flexible style enhances overall performance.

  • Customer Service Passion: You know how to make Vancouver’s downtown diverse customers feel like part of the Simons family and ensure you create a strong sense of vision to inspire your teams to do the same!

  • Strong Business and Financial Acumen: You understand the importance of analyzing performance reports, tracking metrics and using data to innovatively enhance processes and procedures. You pay attention to the fine details while implementing effective solutions to meet business targets.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You proactively seek opportunities to grow the business, drive innovation, and enhance the customer experience with enthusiasm. You take full ownership of creative collaboration to foster long-term success in the competitive Vancouver retail environment.

  • Technologically Advanced: You embrace new technology with confidence and adapt to it effortlessly, showcasing your autonomy in managing digital programs and applying your skills with expertise. Your comfort level allows you to navigate complex tools and systems seamlessly.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Be Part of Something Special: Contribute to a historical Canadian brand and help shape a culture that values teamwork, creativity, and customer service.

  • Grow With Us: Enjoy opportunities to learn, lead, and advance your career while introducing the Simons family to the downtown Vancouver community.

  • A Fun, Engaging Workplace: Join a team that believes in celebrating achievements and creating an enjoyable atmosphere where everyone feels valued.

If you’re ready to make a difference and eager to contribute to our legacy of excellence, we encourage you to apply today!

Please Note the Following Expectations:

  • Customer Service Focus: Experienced and enthusiastic about engaging with customers on the sales floor to provide outstanding service.

  • Varying Hours: Open to a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays, to accommodate operational demands.

  • Training: Available to commute to West Vancouver’s Park Royal Simons location for training prior to store opening.

Please note that the typical hiring timeline for this position may be extended as we prepare for the opening of our new store in 2027. If you are selected, it may take 4 to 6 weeks before you are contacted.

Salary range for this position: $89,000K - $140,000

The salary range provided is intended as a guideline and represents the anticipated hiring range for this position. The final salary offer will be determined based on factors such as relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

At Simons, people are at the heart of all that we do. We pay special attention to the well-being of our employees and their families, highlighting important moments that mark their journey, including service anniversaries and significant life milestones.

Creativity, community, and respect are an integral part of our DNA. We offer everyone the opportunity to build a career that’s suited to them, whether that’s at our stores, head office, or Campus in Quebec City. Proud to recognize our teams’ contributions, we provide competitive work conditions as well as a comprehensive and scalable range of benefits. We also promote flexibility and a welcoming, inclusive, and caring work environment, where everybody can reach their full potential.

Take this opportunity to join our dedicated team and make a difference at a company where people are the top priority.

title: Product Designer - Webex
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco Collaboration Design organization is defining the next generation of product experiences and across both hardware and software. We are a global, cross-disciplinary team of designers, researchers, and technologists who care deeply about how people work together and whose innovation is reliant on the products we build. We’re committed to creating a design culture that is amazingly creative and supportive of you doing meaningful and impactful work.

Your Impact

We are looking for a Product Designer who can bring clarity to complex systems, collaborate closely with product and engineering to turn user needs, technical constraints, and product strategy into intuitive, reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. In this role, you will:

  • Design end-to-end experiences across the Collaboration software portfolio

  • Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers to define user flows, interaction models, and implementation-ready designs.

  • Explore how AI-assisted and agentic workflows can improve user experiences without adding friction or reducing user trust.

  • Create prototypes at the right level of fidelity, from quick workflow explorations to polished concepts for stakeholder alignment, usability testing, and engineering handoff.

  • Use Cisco’s design system to produce consistent, scalable experiences while identifying gaps or new patterns needed for calling-specific use cases.

  • Leverage emerging technologies, tools and AI to amplify your own creativity and efficiency

  • Document interaction behavior, accessibility considerations, edge cases, and design rationale for product teams.

  • Help align teams around a shared product direction through strong storytelling, systems thinking, and pragmatic design judgment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional product design, UX design, or digital interface design experience for software applications.

  • Portfolio: A digital portfolio demonstrating UX/product design case studies, interaction models, and end-to-end user workflows.

  • Design Tools & Prototyping: Experience creating wireframes, component libraries, and interactive prototypes using Figma or industry-standard design tools.

  • Accessibility & Specs: Experience applying digital accessibility guidelines (e.g., WCAG) and documenting design specifications for engineering implementation.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Product Management and Engineering teams across the product lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AI & Agentic Design: Experience designing with and for AI-assisted workflows, automation, intelligent recommendations, or agentic software experiences.

  • Multi-Platform & Hardware Integration: Experience designing across multi-platform ecosystems, including desktop, web, mobile, and hardware-integrated devices/endpoints.

  • Enterprise & Regulated Environments: Familiarity with complex enterprise administration, provisioning, compliance, security, or calling/collaboration platforms.

  • AI Tool Fluency & Human Judgment: Experience using AI tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or workflow generation, paired with clear judgment about where human design thinking matters most.

  • Problem-Shaping Mindset: You are comfortable shaping the problem, not just polishing the solution—asking thoughtful questions, mapping messy workflows, prototyping quickly, and bringing the right people into the conversation so the work moves forward.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Associate Director, Discovery Insights
description:
Job Description:

Associate Director, Discovery Insights

Are you passionate about understanding human behavior and turning deep consumer empathy into breakthrough innovation?

As the Associate Director, Discovery Insights, you will serve as a vital catalyst in Mars Snacking’s internal entrepreneurship engine—championing the front-end of innovation. In this role, you will live and breathe consumer tensions, uncovering rich behavioral insights and translating them into high-impact value propositions for next-generation products and experiences.

Operating at the intersection of human intelligence and rapid experimentation, you’ll lead lean, agile learning loops to test, learn, and iterate bold ideas. If you are an inspiring storyteller and strategic thinker eager to shape the future of snacking, this is your opportunity to make a lasting global impact.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Behavioral Science, Anthropology, Psychology, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s or advanced degree preferred).
  • 5–8 years of experience in consumer insights, innovation research, or a related strategic insights discipline.
  • Deep qualitative expertise across ethnography, in-depth interviews (IDIs), immersions, and collaborative co-creation sessions.
  • Proven application of Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) frameworks and hands-on experience driving agile innovation pipelines.
  • Compelling storytelling & communication skills with a demonstrated ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating workshops and design sprints that bridge consumer discovery with product concepting.
  • Strong analytical acumen to synthesize unstructured behavioral data into clear, actionable business opportunities.
  • Nice-to-have: Experience working in fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG/CPG) or venture/incubator environments.
  • Nice-to-have: Familiarity with quantitative validation tools to complement qualitative discovery.

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Lead human-centric discovery: Uncover unmet consumer needs, latent pain points, and whitespace opportunities through immersive, multi-method qualitative research.
  • Drive agile experimentation: Design and execute lean concept tests, rapid prototyping, and pilot learning loops to validate innovation hypotheses quickly.
  • Translate insights into value propositions: Shape compelling product narratives, user personas, and innovation territories anchored in authentic human behavior.
  • Cross-functional co-creation: Partner closely with R&D, Brand Marketing, and Design to facilitate ideation workshops and translate raw insights into bold, scalable concepts.
  • Champion iterative learning: Embed a "test, learn, adapt" mindset across the front-end innovation team, establishing best practices for early-stage discovery.
  • Influence strategic roadmap: Serve as the authoritative voice of the consumer, guiding leadership on portfolio bets and long-term innovation strategy.
  • Upskill organizational capability: Mentor team members and build enterprise-wide toolkits for qualitative intelligence and human-centered design.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles (Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom).
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including annual company bonus opportunities and comprehensive health/wellness programs.
