title: Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) Analyst

Franklin, TN

The purpose of the Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) Analyst position is to ensure that finished goods are in the right place at the right time within the MPC supply network to meet customer demand, co-pack production requirements, and other inventory balance initiatives, at the least cost to the organization.

The DRP Analyst will lead their segment (Dry, Wet, Care & Treats) in Distribution Requirements Planning for the Mars Petcare Replenishment team, by serving as the main point of contact for replenishment escalations for their segment. They will serve as a Key User for Systems including SAP & JDA Apollo, working directly with peers on the Replenishment team to implement best practices, while ensuring daily and weekly process adherence.

What are we looking for?

Minimum

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience in supply chain planning, inventory deployment, logistics, or distribution resource planning (DRP).

  • Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools, including intermediate-to-advanced Microsoft Excel and experience navigating Power BI or similar BI reporting dashboards.

  • Solid understanding of domestic freight operations, load optimization principles (payload weight, cube utilization, pallet tiers), and transit modes.

  • Proven ability to manage exceptions, resolve logistics bottlenecks, and communicate effectively across cross-functional teams (plants, warehouses, carriers, and 3PL partners).

Preferred

  • Direct experience configuring and executing within advanced planning systems like Kinaxis, or Blue Yonder (JDA).

  • Previous experience in fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG / CPG), food/beverage, or multi-site manufacturing environments with complex distribution networks.

  • Maintain and govern critical planning parameters in OMP to ensure accurate automated deployment and "right-first-time" execution.

  • Exposure to Lean Six Sigma methodologies or a track record of identifying and executing freight and inventory cost-reduction initiatives.

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of SAP (specifically inventory management, STOs, and replenishment modules).

  • 2-5 years experience in a distributed manufacturing environment that includes inventory management and the movement of inventory within the company and to customers.

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Leverage advanced planning systems (SAP, Power BI) to analyze item-level inventory across manufacturing plants and distribution centers, orchestrating product movement to maximize customer fill rates while minimizing total landed costs.

  • Maintain and govern critical planning parameters in OMP to ensure accurate automated deployment and "right-first-time" execution.

  • Maximize freight efficiency and cost savings by strategically building and consolidating multi-SKU truckloads—optimizing weight, pallet count, product mix, and modal selection (e.g., intermodal vs. OTR).

  • Drive performance against key replenishment metrics (Customer Fill Rate, On-Time Replenishment, Payload Utilization, and Intermodal Adoption), actively identifying root causes and deploying corrective actions.

  • Proactively manage Stock Transport Orders (STOs) and dynamic inventory transfers on an exception basis, collaborating with logistics partners (3PLs), plants, and DCs to resolve transit delays and receipt discrepancies.

  • Balance daily inbound and outbound shipment schedules across sites to ensure volume aligns with warehouse throughput and carrier capacity constraints.

  • Monitor network-wide stock levels daily to execute inter-site assistance and inventory rebalancing, supporting manufacturing facilities during supply-demand imbalances.

  • Utilize JDA Replenishment Workbench suite and Replenishment databases including SAP & various Tableau reports, to analyze the inventory position by item and location. Uses info to determine correct quantities and locations to distribute finished product between plants & distribution centers to maximize customer service at the lowest costs, including inventory that is currently available, and/or future production.

  • Builds truckloads of finished goods from plant to warehouse by consolidating SKUs in a manner that makes the best use of freight transportation dollars. Delivers costs savings to the business annually through truck and transportation mode utilization.

  • Attains target level metrics for replenishment area (Customer Fill Rate, Replenishment On-Time shipping, Aging inbounds, Intermodal Utilization, Payload Utilization, & Assistance Spend Tracking) to determine and implement the required actions necessary to positively affect targeted goals.

  • Manage and balance the number of inbound and outbound shipments to/from plants and warehouses to ensure the amount of loads scheduled does not exceed location throughput or freight capacities.

  • Proactively call out service risks through daily JTM & CMOS huddles, weekly LMOS, Regional DOR calls, Ops Huddles inputs, or other forums. Analyze and determine root causes of service failures in order to implement and communicate appropriate actions going forward. Lead JTM/CMOS and other operational execution meetings as needed.

  • As Key User, serves as the first point of contact for peer and cross-functional end-users when there are process or system related issues or failures. Escalates to FEs when needed. Responsible for documenting existing and new Replenishment processes and standard routines through use of one-point lessons, SOPs, and playbooks.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work within a diverse team of talented Associates, all guided by our core principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom.

  • Join a company where we are actively striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

  • Receive dedicated support from day one, including unlimited access to our in-house Mars University to help accelerate your career growth.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary, an industry-leading benefits package, a company bonus scheme, and holistic health and wellness support.

description:

Reporting to the Head of IT Architecture, this role will be responsible for working with the team and evolving the enterprise DevOps platform, cloud automation capabilities, CI/CD standards, and Infrastructure as Code practices across the organization.

This position will work closely with the Architecture team, Cloud Engineering teams, application development teams, and enterprise technology partners to enable secure, scalable, and highly automated software delivery. Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery

  • Experience supporting Azure cloud services and cloud-native applications.

Een leuke plek om werkervaring op te doen, lekker bij te verdienen en je werk te combineren met school, studie en je vrije tijd. En het Banjaardstrand? Dat ligt gewoon om de hoek.

What will you do:

Als medewerker snackbar ben je onderdeel van het team dat ervoor zorgt dat gasten snel kunnen genieten van hun bestelling. Je werkt achter de counter, in de keuken en op andere plekken in de snackbar. Je helpt gasten, maakt bestellingen klaar en zorgt ervoor dat alles netjes en soepel blijft verlopen.

Tijdens je dienst houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Bestellingen opnemen en klaarmaken, waarbij je ervoor zorgt dat friet, snacks, pizza’s, ijs en andere producten op de juiste manier en op tijd worden meegegeven
  • Gasten helpen bij hun bestelling, vragen beantwoorden en ervoor zorgen dat zij snel weer verder kunnen met hun vakantiedag
  • Samenwerken tijdens drukke momenten, waarbij je elkaar helpt, taken verdeelt en ervoor zorgt dat de wachtrij niet onnodig lang wordt
  • De snackbar netjes en schoon houden, van de counter en tafels tot de werkplekken in de keuken

Je krijgt dus een afwisselende bijbaan waarin je de hele dienst lekker bezig bent. Je leert ondertussen hoe het is om in een horecateam te werken, krijgt contact met allerlei verschillende gasten en doet ervaring op die je later ook goed kunt gebruiken.

This is you:

Ervaring in de horeca is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Je leert tijdens het werk hoe alles gaat en krijgt de ruimte om steeds meer taken op te pakken.

Job Summary:
Prepares detailed and accurate Self-Perform Work (SPW) cost estimates that support project planning, bidding, and operational decision-making. Applies technical knowledge of materials, labor, and production methods to evaluate SPW scopes across multiple trades. Collaborates with project, field, and operations teams to ensure estimates reflect realistic production rates, current market conditions, and risk assessments. Contributes to the continuous improvement of SPW estimating tools and data management practices.

Prepares comprehensive SPW cost estimates, integrating material, labor, equipment, and production data for multiple scopes.
Analyzes drawings, models, and specifications to validate quantities, identify risks, and confirm scope completeness.
Collaborates with field leaders, engineers, and project teams to verify production rates and align estimates with execution plans.
Coordinates with procurement teams to evaluate vendor and supplier pricing for SPW materials and equipment, levelling supplier and trade partner bids for SPW work, ensuring that all proposals are consistent with project assumptions and identifying any variances.
Develops variance analyses and cost studies to support value engineering and constructability discussions.
Coordinates with scheduling and operations teams to ensure SPW scope aligns with phasing, access, and sequencing plans, and maintains historical cost and production data to support continuous improvement in estimating accuracy.
Communicates estimate assumptions, findings, and recommendations clearly to project stakeholders, and identifies SPW-related risks, constraints, and uncertainties and incorporates appropriate allowances or contingencies in partnership with operations teams.

None required.

Job Description

This position is responsible for coordinating and managing clinical trials, ensuring compliance with study protocols, regulatory requirements, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.

Key Duties include:

  • Completing required submissions to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) and Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC).
  • Working alongside the program manager and other internal departments to review budgets and contracts.
  • Scheduling and conducting study visits and assessments per protocol; including but not limited to medical history, survey administration, ediary device training, ECGs, concomitant medication, etc.
  • Collecting, processing, shipping, and maintaining inventory of research biological specimens
  • Ensuring timely and accurate data collection following GCP and ALCOA++ guidelines
  • Collecting and reporting adverse events information as required per protocol
  • Maintaining screening, study visits, training and consent logs in the Investigator site files.
  • Preparing study documentation for routine monitoring visits.
  • Serving as the primary liaison between site staff, sponsors, study vendors and other internal departments involved in the conduct of clinical research
  • Providing mentorship to junior staff members with areas of training and development.
  • Serve as expert resource for hospital staff performing study related procedures.
  • Update and maintain internal CTMS systems and review EPIC billing charges. Work alongside internal departments to confirm study-related charges and invoiceable items.

Research Operations Research Visits: 35%

Recruitment: Synthesizes and interprets recruitment reports to assess effectiveness of recruitment strategies and implements innovative solutions to maximize recruitment strategies by allocating resources appropriately. Screening: Provides oversight and training to entire team unit with regards to subject screening. Establishes systems and policies related to subject screening. Study visit preparation and documentation: Provides oversight and training to study team members, including clinic staff, regarding preparation of study visits, maintenance of subject level documentation and creation of study level SOPs. Conduct study visits: Serves as a departmental/unit resource and/or trains others regarding the conduct of study visits, creation of study level SOPs and/or implementation of operational plans. May perform advanced clinical assessments or interventions and/or trains others on study assessments. Specimen collections: Creates, optimizes, and oversees systems to collect, prepare, ship, and maintain inventory of research specimens and trains others on these tasks. Informed consent: Provides oversight (to include review) to study team members who conduct and document consent for participants in a variety of studies. Serves as an expert resource and trainer across department or unit on the consent process and related documentation. Investigational Products: Responsible for the management of IP. Oversees and serves as an expert resource for study teams on the implementation of and compliance with required systems for IP handling, dispensing and documentation. Regulatory management: Responsible for creating and/or implementing policies and procedures related to department/unit-wide regulatory management. Interactions with IRB: Serves as a department/unit-wide resource for the development of IRB submissions and for guidance on IRB communications. Preparation for study monitoring/audit visits: Responsible for creating and/or implementing department/unit-wide policies and guidance related to monitoring and audits. Adverse event collection and safety reporting: Oversees adverse event collection or provides expert guidance on identifying adverse events. Safety Reporting: Oversees the IRB safety report documentation for the entire department or unit. Serves as a resource to department, unit, or division on safety reporting. Billing Compliance: Serves as a resource and trains other staff on reviewing study participant charges and implementing corrective action plans. Ensures that the use of research funding is in compliance with funding agency protocols.

Data and Informatics-10%

Data Entry: Serves as a departmental/ unit-wide resource on CRFs, provides oversight to ensure highest quality data collection and capture. Data Coordination: Creates complex data collection forms (CRFs and/or source documents) according to protocol. Exports data to include reporting of data.

Communication-10%

Communication with sponsors, sites, CROs & Teamwork: Prepares for and leads departmental, unit or division-wide meetings. Mentors junior staff to improve ability to participate in team efforts.

Ethics and Participant Safety-5%

Safety Plans: Coordinates efforts and data for external monitoring boards and independently facilitates and submits the completion of documents related to Research Data Security Plans, Data Safety and Monitoring Plans, and Conflict of Interest. Implementation of Human Subjects Protections: Serves as an expect resource to study teams as they design studies, so they specifically include safeguards to ensure ethical conduct and protection of vulnerable populations. Conflict of Interest: Creates policies and guidances at the department/ unit-wide level regarding ethical considerations.

Leadership and Professionalism-10%

Leadership Involvement: Takes part in a committee, taskforce, or ad hoc group within a department. May participate in presentations and/or publications. Management and mentorship: Trains staff on various work responsibilities and assigns responsibilities to junior staff. Provides constructive feedback to team members.

Site and Study Management-25%

Trial Feasibility: Makes recommendations to investigators and oversite organizations regarding site resources for study teams to help determine site trial feasibility. Budgeting and Financial Management: Facilitates, reviews and confirms study budgets and/or study invoices for study-related activities and procedures including sub-contracts and billing. Quality Assurance: Serves as an internal Quality Assurance Monitor and develops and implements protocol specific quality assurance plans. Conducts site-initiation, interim and close-out monitoring visits, writes monitoring reports, and develops corrective action plans related to visit findings Managing Resources: Oversees department/unit-wide processes related to research resources and finances. Operational Plans: Creates unit-wide, and may collaborate to create institution-wide, policies and guidances regarding research operations and plans. Managing Risk: Responsible for or leads the development and/or implementation of policies and guidelines related to compliance with institutional requirements and other policies. Also ensures appropriate training of all staff related to risk management. May also participate in or lead policy development and/or provide training at the institutional level.

Other duties as assigned – 5%

description:
Position Summary


You will join a multidisciplinary in vivo team in Spain to support the discovery and preclinical development of new medicines. You will run and analyse in vivo studies using rodent models and work closely with colleagues across disciplines. We value practical laboratory skills, careful data handling, and a collaborative attitude. This role offers clear learning and growth opportunities, the chance to make measurable contributions to projects, and the satisfaction of supporting GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Responsibilities


This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


- Plan and perform in vivo studies using rodent models, including dosing, clinical monitoring and humane sample collection.
- Process and analyse biological samples using techniques such as qPCR, flow cytometryx, histology, ELISA and basic microbiology assays.
- Maintain and manage accurate experimental records and support data integrity and reproducibility.
- Contribute to study design, including defining endpoints, sample size considerations and standard operating procedures.
- Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, and monitor supplies and animal welfare needs.
- Work safely in controlled laboratory facilities and follow biosafety and animal welfare procedures.

Why You?

Basic Qualification
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
- Degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Veterinary Sciences or a related life science field.
- Practical experience handling rodents and performing common in vivo procedures.

- Experience in Salmonella and enteric disease models.
- Experience preparing biological samples and running assays such as qPCR, histology, flow cytometry and ELISAs.
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish language skills are desirable.
- Attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate laboratory records.
- Commitment to laboratory safety, animal welfare and data integrity.

Preferred Qualification
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus
- Accredited training in animal experimentation (for example, national categories for animal work).
- Experience working in biosafety level 2 or 3 laboratory environments.
- Experience with in advanced sample analysis methods.
- Familiarity with assay development and troubleshooting.
- Experience working in multidisciplinary teams or cross-functional project settings.
- Basic data analysis skills using GraphPad, Excel or similar tools.

Location and Working Model
This role is based in Spain and is on site at our research facility. The working model is primarily on site to support laboratory activities and animal facility work.

title: Hostler
description:
The Hostler role sits at the core of our Operations function, ensuring the continuous, safe, and efficient movement of freight and equipment across the service center. This position directly impacts dock flow, trailer utilization, and overall throughput—making it essential to maintaining operational velocity and service reliability.

As freight volumes scale and operational complexity increases, precision in yard and dock coordination becomes a critical advantage. Success in this role means minimizing delays, maintaining a clean and organized workspace, and enabling seamless handoffs between inbound, outbound, and storage functions. The Hostler ensures that the right assets are in the right place at the right time—every time.



What you’ll do

1. Execute yard and dock movement with precision

  • Shuttle empty and loaded trailers across dock doors, staging areas, and parking lots
  • Interpret work orders and verbal instructions to prioritize equipment movement
  • Align trailer positioning with inbound/outbound scheduling needs
  • Maintain continuous flow to eliminate bottlenecks and idle time

2. Support freight handling operations

  • Load, unload, and transport freight across dock, storage, and staging areas
  • Move materials using forklifts, pallet jacks, or industrial equipment
  • Stack, bundle, and secure freight to ensure safe handling and shipment readiness
  • Verify and count freight accurately during movement

3. Maintain safety, compliance, and equipment standards

  • Follow all safety protocols, including hazardous material handling procedures
  • Perform routine checks and safe operation of forklifts and hoisting equipment
  • Secure loads properly to prevent damage or operational risk
  • Maintain clean, organized, and hazard-free work areas

4. Enable operational efficiency and teamwork

  • Coordinate closely with operations and dock supervisors to align priorities
  • Participate actively in team initiatives to improve workflow and productivity
  • Adapt to shifting demands with speed and attention to detail
  • Support team performance by maintaining consistency and reliability

5. Execute with accountability and attention to detail

  • Track tasks and complete assignments with minimal supervision
  • Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and safety
  • Apply sound judgment in dynamic, fast-paced environments
  • Communicate clearly across teams to ensure operational clarity

What you bring

  • High school diploma or GED, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 0–3 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or freight handling environments
  • Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification
  • Hazardous Materials training or willingness to complete training
  • Ability to read and interpret safety rules, work orders, and procedural documentation
  • Working math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, decimals, and fractions)
  • Strong verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate across operations teams
  • Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and handle multiple responsibilities
  • Demonstrated sound judgment in environments with limited structure
  • Experience operating yard tractors, hoists, or other material handling equipment

How you operate

  • You think in systems, ensuring flow and coordination across moving parts
  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks
  • You prioritize safety without compromising efficiency
  • You execute quickly with precision and discipline
  • You maintain focus and composure in fast-paced, high-demand environments
  • You communicate clearly and escalate issues proactively
  • You adapt to changing priorities without losing operational control




Compensation & Setup

  • Pay: $19.00 per hour
  • Location: Onsite | Charlotte, NC
  • Benefits: Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Demands

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle or feel, reach with hands and talk and hear.
  • The employee is occasionally required to sit, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl and smell.
  • The employee must regularly lift and or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 80 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities include color vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving vehicles, outside weather conditions and vibrations. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, high precarious places, and extreme temperatures.
  • The noise level in the work area is usually moderate to high.

Roadrunner is for ambitious, smart people who excel at execution over talking about it, and who would rather invent the next standard in freight than accept the status quo.

Action driven leaders who want to be part of real change and help design the future of LTL in the U.S. This is a place where high performers can grow, influence outcomes, and make an impact while working directly with executives and smart people from across industries.

Position Summary:

Join a groundbreaking team at Bank of America, at the forefront of innovation in AI. We are building the next generation of Gen AI platform, empowering new AI initiatives across Consumer, Small Business, Global Banking, and Wealth organizations. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a critical platform that will enable secure, scalable, and high-performance AI capabilities across the organization. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

This position is focused on design, build, and serve the Gen AI BI capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to shape the enterprise data ecosystem by establishing governance standards, improving data discoverability, enabling self-service capabilities, supporting platform tenants, and ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant usage of data platform technologies. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in data governance and metadata management with a strong customer-centric mindset focused on platform adoption and business value realization.
This role is responsible for defining and leading the governance, adoption, onboarding, and tenant support strategy for enterprise data platforms while partnering with engineering, architecture, risk, and business stakeholders to drive enterprise-wide outcomes.

This job is responsible for driving efforts to develop and deliver complex data solutions to accomplish technology and business goals. Key responsibilities include leading code design and delivery tasks with the integration, cleaning, transformation and control of data in operational and analytical data systems. Job expectations include liaising with vendors and working with stakeholders and Product and Software Engineering teams to implement data requirements, analyzing performance, and researching and troubleshooting issues within system engineering domains.

Responsibilities:

  • Leads story refinement and delivery of requirements through the delivery lifecycle and assists team members in resolving technical complexities

  • Leads testing teams to develop test plans, contributes to existing test suites including integration, regression, and performance, analyzes test reports, identifies test issues and errors, and leads triage of underlying causes

  • Mentors Data Engineers to enable continuous development and monitors key performance indicators and internal controls
  • Define and execute strategic roadmaps for governance, adoption, and tenant service capabilities.

title: Customer Delivery Architect
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco's Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services is at the forefront of the global 5G revolution. We partner with Japan's tier-1 mobile network operators (MNOs) to architect, deploy, and optimize mission-critical 4G/5G mobile packet core networks and cloud-native mobile infrastructures.

Our team combines deep 3GPP domain expertise with cutting-edge cloud-native platform engineering. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where we co-innovate with Cisco's global Mobility Business Units (BU), Centers of Excellence (CoE), and tier-1 service providers to deliver ultra-reliable, high-capacity, and low-latency mobile platforms supporting millions of subscribers.

Your Impact

As a Customer Delivery Architect for Mobility & 5G, you will serve as the principal technical authority and trusted advisor leading the end-to-end architectural design, validation, and commercial deployment of Cisco's 5G Standalone (SA) / Non-Standalone (NSA) Converged Core and Cloud-Native Network Functions (CNF).

You will bridge the gap between customer business objectives and technical delivery execution. You will own the high-level architecture (HLD), low-level parameters (LLD), end-to-end call flow design, and performance optimization for 5G Core network functions (UPF, SMF, AMF, PCF, NRF) across bare-metal and containerized Telco Cloud environments, ensuring flawless execution during live carrier cutovers and network migrations.

What You'll Do

• 5G Core Architecture & Solution Design: Lead the architecture, design, and integration of Cisco 5G SA/NSA Core solutions, Converged Packet Core (vEPC / 5GC), and Control and User Plane Separation (CUPS) architectures for major Japanese telecommunications carriers.

• Cloud-Native & User Plane Engineering: Architect high-throughput, low-latency 5G User Plane Functions (UPF) and Service-Based Architecture (SBA) control planes running on modern container platforms (Kubernetes / OpenStack / Bare-metal Telco Cloud).

• End-to-End Call Flow & Protocol Design: Define detailed signaling call flows, session management, policy control, charging (CHF/Diameter), subscriber data management, and network slicing across 3GPP (Rel 15/16/17) standards.

• PDI Delivery & Cutover Governance: Act as the lead delivery architect across the full project lifecycle (Plan, Design, Implement)-directing lab staging, PoC benchmarks, migration strategies, operational runbooks, and real-time risk decision-making during high-stakes maintenance windows.

• Strategic Advisory & Trusted Partnership: Partner closely with telco engineering directors, CTO office stakeholders, Cisco Account Teams (AM/CSM), and specialist SEs to shape multi-year technology roadmaps and drive architectural evolution.

• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and mentor senior consulting engineers, drive delivery quality control, and collaborate with global development teams (Mobility BU / TAC) to resolve critical software and protocol roadblocks.

Who You'll Work With

You will collaborate with a passionate, multidisciplinary team of mobile core specialists, cloud-native architects, and project leaders within Cisco CX Japan. You will work closely with Account Executives, Solution Architects, global CoE delivery centers, and the Cisco Mobility BU, while interfacing directly with executive technical leaders at Japan's top telecommunications operators.

Who You Are

You are a distinguished mobile packet core architect with extensive experience designing and deploying large-scale carrier mobile networks. You combine deep 3GPP protocol mastery with modern cloud-native virtualization acumen and exceptional client leadership skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 8+ years of hands-on technical experience in Service Provider mobile packet core architecture, engineering design, or delivery (4G LTE EPC, 5G NSA/SA Core).

• Deep technical mastery of 3GPP mobile core protocols and interfaces: 5G SBA (HTTP/2, REST APIs, JSON), PFCP (N4/Sx), GTP-C/GTP-U, Diameter, RADIUS, and BGP/MPLS routing.

• Proven track record architecting or deploying core network functions: UPF, SMF, AMF, NRF, PCF, MME, SGW, PGW, and ePDG/N3IWF.

• Hands-on experience with Telco Cloud and virtualization platforms hosting VNFs/CNFs (Kubernetes, Docker, OpenStack, KVM, SR-IOV, DPDK/CNDP).

• Experience leading mission-critical network cutovers, major software migrations, and performance benchmarking for tier-1 telecommunications carriers.

• Native or business-level fluency in Japanese (client executive presentations, SOW scoping, and technical documentation) with professional working proficiency in English (collaborating with global BUs and international delivery teams).

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Cisco Mobility platforms (e.g., Cisco Ultra Cloud Core / Cloud Native 5G Core, Cisco StarOS / ASR 5500, Cisco UCS).

• In-depth understanding of 5G Network Slicing, Private 5G, MEC (Multi-Access Edge Computing), and IMS/VoNR architecture.

• Industry certifications such as CCIE (Service Provider / Enterprise Infrastructure), CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), or equivalent.

• Scripting and automation capabilities using Python, Ansible, Terraform, or Linux shell tools for automated testing and CI/CD validation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Description:

Job Description

Distribution Operations lies at the heart of the Shell value chain embodying the lifeforce that seamlessly manages the transportation, storage and delivery of essential energy resources and solutions to our customers. ​

​We are the bridge that connects the value chain through strategic partnerships across Shell and enables integrated value delivery.​

​We maximise the value of our existing assets and relentlessly pursue solutions that enable greater commercial value and reduce carbon intensity while upholding world class safety performance and risk management. We drive digital and automation solutions to create assets of the future. ​Through our road transport and terminal strategies, we aspire to deliver more value with less emissions whilst building greater resilience in supply chain volatility to thrive in the Energy Transition.

Dimensions:

Road Transport NSC is the largest Road Transport Operations within Trading and Supply Europe/Africa organization with an annual spend of approx.US $ 150mln p.a. across seven different countries, 6 major businesses (Retail, Aviation, Commercial, LNG, Bitumen and Hydrogen) and currently 12 RT Contractors.

As the Road Transport Integrator (RTI), you will play a crucial role in interfacing with key internal stakeholders of RT UK, including Mobility and Supply (Channel Optimization and Commercial Oil Operations), as well as in liaising with external stakeholders like RT Contractor schedulers and dispatchers regarding Shell expectations and core deliverables to ensure safe, cost effective and compliant deliveries to its customers.

The RT Integrator will report to the Road Transport Integrator Team Lead and be based out of SBO in Krakow.

Where you Fit:

With the change in business model to non-dedicated outsourced scheduling and the change of location for SBO support for Road Transport UK from SBO Manila to Krakow you will be critical in helping the team navigate the significant change in a complex landscape. You will be supported by the existing OTD team in Manila, the BNL OTD team in SBO Krakow and other RT SBO teams based in SBO Krakow.

As a successful candidate you’ll take charge of all aspects related to systems and processes for successful outsource scheduling day-to-day operations. You will own and drive the tools needed for stakeholder engagement, ensuring Shell expectations and core deliverables are met, i.e. safe, cost-effective, and compliant deliveries to our customers.

As the entire NSC RT landscape transitions from a Mode 1 dedicated model to NDOS, the RTI team in Krakow will evolve into a community supporting the countries in the cluster, providing growth and development opportunities, as well as learning/supporting a wider range of dynamic supply chains in the region.

Your Role in the Team:

  • Manage day-to-day operational activities and provides the interface between RT Contractors and various Shell partners and stakeholders including: Mobility, Supply, Loading Locations, and Supply Chain Support team. Key aspects of the role include but are not limited to:

Informing and aligning on commercial terms and feasibility of, logistical steers with all stakeholders

Monitoring compliance with Plan vs. Actual liftings with RT Contractors

Challenge feedback from RT Contractors on operational performance including delivery against Monthly demand forecast

Ensure RT Contractors maintain agreed Stockout and Working Capital levels and identify E2E improvement opportunities

  • Act as the main focal point between RT Contractors and Shell systems and processes to ensure Contractor Schedulers can plan movements and Contractor drivers can load and deliver product on behalf of Shell.
  • Support delivery of Shell ‘phoned in’ customer orders and ensure Contractor Schedulers have all the touchless orders placed in Markethub and update mapping in the TMP of RT Contractors to ship to. Manage any issues with incomplete customer orders.
  • Provide interface between RT Contractors and Shell credit management, manage the credit assurance process for non-consigned VMI customers to ensure that we follow up on blocked customer sites and pursue a demand through to delivery.
  • Support RT Contractors in the event of VMI system outages, providing first level trouble shooting support to RT Contractors.
  • Responsible for communication of urgent order requirements from Shell to RT Contractors
  • Administer Load Support Services if drivers have problems interacting with Terminal Automation Systems when loading product and any supply allocation issues.
  • Check that any planned movement reference documents have been exported from SAP and received in Terminal loading locations.
  • Liaise with Customer Operations, where relevant to the market, to monitor vehicle visibility and order tracking in the event of customer queries.
  • Ensure any manual advanced shipment notifications are managed by the RT Contractors.
  • Review and where appropriate, authorise non-standard deliveries when requested by RT Contractors.
  • Investigate issues with in-transit product and agree to resolution of disputes between customers and RT Contractors
  • Manage any delivery documentation requirements that must be produced from Shell as the shipper.
  • Responsible for any legal and fiscal adherence if Shell must communicate with Government agencies prior to load and delivery.
  • Responsible for the management of Master data held in GSAP and VMI.
  • Identify areas for performance optimization and deliver improvements (E2E value opportunities as well as cost and efficiency challenges) by continuous improvement activities and stakeholder engagement.
  • Contribute to ambitious Cluster Road Transport cost budget, value creation, service levels working in seamless collaboration with Finance, Mobility, Products/CO and New Business Integration.
  • Collaborate between Shell stakeholders and outsourced RT Contractors on the annual Trading & Supply Supply Chain optimization cycle and Seasonal Switch, including:

o Gathering the lists of tanks at risk

o Coordination of pricing actions with Pricing Team

o Communicating to RT Contractors regular updates of RVP’s from depots/refineries

o Preparing and sending reports regarding Season Switch progress to relevant stakeholders

  • Download data from relevant systems, analyse and generate ad hoc reports as required by Road Transport NSC.
  • Act as Business Focal Point for the new Transport Management Platform, supporting RT Contractors as well as Shell Road Transport Contract management teams.
  • Actively participate and contribute to Supply Chain Disruption and Crisis management when needed

SPECIAL CHALLENGES

The successful candidate will need to be collaborative and work with others in different locations to assure a successful handover, especially considering the change in SBO location with the current OTD team based in SBO Manila.

  • Road Transport Integrator needs to be capable of dealing with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders that does require excellent communication skills and leadership
  • Deliver year on year value improvements by demonstrating a strong commercial acumen
  • High level of resilience needed to deal with multiple topics at same time as well as to cope with stressful and unknown situations caused by Supply Chain Disruptions
  • Have a strong “can-do” mindset and bringing innovative ideas to the team
  • Being strong in delivery through others (i.e. RT Contractors) by having proven influencing skills.

What we need from you:

Professional competencies:

  • Proven experience in understanding key business processes within an organization. Experience in Distribution planning is an advantage.
  • Champions Customer Focus
  • Proven capability in diverse Stakeholder Management at various levels
  • Delivery through others
  • Problem solving
  • Maximizes Business Opportunities
  • Continuous improvement mindset (LEAN, CIP1 preferred)
  • Demonstrates understanding E2E Supply Chain
  • Strong achievement-orientation, motivation & ability to deliver quality results under pressure
  • Provide leadership in HSSE
  • Project Management
  • Communication/presentation skills

Languages:

  • Excellent English and an additional language capability of French, Flemish, Dutch is advantageous providing optionality to provide cover to the wider North Sea Cluster Organisation.

This role is designed as office-based roles (minimum of 3 days a week) and will be based in SBO Krakow.

Expected 2-3 international business trips each year.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/29/2026

This is an onsite role in Milpitas, CA

Meet the Team

Cisco Secure Access is cloud-delivered security service edge (SSE) solution, grounded in zero trust, gives users an exceptional user experience and protected access from any device too anywhere. Cisco Secure Access enforces security policies such as access control, threat protection and data security using ZTNA, SWG, DNS, CASB and FWaaS. As a team member, you'll play a crucial role in enhancing seamless and secure access to applications and resources, and protecting organizations from diverse cyber threats. Join the Cisco Secure Access team, where innovation meets cutting-edge technology in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Your Impact

You will serve as a Principal Software Engineer within Cisco's cloud security business group, collaborating across multiple fast-paced teams to design, develop, and deliver scalable, supportable, and maintainable production-quality applications! Your responsibilities include building new capabilities to the products as well as and improving existing processes and architecture, developing, partnering with internal and external teams to understand business and technical requirements and documenting technical specifications for development. You will oversee architecture, design, code quality, and deployments, while also documenting and communicating technical solutions to architecture groups and leadership. Additionally, you will participate in design and code reviews, mentor junior developers, evaluate new technology stacks and third-party tools through proof of concepts and benchmarks, and troubleshoot sophisticated system-level stability and scalability issues.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering or Computer Science with a minimum of 17+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master’s degree and 10 years of relevant industry experience owning architecture and technical strategy across multiple teams, from problem definition and system design through rollout, adoption, and operational support.

  • 7+ years of experience in a technical leadership role and architecture.

  • 10+ years experience in development in AWS cloud or similar and proficiency in Python, Go or Java.

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, APIs, micro-services architecture, data platforms, multi-tenant services, and production operations.

  • Experience building agentic systems and leveraging AI to improve productivity across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Preferred requirements:

  • Experience with SSE/SASE, zero-trust architecture, identity-aware access, authorization, secure web access, data protection, DNS security, browser isolation, or digital experience monitoring.

  • Experience with LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool calling, prompt and context management, model evaluation, LLMOps, AI safety, guardrails, and responsible AI.

  • Experience with streaming data, feature engineering, anomaly detection, behavioral or graph analytics, model drift, explain-ability, feedback loops, and investigation or analyst workflows.

  • Experience with data pipelines handling large volumes and sound knowledge in technologies such as Kafka, Kubernetes, NoSQL.

  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks, TypeScript, component or design systems, web performance, accessibility, browser security, API design, and backend-for-frontend architecture.

  • Ability to work independently, research current and emerging technologies, propose changes as needed to cater to changing business / technical conditions.

  • Ability to optimally lead teams and inspire others to achieve goals through innovation, quality and excellence.

  • Excellent debugging skills, ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex system level stability or scalability issues.

  • A track record of setting engineering standards, resolving cross-organization architectural tension, mentoring principal-level talent, and communicating complex ideas to mixed audiences.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:
We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programmes, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme.

Discover more about our company wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage Life at GSK | GSK

Director, Integrative Sciences

We are seeking a visionary leader to join our Oncology Translational Medicine Integrative Sciences team as the Director of Integrative Sciences.

This role will focus on driving innovation in diagnostic technology platforms, leveraging cutting-edge approaches such as oncology foundational models, real world data, multi-modal omics data, AI/ML, computational pathology, and biomarker discovery to transform how we understand and treat cancer. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping biomarker, diagnostic, and clinical development strategies, particularly in the context of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), T cell engagers and other advanced therapeutic modalities, while maintaining responsibilities for analyzing clinical trial biomarker data to enable translational medicine approaches.

For candidates seeking to be located at our Stevenage site, this role will temporarily be based at Stevenage. However, the Company plans to relocate its offices to Cambridge, UK. The location of this role will therefore subsequently change to Cambridge, UK Ware in accordance with timelines to be set by the Company. The relocation is currently proposed to take effect by early 2029.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will

  • Lead innovation in emerging diagnostic technologies, including ctDNA, computational pathology, advanced imaging techniques, and multi-modal biomarker platforms, to enhance patient stratification, therapeutic targeting, and mechanism-of-action insights.
  • Develop and apply oncology foundational models and AI/ML analytical approaches to complex clinical, real-world and biomarker datasets, including high-dimensional data such as single-cell transcriptomics, spatial omics, proteomics, and cfDNA.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in application of analytical methods and emerging diagnostic technologies to enable biomarker discovery and diagnostic strategies to optimize patient selection, dose determination, and combination therapy approaches with a focus on antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs).
  • Oversee the integration of oncology foundational models to inform translational medicine and clinical development strategies ensuring robust interpretation, practical implementation and timely communication across matrix teams.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, clinical development, CPMS (Clinical Pharmacology and Modelling Simulation), Diagnostic, Translational Research, and AI/ML teams, to evaluate and apply complementary data analytics approaches for meaningful insights into complex biology.
  • Lead efforts to identify, evaluate, and implement emerging technology platforms to advance diagnostic innovation and support pipeline growth.
  • Provide leadership and accountability for clear and timely communication of data analysis outputs, complex analytical principles, and models to diverse stakeholders, including senior leaders and non-technical partners.
  • Champion the integration of biomarker and diagnostic strategies into clinical development plans, ensuring alignment with oncology research unit and translational medicine objectives
  • Drive the application of computational pathology and AI-driven image analysis to enhance diagnostic capabilities and biomarker discovery in oncology programs.
  • Support the evaluation of academic partnerships and external technology platforms, ensuring alignment with Oncology Translational Medicine goals and innovation priorities.
  • Contribute to due diligence efforts for business development opportunities, leveraging expertise in advanced analytics and emerging diagnostic technologies.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications & Skills:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  • PhD degree or equivalent experience/training in computational biology, bioinformatics, machine learning, computational pathology, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of applied experience in Pharma/Biotech or an academic setting, with a focus on oncology research, diagnostic innovation, and biomarker analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, driving alignment and delivering impactful outcomes.
  • Experience with emerging diagnostic platforms and technologies, including their application to translational medicine and clinical development.
  • Demonstrated advanced knowledge of statistical and analytical methods relevant to the analysis of complex high-dimensional heterogeneous datasets.
  • Experience with GitHub, development of R Shiny applications/R markdown, and working in cloud or high-performance computing (HPC) environments.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:

  • MD degree with oncology clinical development experience is highly desirable and considered an upside for this role.
  • Expertise in oncology foundational models and AI/ML analytical approaches applied to complex biomarker datasets.
  • Proficiency in coding skills (e.g., R, Python) and strong working knowledge of bioinformatics databases, resources, and tools.
  • Proven ability to analyze and interpret high-dimensional datasets (e.g., single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, cfDNA) using advanced modeling techniques.
  • Experience with computational pathology and AI-driven image analysis in the context of diagnostic innovation.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial biomarker data analysis and its application to precision medicine strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience with antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and their associated biomarker and diagnostic strategies.
  • Proven leadership experience in driving diagnostic innovation and implementing emerging technologies in oncology research.
  • Strong track record of integrating preclinical and clinical biomarker data to inform translational medicine strategies.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and data standards for transitioning programs into clinical trials.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to influence and drive decision-making in a matrix environment.

description:

Cisco’s Collaboration Business Unit empowers people and organizations worldwide to connect, communicate, and innovate seamlessly. Webex is powering the shift to the hybrid workforce, helping people stay connected in a rapidly evolving digital world. We cultivate a startup-like culture that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, while offering the scale and impact of a global technology leader.

As a distributed big data enthusiast, you’ll architect and deploy resilient, large-scale data solutions across Cassandra, Kafka, and OpenSearch in hybrid AWS and private cloud environments. You’ll automate cloud infrastructure with Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes, optimize high-throughput systems for scale and performance, and strengthen reliability through automated backups, security patching, and incident management. As a trusted technical partner, you’ll also guide application teams on data access patterns and cloud migration strategies.

  • Bachelors and 8+ years hands on experience (deploy, monitor, scale, and upgrades) with a distributed database technology such as CassandraDB, Opensearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL, or Redis.

  • 5+ Years experience with infrastructure automation and DevOps practices such as CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes), Python

  • 5+ years experience supporting live production systems for customer facing software as a service

  • 3+ years of experience leading technical projects, including responsibility for task estimation, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to modern data platforms including data pipelines, streaming systems, AL/ML and GenAI workloads

  • Experience writing data driven applications in Java or Python and familiarity with data access patterns in software

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sponsorship Information Officer - Area Program Sumba Barat Daya
description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Employee Contract Type:

Local - Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)

Job Description:

The Sponsorship Information Officer (SIO) is responsible to support the overall sponsorship operation service in one or cluster Area Program by administrating all activities related to the operation of sponsorship information system called HOPE and supporting development of tools for monitoring RC presence and wellbeing, to contribute to the achievement of CESP (Community Engagement and Sponsorship Planning) goals. The SIO will ensure the alignment with relevant strategies (national, regional, sponsorship), policies (ministry policies, sponsorship policy, DME management policy, Child Protection policy) and standards (LEAP, Sponsorship Standard & Programming Guidelines, financial). The SIO will work in close coordination with Field Facilitators and partners. The SIO may be supported by National Office Sectoral Team.

All staff are expected to contribute to Wahana Visi Indonesia’s core approaches—Transformational Development, Advocacy, and Emergency Response. During emergencies, this role may be required to support organizational readiness and response efforts, ensuring timely, coordinated, and accountable delivery of assistance in line with established systems and standards.

Strategy Development & Planning

  • Develop monitoring and evaluation plan and tools for monitoring RC presence, participation and basic welfare.
  • Do mapping existing child monitoring tools for in order to fit with the needs of field staff or partners.
  • formulate, test and revise RC monitoring and RC update data to capture RC updated data (e.g RC presence, RC & family participation, RC well being, etc) for sponsorship needs and program needs
  • Support PLA and FGD Baseline survey and assessment.
  • b. Provide inputs in the development of sponsorship business process in AP.
  • Analyse the existing sponsorship business process
  • Support the formulation, test and revision of sponsorship business process to fit AP context.

Resource Acquisition & Management

  • Provide inputs for the development of annual operating plan and budget - SOP on tools and equipments needed for operating Sponsorship Information System (SIS).
  • Install and effectively and efficiently use SIS hardware and software such as, internet connection, LAN, HOPE, printer and scanner.
  • Check, maintain SIS infrastructure regularly to ensure its proper function and acquire assistance if necessary.
  • Provide technical assistance for field team of Operating model partner in monitoring RC presence, participation and basic welfare

Capacity Building

  • Train project staff, operating model staffs and cadres on SIS (HOPE, DI photo, video, and project database) and basic sponsorship knowledge and skill.
  • Check the quality of DI
  • Produce, monitor and analyze indicators for RC presence (CMS), RC & family participation in development activities & RC well-being (e.g. education, health, birth certificate, etc).

Accountability & Quality Assurance:

  • Assist development of projects data base.
  • Technical tasks:
  • Process and input CH, CMS, Child Participation, Child and family support into HOPE
  • Data recociliation: Produce, analyze and report to SIP Coordinator RC turn over report.
  • System maintenance
  • Ensure the pending task is managed according to standard and take necessary action accordingly
  • Maintain dan review local database relevant to AP needs
  • Report problems relating to HOPE to NO in 24 hours.
  • Ensure the validity of data input into HOPE
  • Process adds, holds, drops, child death, reactivate, child annual update in single Step
  • • Sponsorship performance and RC data is appropriately updated into the system, maintained, documented and analyzed according to partnership standard.
  • Produce data for monthly GNOD report including to do list, to do summary, management report, progress of APR, CC/GC and CMS; and submit to SIP Coordinator on agreed date.
  • Produce overdue and current pending correspondence from HOPE regularly.

Networking & Coordination:

  • Manage effective relationships and networks with various development partners including Operating model partner as negotiated with Project Coordinator / AP Manager. Be responsible for maintaining and strengthening relationships with key partners.
  • Communicate effectively Wahana Visi Indonesia identity, mission, vision, values and our approach to work in ways that are contextually appropriate and clear.

Management & Leadership:

  • Contribute to a working environment of mutual trust, respect, and care among all staff.
  • Support SIP Coordinator and operating model partner to ensure project goals are met according to AP plan and Annual Operating Plan on time, on budget and with quality.

Required Professional Experience

  • A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as information technology, computer science, business administration, or a related discipline is often required.

  • Typically, a minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in data
    management, information systems, or a similar field is required.

  • Experience working in the context of community development, child sponsorship programs, or international NGOs may be preferred.

  • Experience with database management, data analysis, and reporting is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with child sponsorship programs and community engagement models.

  • Knowledge of monitoring and evaluation concepts and tools.

  • Willingness and ability to travel to project sites and communities as needed to support data collection, training, and system maintenance.

  • Proficiency in relevant software and tools, including Sponsorship Information System (SIS) software, may be required.

  • Any certifications related to data management, database administration, or relevant software tools can be a plus.

  • Excellent computer skills, including proficiency in database software, Microsoft Office Suite, and data analysis tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, as the role involves working with various stakeholders.

description:

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Medicine Partners job.

A Brief Overview
Under general supervision, operates as part of the care team performing a variety of functions such as greeting patients, patient registration, insurance coverage and eligibility verification, scheduling and telephone management.

The PSR I is an entry-level position with limited or no prior experience; under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team. Stanford Medicine Partners

Internal/External Vacancy Announcement
No. WFP/GHA/ACC/RAM/SEPTEMBER/2026
RAME ASSISTANT
Deadline for Application: 7 days from day of publication

The Office of the UN World Food Programme (WFP) Accra invites applications from suitable candidates to fill the vacancy below.
Job Title : RAME Assistant
Duration : 1 year (Renewable)
Post Grade : SC 5
Duty Station : Bolgatanga

JOB PURPOSE:
To coordinate and perform Research, Assessment, Monitoring and Evaluation activities and provide reports to support the effective delivery of assistance packages..

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Under the direct supervision of the Head of Sub-Office Bolgatanga and the technical supervision of the Head of Research, Assessment, Monitoring and Evaluation, the RAME Assistant will be responsible for the following duties.
1. Collect, clean, and preprocess large datasets related to food security
indicators, including nutrition, food systems and social protection.
2. Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, and
correlations within the data, with a focus on understanding the drivers of food insecurity and vulnerability, as it relates to assessment and monitoring from WFP’s and partner interventions in Ghana.
3. Develop and maintain data pipelines, workflows, and automation processes to streamline data acquisition, storage, and analysis, and ensure data integrity, quality, and security.
4. Ensure adherence to WFP policies regarding data and visualization,
including data privacy, security, management and documentation of
codes/syntaxes.
5. Create data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings
effectively to stakeholders, including government agencies, partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
6. Coordinate and conduct trainings for WFP and partner staff on key
indicators, questionnaires, and remote survey methods to facilitate the effective implementation of near real-time monitoring systems. Support in the design and implementation of ODK and Microsoft Forms survey tools for multiple projects, including validation checks, skip logic, and workflow optimization.
7. Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, and publications
documenting research findings, methodologies, and recommendations.
8. Document field data collection reports, focus group discussions, and
methodological details for surveys. Prepare field mission reports to document programme implementation.
9. Supported beneficiary targeting processes, including vulnerability ranking and eligibility analysis for project participants to ensure the most vulnerable persons receive equitable assistance.
10.Other duties as required.

Minimum Academic Qualifications
Completion of secondary school education. A post-secondary certificate in the related functional area.


Desired Experiences for entry into the role:
1.The candidate should have at least 5 years progressive work experience.
2. Has experience collecting programme output and outcome data, conducting quantitative and qualitative analyses, and reporting findings to management team, partners and other stakeholders.
3. Has experience utilizing WFP monitoring and evaluation systems and standard
4. Experience in statistical analysis STATA, SPSS, Excel
5. Knowledge in data visualization tools like Tableau; Excel; Power Bi is essential
6. Knowledge in questionnaire programming with the ODK

Language:
Fluency in both oral and written communication in the UN language in use at the duty station and in the duty station’s language, if different.

Applicants should submit their applications and CV stating 3 references online to: www1.wfp.org/careers/job.openings and follow the steps.

Qualified Female Candidates are encouraged to apply.

This is a hybrid role based out of Holmdel, NJ or Allentown, PA

Meet the Team

You will be part of a collaborative network working across Cisco Optics Operations, Engineering Design, and Operations teams. This role involves close engagement with Acacia, COG, and external vendors to define requirements, solve technical challenges, and improve manufacturability. You will also collaborate with contract manufacturers and supplier partners to develop automation capabilities and ensure smooth transfer of manufacturing solutions into stable production. The team is focused on advancing optical transceiver manufacturing with an emphasis on automation and scalability.

Your Impact

As a technical process lead, you will drive the automation and scalability of optical transceiver manufacturing. You will own the design of processes and automation for critical manufacturing equipment, focusing on active alignment and fiber attach methods. Your responsibilities include setting process and automation strategies, driving design-for-manufacturing and design-for-cost initiatives, refining manufacturing processes for scale, and identifying and deploying equipment for advanced optics manufacturing (CPO/NPO). You will support the transfer of processes from NPI to production, ensuring sustainable and repeatable operations. Your work will directly impact manufacturing readiness for volume and next-generation optical product development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant experience in process engineering for optics, opto-electronics, or semiconductor packaging with a focus on equipment design, including hands-on NPI and transfer to production.

  • Experience with fiber attach and optical alignment systems, including automated optical assembly process development and qualification (DOE, SPC, PFMEA, capability studies).

  • BS/MS in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Optics/Photonics, Materials, Physics, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience defining, evaluating, and qualifying capital equipment working directly with suppliers and/or contract manufacturers.

  • Clear technical communication and problem-solving skills, including design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and manufacturing cost modeling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on machine design skills using Solidworks, Autocad, or equivalent software.

  • Proven ability to develop automated manufacturing solutions that improve repeatability, efficiency, and scale.

  • Knowledge of machining and tool manufacturing methods with a strong background in tolerance analysis.

  • Exposure to next-generation optics manufacturing concepts, including CPO/NPO or related advanced process development.

  • Experience using AI or digital tools for manufacturing analysis, process monitoring, or operational decision-making.

  • Experience in cross-functional execution, aligning teams for manufacturability, cost, and delivery performance decisions.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Investment Banking Associate/VP, Biopharma Advisory
description:
Job Title: Investment Banking Associate / Vice President – M&A

Department: Investment Banking

Location: New York

Salary Range: $175,000 - $250,000

The M&A Sr. Associate or Jr. Vice President will be a key member of an experienced team, contributing to a world-class investment banking practice focused on healthcare and life science companies, with broad and deep contacts within the biopharma and specialty pharmaceuticals industries. The successful candidate will participate in all aspects of originating, structuring and executing sell-side and buy-side M&A transactions. This position offers the successful candidate consistent execution experience, significant responsibility, and opportunity for advancement. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in an M&A role on a leading investment banking team.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the execution and support the origination of M&A transactions including public and private sell-sides, buy-sides, etc.
  • Oversee the building and maintenance of complex financial/valuation models, including long range company forecasts, DCF analyses, accretion/dilution analyses and other valuation analyses.
  • Develop client relationships through deal execution and pitches as well as communicate and partner with other internal investment banking professionals.
  • Work with the Biopharma and Spec Pharma coverage teams on idea generation and material preparation for meetings with clients to discuss potential sell-side or buy-side transactions.


Experience and Qualifications Required:

  • Healthcare Investment Banking preferred; Minimum of 4 years in investment banking with significant exposure to M&A.
  • Strong technical skills including advanced financial modeling, financial analysis and understanding of valuation concepts.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills including business writing and presentation skills.
  • Exemplary academic record: finance and life sciences undergraduate experience preferred but not required, MBA/CFA a plus.
  • Highly motivated, energetic, personable, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a dynamic, meritocratic work environment.
  • Regulatory qualifications (Series 79, 63,) to work in the financial industry within investment banking; individuals not certified will be required to undertake examinations within 3 months of joining the Firm.

About Us

Leerink Partners is a leading investment bank providing a complete suite of financial solutions comprising M&A advisory, equity, debt, and derivative capital markets, equity research, and sales and trading capabilities. The firm’s strategic focus on the healthcare industry empowers it to provide unique advice and insights to its clients. The firm is a broker-dealer registered with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission and a member of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Leerink Partners is an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to expanding its commitments and investments to create a more diverse, equitable and inclusive company culture and innovation ecosystem. We are strongly committed to the values and policy of equal employment opportunity across our employment practices.

Actual starting base pay will be determined on skills, experience, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other perks, as outlined in any formal offer made.
