title: Technician, Customer and Network Facing
description:
Our culture lifts you up—there is no ego in the way. Our common purpose? We all want to win for our customers. We aim to always be evolving, dynamic, and ambitious. We believe in the power of genuine connections. Each employee is a part of what makes us unique on the market: agile and dedicated.

Time Type:

Regular

Job Description :

About Our Company

Breezeline is a dynamic, innovative company providing the very best Internet, TV, and Voice service to the US markets we serve. We are ‘Above And Beyonders’, who consistently strive to surprise and delight our customers by doing the unexpected. We continually look for new and better ways to enrich our customers’ lives through connected and memorable experiences.

As the eighth-largest cable operator in the United States, Breezeline reaches more than 1.7 million homes and businesses in 13 states with Internet, TV, Voice and fiber services. Headquartered in Quincy, MA, Breezeline is a subsidiary of Cogeco Communications Inc. (TSX:CCA).

Why Work At Breezeline?

As one of the country’s fast-growing Internet service providers, Breezeline offers our colleagues a vibrant workplace culture and excellent career opportunities. As a proudly diverse and inclusive organization, we believe that every person’s unique individuality should be welcomed and celebrated, and their abilities and potential should be honored and recognized. It is a key part of our culture to actively promote opportunities internally to ensure that you are never static in your career with us.

Internal Values – How we act

We’re proud that Breezeline is unlike any other employer in the industry. We work hard, but we never lose sight of the big picture. We understand that our colleagues are looking for more than just a great job – they want an extraordinary life – and at Breezeline, we want to make that a reality.

And here is how we do it.

Fun: We laugh a lot. It makes every day brighter, and if you don’t love what you do, you’re not doing it right.

Job flexibility: We think everything you do matters – at work and home.

Discounted services: We offer our customers some fantastic services, and we think you deserve to enjoy them in your home, too.

Total Rewards: Let’s be honest, everyone wants to make a good salary. We offer attractive total rewards and a great culture to go along with it. We’ve got you and your family covered with one of the best packages in the business.

Career evolution: At Breezeline, you get more than just a job. You get all the tools you need to learn, grow, and achieve your career goals!

Cutting-edge technology: Do you have a passion for technology? Great, we do, too. At Breezeline, you will get the opportunity to manage, influence, play, create, fix, and re-shape the industry.

Summary

Under general supervision, the Customer and Network Facing Technician is a universal technician that is responsible for performing field installation and service work, troubleshooting, repair and maintenance of cable television, internet, and telephony systems. This role supports the growth of the system by ensuring the quality performance of technical services, installation setup, testing, and maintenance of all current and future products and services over Hybrid Fiber Coax (HFC) and Fiber to the Home (FTTH) networks. The incumbent ensures the quality of services provided to end-users meets or exceeds established industry and company performance standards and complies with FCC requirements and protocol.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, disconnect, and troubleshoot television, high-speed internet, telephony, and automation systems for residential and business clients.

  • Performs preventative maintenance and repair of the HFC and FTTH networks, including all associated equipment, in accordance with company engineering standards.

  • Read and accurately interpret system/network design maps.

  • Install and replace HFC physical plant network components such as coax, actives, passives, grounding systems, pedestals, riser guards, conduit, etc., according to technical specifications.

  • Identify and repair upstream and downstream ingress.

  • Complete end-of-line network testing to meet technical specifications.

  • Regularly test all HFC network components using test equipment including: signal level meters, volt-ohm meters, leakage detector, Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR), and Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR).

  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot, and update records of standby power supplies according to technical specifications.

  • Troubleshoot and repair basic distribution problems associated with RF, AC, and DC elements of the forward and reverse plant.

  • Restore system service outages.

  • Perform CLI rideouts and monitor and repair signal leakages.

  • Maintain tools and equipment inventory.

  • Accurately complete work orders in a timely manner.

  • Maintain, secure, and stock assigned vehicle and equipment.

  • Ensure productivity is being tracked through company applications (e.g., NRBY, WFX, Stratusync, iGlass).

  • Work alongside Headend personnel to properly OTDR any damaged fiber.

  • Properly assist on projects such as Remote Phy, 5-85 Mhz, Node activation, E2E testing on new properties, etc.

  • Prepare for daily work assignments by requisitioning equipment and supplies from the warehouse and stocking the vehicle as needed.

  • Maintain company truck and other equipment per service requirements and safety guidelines.

  • Drive a company vehicle between office/home, warehouse, and work sites in a safe and courteous manner, and in accordance with all laws and company policies.

  • Communicate with dispatch (via WFX, phone, etc.) for assistance, status on current installs, or new service requests.

  • Consult with supervisor and other technicians for advice and assistance as needed.

  • Interact with customers in a professional, courteous manner, including when responding to escalations and repeated customer concerns.

  • Educate customers regarding their existing and new services and promote other company services.

  • Comply with all safety procedures and policies.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Integrity: Tactful, maintains confidence, fosters an ethical work environment, prevents inappropriate behaviors by coworkers.

  • Initiative: Brings about great results from ordinary circumstances; prepares for problems or opportunities in advance; transforms leads or ideas into productive business outcomes; undertakes additional responsibilities and responds to situations as they arise without supervision.

  • Planning, Prioritizing, and Goal Setting: Prepares for emerging customer needs; manages multiple projects; determines project urgency; uses goals to guide actions and creates detailed action plans.

  • Communication: Clearly conveys information through a variety of media (verbal, written, e-mail, v-mail, etc.) in a way that engages the audience and helps them understand and remember the message; listens well.

  • Self-Development and Continuous Learning: Stays informed of current industry trends; actively identifies opportunities for learning; learns and applies new concepts to improve job performance; shares information with others on the job; takes responsibility for career development.

  • Customer Focus: Demonstrates a high level of service delivery; does what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; addresses and resolves service failures; prioritizes customer needs; makes customers and their needs a primary focus of actions.

  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Recognizes others’ perspective, objectives and motives; works collaboratively towards solutions that benefit all involved parties and help accomplish common Cogeco objectives.

  • Attention to Detail: Alert in high intensity/high-risk environments; follows detailed procedures and ensures accuracy in documentation and data; carefully monitors gauges, instruments, or processes; concentrates on routine work detail and organizes and maintains a system of records.

  • Adaptability: Works with little supervision; manages ambiguity and autonomy; flexibility to work in an unstructured environment; deals effectively with uncertainty and change.

Qualifications

Minimum

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Core Technician skillsets.

Compiles data for documentation of test procedures and may assist with report preparation.

A Quality Assurance Associate at performs In-process, Final Inspection and Final Approval of Product :

  • Checks PM logbooks on manufacturing equipment for completeness and accuracy.

title: Director of Annual Giving
description:
Thank you for your interest in working at William Paterson University.

William Paterson University is a purpose-driven, proudly diverse community—designated as both a public Hispanic-Serving Institution and Minority-Serving Institution—committed to creating transformative academic, professional, and personal experiences as a powerhouse of progress. We foster a workplace that values growth, flexibility, and community, and we are recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Forbes’ Best Employers by State, 2025 Great College to Work For, and honored with the NJBIZ Empowering Women Award.

Our 1,000 dedicated staff members enjoy competitive benefits, a four-day summer workweek, tuition support, and strong opportunities for internal promotion. Situated on a scenic suburban campus just 20 miles from New York City, WP offers a diverse, inclusive environment where your contributions fuel student success, economic and social mobility, and community engagement. Together, we empower our students through intentional, holistic support within flexible, innovative, and inclusive settings—preparing graduates to thrive professionally and personally, and to lead with a commitment to progress in New Jersey and beyond.

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Assistant VP of Alumni Engagement and Philanthropy, the Director of Annual Giving is responsible for providing overall leadership and management of the Annual Giving program and staff. In this role, the Director is responsible for designing and implementing multi-faceted strategies in collaboration that meet short and long-term philanthropic goals of the University.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Designs and implements Annual Giving strategies and programs, in order to support the achievement of agreed-upon fundraising goals and objectives including: identification, cultivation, solicitation, stewardship and recognition; projecting annual giving revenue at the high/low levels, and monitoring and adjusting those projections, wherever necessary, throughout the fiscal year.
  • Ensures gift counting, campaign reporting, and annual giving metrics comply with CASE (Council for Advancement and Support of Education) standards and sector best practices.
  • Analyzes annual giving data, donor trends, and campaign performance (retention, acquisition, upgrade/downgrade, and channel-level ROI) using pivot tables and other data analysis tools to inform strategy; builds and maintains reports and dashboards to track progress against fundraising goals and present findings to leadership.
  • Manages and oversees the execution of traditional, current and emerging appeal channels (direct mail, email, digital/social media, text-to-give, and crowdfunding) to ensure the department achieves philanthropic and engagement goals.
  • Manages a prospect portfolio encompassing the Tri-State region; secure gift at the annual fund and Annual Fund leadership level to meet personal fundraising goals.
  • Maintains a schedule of personal visits and engagement activity that yield revenue and increase the University’s base of support.
  • Works closely with the major gift officers to maximize donor pipeline potential and coordinate timing of appropriate annual fund communication and solicitations to support major gift moves management and solicitations.
  • Hires, trains, develops, mentors, disciplines, supervises and evaluates Annual Fund staff (two direct reports) in accordance with University policies and state regulations.
  • Collaborates with the Alumni Engagement team and University staff campus-wide to partner and build engagement and Annual Giving solicitation strategies that encourage alumni involvement and increase annual alumni giving.
  • Manages Annual Giving department budget allocation.
  • Negotiates contracts with annual giving third party vendors.
  • Serves on University committees as needed.
  • Performs other duties as assigned that are appropriate for the position.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.

  • Five (5) years of experience in fundraising, strategic planning/implementation, and functional operations, including experience analyzing fundraising and donor data to identify giving trends.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

  • Excellent networking, interpersonal and presentation skills.

  • Demonstrated experience analyzing fundraising and donor data, including building reports and pivot tables to track giving trends, donor retention/attrition, and campaign performance.

  • Knowledge of CASE (Council for Advancement and Support of Education) standards and best practices for gift counting, campaign reporting, and annual giving benchmarking; CASE credential or active CASE/AFP professional development strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate collaboration while working as a part of the Advancement team.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of products, including advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, and data visualization) for analyzing fundraising and giving trends, social media platforms; Almabase; experience with Banner or a comparable fundraising CRM/database (e.g., Raiser's Edge) for querying and reporting preferred.

  • Driver’s license valid in New Jersey for travel throughout the tri-state area.

Evaluates project performance, identifies areas for improvement, and implements corrective actions.

Position Summary:

  • This position is responsible for the daily care of flocks in growing houses by performing all essential duties. Other duties may be assigned.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare houses for bird placement by installing metal & wire partitions to form accurate sized pens for bird placement as instructed, setup feed system, and safely operate truck/trailer to transfer birds from FCR to Growout and place in assigned pens (15%)
  • Provide daily care of flock by properly calculating and recording feed amounts using calculator to determine # of pounds per pen, using hopper scale to weigh proper # of pounds per pen, distributing feed into feed hoppers by carrying buckets, monitoring flock for signs of injury/illness/slow growth and placing in recovery pen or euthanizing according to animal welfare policy, and collecting, recording wing band, and disposing of flock mortality, and administer and record medications via the water system as directed by management (30%)
  • Maintains flock environment by flushing water lines weekly by turning flush valve, maintaining pen bedding to animal welfare standards, using handheld electric blower to clear dust from equipment (fans, inlets, etc.) once a week, and verifying feed/water/environmental control systems working properly and report any issues for correction (15%)
  • Collect data regarding bird growth and development by analyzing fleshing (breast size) and sorting as needed, using digital scales to obtain average weight of each pen by weighing 60 females/30 males weekly, collecting weekly lab samples by using boot swabs for environment and cleft pallet swabs for birds, and assisting with euthanasia of birds designated by FCR out list as instructed by manager (30%)

Other duties, responsibilities, and activities:

  • Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. Such as: maintain vehicle by checking fluid levels, filters, tire pressure, and clean/disinfect to remove debris, operate a high pressure and regular water hose, maintains foot pans and hand sanitizer, maintains a clean and organized work/break area. (10%)

Biosecurity/Animal Welfare Requirements:

  • The jobsite is a biosecure environment which requires showering, changing clothing and footwear before entering the facility. Appropriate clothing and footwear are provided by the Company. No jewelry may be worn on the jobsite except for medical ID jewelry and body piercings covered by appropriate clothing. Must be willing to sign an agreement to avoid any avian species (chickens, ducks, birds, etc.). Must be willing to sign and abide by the Company Biosecurity and Company Animal Welfare Guidelines.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Physical: Must use safe lifting techniques. Must regularly lift and carry feed weighing up to 30 pounds and will occasionally be required to lift and carry bundles of shavings weighing up to 12 pounds. Will occasionally be required to pull/push 500 to 1000 pounds (wheeled carts). While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand majority of shift (concrete floor); walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; balance; climb ladder; stoop/bend; talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth perception; and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Tools and Equipment: Must be able to use hand tools such as pitchfork, broom, hammer, chain breaker, pliers, screwdrivers, come-a-long, wire cutters; safe operation of vehicle to and from work area
  • Environment: Required to work in dimly lit area on wet, slippery surfaces and in hot, dry, dusty, wet, and cold environments.
  • Personal Protective Equipment Required: Safety goggles and/or glasses, face shield, chemical gloves, waterproof apron, and rubber boots are required when handling disinfectants. Must wear company provided facial covering. Ear plugs may be used as needed. NIOSH approved N95 particulate respirators may be worn as needed.
  • Chemicals Commonly Used: Disinfectants, cleaners, lubricants, spray foam, vehicle fluids.
  • Safety: Team member is expected to follow all applicable safety policies and procedures. These include but are not limited to Hazard Communication, Respiratory Protection, LOTO and Personal Protective Equipment. Team member is expected to identify, address and mitigate safety related risks.

Ramp Agents at Southwest work outside to guide planes, move bags and cargo, help with de-icing planes during cold weather, and help keep our operation running smoothly. Whether you're an aviation pro or just starting to learn about the industry, you’ll gain valuable experience and learn new things in this role — all while helping Southwest run safely and on schedule. title: Automotive Product Specialist
description:
Considering a career with Ken Garff Automotive Group means you are in for a great ride (excuse the car metaphor)! We’re not your standard dealership or group of dealerships and we are pretty darn proud of that. We are out to do things differently and want to consistently change, grow, and progress. For that reason, our employees are proud of where they work!

Aloha Kia Kona, a Ken Garff Automotive Dealership, is currently looking for a Salesperson that aligns with our core values and acts with respect, integrity, growth, humility and teamwork.

It’s your passion for helping others and natural ability at building great relationships that makes you successful in sales. You are a naturally persuasive individual able to motivate others and you prefer fast-paced work and lots of customer interaction. These work activities and environments energize you! Because you’re good at handling details quickly, correctly, and efficiently, you manage multiple customer relationships and their respective needs exceptionally well.

Looking for:

  • Friendly and cooperative demeanor; quick to connect and build relationships with others

  • Easygoing, uninhibited, and comfortable working with others

  • Persuasive with a strong drive for results

  • Tolerant of uncertainty

  • Prior experience in sales or customer service preferred

  • Must be 18 years or older and be authorized to work in the U.S with a valid in-state driver's license and a good driving record, per company standards

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Why you’ll love working with us:

  • No Experience Necessary! WE WILL TRAIN YOU to be a Sales Professional.

  • Competitive compensation package and 401k with company match

  • Average: $2,500-$9,000/monthly = monthly draw - commissions/bonuses/incentives - $3,000 monthly guarantee for 90 days *** w/ top making 6 figures***

  • Wellness Time Off, plus holidays, plus a Personal Purpose Day

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability Insurance, AD&D and Life Insurance

  • EAP, Wellness Plan, Mental Health Support, Diabetes Management Program, and Parental Leave Stipend

  • Year-end bonus program for ALL employees (Garff Giveback)

  • Employee discounts on vehicle purchase, parts, service and more!

***The pay scale above is the compensation range that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, specific skills, relevant work experience, relevant education and/or training, and performance related bonuses and incentives.

What you’ll do as a Salesperson:

  • Enthusiastically lead customers through their sales journey

  • Professionally represent the dealership and maintain high customer satisfaction via frequent and friendly follow-up

  • Respond to and communicate with potential prospects (web lead, phone lead, store lead)

  • Frequent training to develop sales skills and product knowledge

At first glance, there’s nothing remarkable at Ken Garff. Our uniforms aren’t flashy, and our buildings look a lot like the competition. You may not see it right at first, but if you listen, you’ll hear. Because listening isn’t just something we do; it’s part of who we are. It’s how we show that what we absolutely value the most (far more than buildings, uniforms or cars) is our people. And we thrive on treating them right. We listen because we believe listening matters. We’re just different that way.

Will you join us as a new Salesperson? Will you throw your energy and focus behind what we’re doing? Will you live our values and do things differently than you’ve ever done them? Will you listen and build trust and foster relationships? This organization, that started as an idea by a man named Ken Garff way back in 1932, needs one thing to keep its vision intact and its purpose of reinventing an industry moving forward. It needs you.

title: Web Application Architect
description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Bridge Specialty Group is seeking a Web Application Architect to join our growing team in Plano, TX.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Web Application Architect to join the Bridge Specialty Group IT organization. Reporting to the Head of IT Architecture, this role will lead the architecture, modernization, and governance of highly interactive, transactional web applications used by customers, brokers, underwriters, operational teams, and business partners.

The Web Application Architect will define modern front-end and full-stack application patterns, guide UI/UX design and implementation, and shape secure integrations between web experiences, enterprise backend services, and third-party applications. This role will work closely with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, Application Development teams, Enterprise Architecture, Data Architecture, Integration teams, Security, and Cloud Platform teams to deliver intuitive, accessible, scalable, resilient, and maintainable digital solutions.

How You Will Contribute:

Web Application Architecture & Digital Experience

  • Collaborate with the Head of IT Architecture and Enterprise Architecture teams to define web application architecture standards, reference designs, and technology roadmaps.

  • Establish architectural patterns for highly interactive, workflow-driven, and transactional web applications.

  • Define standards for front-end frameworks, application composition, state management, browser compatibility, responsive behavior, API consumption, performance, and maintainability.

  • Conduct architecture and technical design reviews to ensure solutions align with enterprise, security, cloud, and integration standards.

  • Guide to modernization of legacy web and non-web applications through refactoring, re-platforming, decomposition, and incremental user experience improvements.

  • Lead architecture decisions for customer-facing, partner-facing, and internal web applications.

  • Define component-based front-end architectures using modern JavaScript and TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or comparable technologies.

  • Establish reusable component libraries, design systems, coding standards, and front-end engineering practices.

  • Define approaches for routing, state management, caching, error handling, feature configuration, internationalization, and browser-side security.

  • Architect applications supporting complex, high-volume, and multi-step business transactions.

UI/UX Design & User Experience

  • Partner with Product Owners, and business stakeholders to translate user needs and business workflows into intuitive digital experiences.

  • Provide architectural guidance for interaction design, information architecture, navigation, responsive layouts, and consistent visual behavior.

  • Promote user-centered design, accessibility, usability, mobile-first design, and inclusive design practices.

  • Support creation and governance of design systems, prototypes, wireframes, and reusable interaction patterns using tools such as Figma or comparable platforms.

  • Use user feedback, analytics, and usability findings to guide continuous improvement of digital experiences.

Transactional & Workflow Application Design

  • Design reliable application flows for submissions, quoting, servicing, approvals, document handling, workflow tasks, and other insurance business processes.

  • Define patterns for validation, session and state management, transaction integrity, concurrency, idempotency, error recovery, auditability, and long-running workflows.

  • Ensure transactional applications meet requirements for performance, scalability, resiliency, data protection, and operational support.

Application Integration & API Architecture

  • Design backend services and integration patterns that support modern web applications and user experiences.

  • Define API-first and Backend-for-Frontend patterns for efficient, secure, and experience-specific access to enterprise services.

  • Architect integrations with third-party applications, carrier and vendor platforms, embedded user interfaces, hosted experiences, widgets, iframes, software development kits, and external APIs.

  • Define patterns for REST APIs, GraphQL where appropriate, webhooks, event-driven integration, messaging, workflow orchestration, and asynchronous processing.

  • Address identity propagation, authorization, data transformation, error handling, observability, versioning, rate limits, availability, and failure isolation across external integrations.

  • Collaborate with integration and platform teams on Azure API Management, messaging, and shared service patterns.

Cloud-Native Application Design & Security

  • Architect secure and scalable web applications deployed on approved cloud platforms, with Microsoft Azure as the primary platform and AWS experience considered beneficial.

  • Define patterns for static web hosting, content delivery networks, edge routing, web application firewalls, application services, containers, serverless services, and caching.

  • Guide performance engineering for page load time, rendering, API latency, payload optimization, caching, scalability, and availability.

  • Ensure applications include appropriate telemetry, distributed tracing, logging, alerting, and user-experience monitoring.

  • Apply secure-by-design principles across browser, application, API, and integration layers.

  • Define authentication, authorization, session management, single sign-on, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect patterns.

  • Partner with Security teams to address OWASP risks, dependency vulnerabilities, secrets management, secure coding, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure sensitive information is protected throughout user interactions, backend processing, and third-party integrations.

Delivery Enablement & Technical Leadership

  • Work directly with UX/UI, front-end, backend, integration, quality assurance, and DevOps teams to guide solution design and resolve architectural challenges.

  • Review user experience designs, architecture diagrams, technical designs, API contracts, prototypes, and implementation approaches for quality and alignment.

  • Mentor architects, technical leads, engineers, and designers in modern web applications, UI/UX, security, integration, and performance practices.

  • Facilitate clear communication between technical teams, product teams, business stakeholders, and third-party partners.

  • Serve as the web application architecture subject matter expert for strategic digital initiatives.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Stay informed on emerging trends in web architecture, front-end engineering, UI/UX, accessibility, cloud platforms, digital experience, and integration technologies.

  • Evaluate frameworks, tools, design practices, and platform capabilities based on business value, technical fit, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement in digital application design and delivery.

  • Actively contribute to architecture and engineering communities of practice within Brown & Brown.

  • Additional responsibilities consistent with the role objectives may be added as needed to support the profit center.

Skills & Experience to Be Successful:
Required

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • [8] + years of progressive experience in software engineering, including [4] + years in web application architecture, solution architecture, or senior full-stack engineering roles.

  • Strong experience designing highly interactive, responsive, accessible, and transactional web applications.

  • Deep knowledge of modern front-end architecture using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and frameworks such as React or Angular.

  • Experience defining component libraries, design systems, state management patterns, automated testing approaches, and front-end engineering standards.

  • Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles, user-centered design, interaction design, responsive design, usability, and accessibility.

  • Experience designing backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and Backend-for-Frontend solutions.

  • Experience integrating web applications with third-party platforms, embedded experiences, SaaS products, vendor APIs, webhooks, and external identity providers.

  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, single sign-on, browser security, API security, and OWASP risks.

  • Experience designing for application performance, scalability, reliability, observability, transaction integrity, and failure recovery.

  • Strong technical leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or related discipline.

  • Experience in the insurance or financial services industry.

  • Experience designing customer, broker, agent, partner, or employee self-service portals.

  • Hands-on familiarity with Figma, design systems, prototyping tools, Storybook, or comparable UI/UX platforms.

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Front Door, Azure API Management, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.

  • Exposure to AWS services supporting web and transactional applications.

  • Experience with content delivery networks, web application firewalls, caching, real-user monitoring, and digital analytics.

  • Experience integrating acquired businesses, third-party applications, carrier platforms, or vendor-hosted user experiences.

  • Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and Agile product delivery.

title: Software Developer Embedded Systems II (Full Time) – Canada
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Applications are accepted until further notice.

Meet the Team

Our dedicated team members are building the future of Cisco’s core networking platforms, operating systems, and intelligent embedded infrastructure, powering global connectivity. You will join engineering teams focused on developing high-performance routing and switching architectures, low-latency telemetry, and hardware-software integration within business groups such as Cisco Networking, Security & Trust, and Supply Chain. As part of this collaborative environment, you will contribute to the evolution of next-generation distributed platforms and mission-critical network systems. Explore the opportunities at the intersection of embedded software, networking protocols, and silicon systems, helping to transform how Cisco delivers resilient, high-speed digital experiences worldwide.

Your Impact

As an Embedded Systems Software Developer, you will take ownership of designing, implementing, and optimizing critical software components across Cisco’s next-generation networking platforms. You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, technical leaders, and architecture groups to solve complex architectural challenges, drive system scalability, and ensure high platform availability. Lead technical initiatives by mentoring emerging talent, contributing to architectural decisions, and applying modern software engineering best practices to improve development velocity and quality. Success in this role means establishing strong technical influence, driving resilient system-level innovations, and delivering solutions that underpin global digital communications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in one of the following:

-A Master’s degree program with 0 years of work experience;

-An undergraduate degree program (Associate's or Bachelor's) with 2 years of work experience;

-An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 2 years of work experience.

  • Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Expected to continue enrollment in a degree or qualifying educational or workforce development program following completion of the internship.

  • Strong proficiency in C and C++ systems programming, with demonstrated expertise in multi-threading, concurrency, memory optimization, and asynchronous architectures.

  • In-depth understanding of operating systems internals (kernel/user space boundaries, process scheduling, virtual memory, IPC) and enterprise/SP networking protocols (L2/L3, TCP/IP, routing).

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing, debugging, and profiling software in Linux environments using tools such as GDB, Valgrind, and Git.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Linux kernel development, embedded device drivers, RTOS, or high-throughput packet processing frameworks (e.g., DPDK, XDP).

  • Knowledge of advanced routing and switching protocols (BGP, IS-IS, Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN) or low-latency telemetry architectures.

  • Proficiency in Python or Bash for developing automated testing frameworks and integrating with CI/CD infrastructure (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Exposure to hardware/software interfaces (PCIe, I2C, SPI), FPGA/ASIC acceleration, or secure boot and embedded vulnerability mitigation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

Provides continuity, management, oversight, and direction of the Work Control and Outage organizations including responsibility for managing the performance of the Outage Manager and the Work Control Manager.

Direct the online work execution process. Identify process problems and implement corrective actions to address those problems in a timely manner.

Participate in various senior management committees and forums (e.g., Trek to Excellence, ITPRC, Plant Health Committee, Senior Site ALARA Committee, etc.)

Direct refueling outage preparation, planning, and scheduling while ensuring the status of these activities is accurately communicated to the management team.

Ensure consistent and effective work force practices through assigned supervisors and functions.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do

We are looking for an astute, determined professional like you to fulfill an Investment Analyst role within our Agency Lending business. You will assist our clients in obtaining financing for their multifamily projects through the lending programs of Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and FHA. You will showcase your success through collaboration, ownership and innovation. Your expertise in emerging trends and practices will evoke stimulating discussions around optimization and change to help keep our competitive edge. This rewarding opportunity will enable you to make a big impact in our organization, so if this sounds exciting, then PGIM might be the place.

  • Perform Excel-based financial modeling and analysis.
  • Exposure to entire loan process from originations to closing.
  • Interact professionally both internally and externally with senior management, originators, deal managers, borrowers, brokers, and correspondents.
  • Provide superior analytical support to senior members of the team on a variety of ad-hoc assignments and long-term projects.
  • The Real Estate Investment Analyst position is typically a three-year assignment. Based on business needs, strong performance and mutual agreement, one one-year extensions may occur.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate business, real estate, or related program. A concentration/major in Finance and/or Real Estate is preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Strong quantitative skills and demonstrated analytical ability.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication skills both verbally and in writing.
  • Outstanding attention to detail.
  • Can-do, proactive attitude.

  • 1-3 years of prior experience in FHA, Fannie Mae and/or Freddie Mac multifamily lending and/or multifamily real estate including appraisals, equity, development, or other mortgage loan programs is preferred.

With $207.9 billion in gross assets under management and administration ($133.8 billion net),1 PGIM Real Estate provides investors and borrowers access to a range of real estate equity, real estate debt, agriculture, and impact solutions across the risk-return spectrum.

title: Zelfstandig Werkend Kok
description:
About the role:

Bij Landal Landgoed De Elsgraven werk je als kok op een kleinschalig vakantiepark midden in het Twentse groen. Gasten komen hier voor rust, natuur en tijd met elkaar. Na een dag op pad, een fietstocht door de omgeving of een activiteit op het park, schuiven zij aan bij Restaurant De Elsgraven voor een lekkere lunch, diner of buffet. Jij zorgt ervoor dat ook het eten onderdeel wordt van een fijne vakantiebeleving.

Je werkt in een klein en gezellig team, waar je veel samen doet en tegelijkertijd zelfstandig je werkzaamheden oppakt. Daarbij heb je een groot voordeel ten opzichte van veel horecabanen: het restaurant sluit om 20.00 uur. Je werkt dus geen lange nachtdiensten en hebt regelmatig een heel weekend vrij.

What will you do:

In de keuken van De Elsgraven zorg je samen met je collega’s voor de dagelijkse bereiding van onze gerechten. Omdat we met een klein team werken, is je rol lekker afwisselend. Je weet wat er moet gebeuren, pakt zelfstandig je werkzaamheden op en helpt je collega’s wanneer dat nodig is.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het controleren en verwerken van binnenkomende goederen
  • Het voorbereiden en bereiden van gerechten
  • Het verzorgen van ontbijt, lunch en diner
  • Het bereiden van buffetten voor partijen
  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, smaak en presentatie

This is you:

Je hebt al ervaring als kok in een professionele keuken en weet wat er nodig is om zelfstandig mee te draaien. Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen, maar je hebt wel een goede basis en plezier in het vak. Samenwerken gaat je goed af en in een klein team pak je gemakkelijk verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat we belangrijk vinden:
- Ervaring als kok in een professionele keuken
- Enthousiasme en passie voor koken
- Zelfstandig kunnen werken en goed kunnen samenwerken
- Oog voor kwaliteit, hygiëne en een nette werkplek
- Flexibiliteit om ook in weekenden en op feestdagen te werken
- Kennis van HACCP is mooi meegenomen, maar kun je ook via ons behalen

Come work with us, as this is what we offer!

Samen zetten we alles op alles om onze gasten en onze collega’s het beste te bieden. Word jij onze nieuw collega, dan komt dit met alleen maar voordelen, zoals:

  • Een fulltime of parttime (uur per week) contract binnen de recreatie cao
  • Een salaris tussen €2.639 en €3.215 bruto per maand*
  • 25 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime werkweek*
  • Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per km
  • Deelname aan het pensioenfonds Recreatie
  • Diverse collectieve verzekeringen
  • Gratis reis- en annuleringsverzekering voor jou en je gezin.
  • Een gunstige personeelsboekingsregeling
  • Gratis gebruik maken van onze parkfaciliteiten


Een fulltime dienstverband kent een 38-urige werkweek, wat gelijk staat aan een werkweek van 5 dagen. Indien je een parttime dienstverband hebt, worden jouw salaris en vakantiedagen naar rato berekend.

title: Mechanical Design Engineers/Drafters
description:
Job Description:

Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc. (AMA) of Hampton, VA is actively seeking a several candidates with either Mechanical Engineer, Mechanical Designer or Mechanical Drafter experience in spaceflight hardware. The qualified candidates will provide technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems surrounding the modeling, analysis, manufacture, and testing of flight project components and mechanisms to be utilized for both research and spaceflight. This position will support the Research, Science and Engineering Services (RSES) contract onsite at NASA Langley Research Center in Hampton, VA.

The salary range for these positions is $90,000 to $124,000, commensurate with education and experience.

US citizenship or Permanent Residency is required.

These roles are contingent upon being awarded the work.

Job Descriptions:

Mechanical Engineer:


The qualified candidates will be responsible for the development and review of CAD models and drawings, effective communication of said designs, work with structural analysts and program management to iterate on designs, guiding the components through the manufacturing process, and overseeing the assembly, integration, and testing of designed systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate CAD design models and engineering drawings of components to be used on spaceflight hardware

  • Perform analytical sizing activities on designed hardware

  • Develop reports, presentations and other documentation

  • Generate assembly/integration and test procedures

  • Knowledge of acceptance standards for spaceflight hardware applications

  • Attend meetings and teleconferences and be ready to discuss issues seen in design, analysis, qualification and acceptance plans and reports

  • Guide developed hardware through the manufacturing process

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and with a minimum of 5 years of experience; or a Master's degree and 1 year of experience.

  • Experience with Parametric CAD software for component design and initial sizing.

  • Demonstrated experience in hardware design, analysis, and testing.

  • Ability to work independently under general direction only.

  • Candidates must possess strong written and oral communication skills

  • US citizenship or Permanent Residence.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience with Creo Parametric is highly desired.

  • Expertise in component and mechanism design, analysis, and testing in the aerospace industry.

Mechanical Designer:

Designs and develops mechanical systems, assemblies, and packaging layouts for spacecraft, nuclear power, propulsion, and support hardware. Uses CAD tools to create 3D models, conduct design trade studies, prepare engineering drawings, and ensure designs meet requirements for mass, volume, thermal performance, manufacturability, structural integrity, and spaceflight environments. Collaborates closely with engineers, analysts, and fabrication teams to mature concepts from preliminary design through integration and test.

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Design Technology, or related field. Proficient in Creo/Windchill.

Mechanical Drafter:

Produces and maintains detailed engineering drawings, CAD models, schematics, bills of material, and configuration-controlled documentation. Converts engineering concepts and design changes into accurate fabrication and assembly drawings, ensuring compliance with NASA drafting standards, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and configuration management requirements. Works with designers and engineers to support manufacturing, inspection, integration, and testing activities.

Associate's degree or technical certificate in Mechanical Drafting, CAD/CADD Technology, Engineering Graphics, or related field. Proficient in Creo/Windchill.


Analytical Mechanics Associates (AMA) is proud of our customer relationships, our diverse and dynamic work environment, and our employees' career satisfaction. AMA is a small business with a wide reach; headquartered in Hampton, VA, AMA has operations in Greenbelt, MD; Huntsville, AL; Dallas and Houston, TX; Denver, CO; Mountain View, CA; and Edwards Air Force Base, CA. With over 60 years of experience, AMA specializes in aerospace engineering, science, analytics, information technology, and visualization solutions. AMA combines the best of engineering, science, and mathematics capabilities with the latest in information technologies, visualization, and multimedia to build creative solutions. We offer competitive salaries and a substantial benefits package, including but not limited to paid personal and federally recognized holiday leave, salary deferrals into a 401(k)-matching plan with immediate vesting, tuition reimbursement, short/long term disability plans, and a variety of medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

AMA is committed to the professional growth of every employee, understanding that the successes of our employees drive our success. We provide a work environment that is engaging, collaborative, and supportive. To learn more about our company, please visit our website at and follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn.


AMA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic prohibited under federal, state, or local laws.

title: Associate Engineer, Production
description:
Venture Global LNG (“Venture Global”) is a long-term, low-cost provider of American-produced liquefied natural gas. The company’s Louisiana-based export projects service the global demand for North American natural gas and support the long-term development of clean and reliable North American energy supplies. Using reliable, proven technology in an innovative plant design configuration, Venture Global’s modular, mid-scale plant design will replace traditional designs as it allows for the same efficiency and operational reliability at significantly lower capital cost.

We are seeking qualified applicants for the position:

Associate Engineer, Production

Located:

Cameron

Summary

We are seeking an Associate Production Engineer to join our team in Cameron, LA with travel as needed.

This role will report to the Manager of Production Engineering and will be responsible for developing and progressing the Ready for Operations (RFO) schedule to transition the facility from EPC to the operations phase.

Post transition, the role will be responsible for closely working with key interface stakeholders to ensure that the safe and sustainable realization of facility production targets and other critical KPI’s are met.

General Description Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support the development and maintenance of:
    • a facility production forecasting model
    • mass and energy balance models
  • Support the development and maintenance of tools:
    • to support production, environmental and compliance reporting
    • to monitor production performance summaries and Key Performance Indicators for each processing Train
    • for monitoring and ordering catalysts, chemicals and consumables needed to manage the facility
  • Support the development and maintenance of loss accounting summaries to allow for identification and categorization of facility production losses
  • Support the development of production engineering standards and procedures
  • Coordinate with maintenance, gas supply, commercial operations and finance on facility operations and reporting
  • Provide day to day troubleshooting support to operations
  • Set CP Facility LNG Trains Production daily targets, define operating limits and engage with Operations, Maintenance and Engineering to develop the Production Plan for the day.
  • Build and maintain Real time, online, surveillance and monitoring models to optimize the Availability and Performance of the CP Facility LNG Liquefaction Trains
  • Perform Analysis to detect deviations from Live Operating Envelope Limits and identify the actions required to safely and reliably maximize LNG rundown.
  • Identify short-, medium- and long-term Availability and Reliability improvement initiatives to maximize LNG rundown using insights from Real time System and Physics-based/data-driven models.
  • Identify Production risks that could impact Availability and Reliability and develop mitigation plans to address them
  • Provide input to the weekly and monthly Production reviews and follow up on any actions required to improve the performance of the CP Facility LNG Trains
  • Identify the CP Facility LNG Trains production loss events and engage with the relevant stakeholders (including but not limited to Engineering, Maintenance, Operations) to review, validate, report and manage production losses in a timely manner to maximize Availability and Reliability
  • Lead or be part of EIRs (Engineering Investigation Requests) and MoCs (Management of Change) required to improve the CP Facility LNG Trains performance.
  • Lead or be part of the CP Facility LNG Trains Production loss RCAs when required.
  • Gather the required assumptions on LNG Trains performance and provide timely input to the Forecast and Annual Delivery Plan process.
  • Support the Long-Term Service Agreement (LTSA) process and provide all the required input and analysis as required
  • Support the development of Integrated Production Excellence standards and procedures.
  • Capture Lessons Learned from the CP Facility and provide input to other Venture Global LNG projects / sites as required

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Process/Chemical or Petroleum Engineering.
  • One (1) to four (4) years’ experience working as an Engineer in a process plant environment would be a plus.
  • Engineering graduates with a demonstrable passion to pursue a career in this discipline would also be considered.
  • Oil and Gas experience is required, with preference in LNG applications, however, petrochemical, NGL, cryogenic natural gas processing, or other hydrocarbon processing experience may be acceptable

Venture Global LNG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Electrical Engineering New Graduate | Rochester, NY
description:
Electrical Engineering New Graduate | Rochester, NY

100% Employee-Owned | Big-firm resources, local-team relationships, ONE IMEG culture

IMEG is hiring an Electrical Engineering New Graduate in Rochester, NY. This entry-level role offers hands-on design, analysis, and project execution experience, with mentorship, training, and opportunities to grow your expertise from day one. You will work closely with experienced engineers and consultants to support electrical systems design for buildings and help deliver positive client outcomes.

In this role, you'll support project execution by assisting with planning, documentation, technical analysis, and coordination across multidisciplinary teams while working within project budgets and client expectations. You'll contribute to education and government projects with a team that is especially strong in renovation, technical-space, and infrastructure-refresh work, advancing high-performance, energy-efficient design aligned with MEP2050 and AIA2030.

Location: Rochester, NY

Bldg 5,6,15,17, Government (City/County/State); and SUNY - Potsdam / Potsdam, NY / SUNY Potsdam Maxcy Hall Ceilings, Education.

Job Description:
This job is responsible for analyzing supply, demand, inventories, and prices in global oil and gas markets. Key responsibilities include monitoring and working with macro and micro statistical data linked to energy to build models that can help forecast prices for a broad array of energy related commodities, developing narratives connected to the analysis, providing trading ideas, and communicating recommendations to institutional clients. Job expectations include prior industry knowledge and providing judgment based on research findings to team members.

The candidate will:

  • Contribute to regular publications by researching key issues on energy/commodity markets.
  • Contribute to our commodities price forecasting effort through econometric modelling of commodity markets.
  • Interact with a broad array of internal sales and trading desks, as well as with external corporate and investor clients.
  • Monitor and analyze ongoing developments in the commodity markets.

Qualifications/skills

  • Three to five years of experience at an investment bank, institutional investor, or energy trading house
  • Postgraduate degree in economics, econometrics, statistics, or finance (MA/PhD), with an excellent academic record.
  • Strong quantitative skills, coupled with sound knowledge of applied econometric techniques and the ability to work with large datasets.
  • Thorough knowledge of microeconomics, financial economics and financial derivatives, with a special focus on price theory.
  • Some background in macroeconomics, particularly business cycle theory, and financial portfolio theory would be an advantage.
  • Strong interest in commodity and financial markets are a must.
  • Advanced software skills in both MS Office and one or more applied statistical packages (EViews, STATA).
  • Very good presentation skills, able to present thoughts clearly and succinctly.
  • Fluent in English. Command of other languages would be an advantage, but not essential.
  • Teamwork-oriented, able to work under pressure.
  • Excellent writing skills.

title: Senior Financial Planner
description:
At Midland States Bank, base salary is one component of our Total Rewards program. Exact compensation is determined by factors such as (but not limited to) education, skills, internal equity, and experience. This position offers additional compensation in the form of short-term incentives (i.e. bonus and/or commission) and may include long-term incentives (i.e. stock awards). Benefits for this role include comprehensive healthcare, well-being benefits, paid family leave as well as generous paid time off. Total Rewards also include banking perks, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, 401K plan with company match and may include the opportunity to participate in our Non-Qualified Deferred Compensation plan. Incentives and benefits are subject to eligibility requirements.


Senior Financial Planner

Salary Range: $106,250 - $141,650

Position Summary

The Senior Financial Planner serves as a technical planning expert, partnering with Wealth Advisors, Trust Officers, and other relationship managers to develop comprehensive financial plans for high-net-worth clients and prospects. This role gathers and analyzes client financial information, develops customized planning recommendations, and presents strategies that address retirement, tax, estate, insurance, cash flow, education, and legacy planning objectives.

The Senior Financial Planner utilizes both eMoney and MoneyGuide to model sophisticated planning scenarios and deliver actionable recommendations that strengthen client relationships and support new business development. The Senior Financial Planner serves as a thought leader in financial planning by identifying emerging planning strategies, industry trends, and best practices, helping advisors and clients capitalize on sophisticated planning opportunities that enhance the firm’s value proposition. Additionally, the Senior Financial Planner is expected to champion the Midland brand, engage in community events, and lead partnerships across all lines of business. This position is an individual contributor role.

Primary Accountabilities

Planning Responsibilities

  • Develop comprehensive financial plans utilizing both eMoney and MoneyGuide software.

  • Analyze complex financial situations involving retirement, tax, estate, insurance, cash flow, education, executive compensation, charitable giving, and business succession planning.

  • Prepare customized planning recommendations aligned with each client’s goals and objectives.

  • Evaluate multiple planning scenarios and clearly communicate recommendations to advisors and clients.

  • Recommend innovative planning strategies that address complex client needs while supporting the continued evolution of the firm's financial planning capabilities.

  • Continuously monitor and update financial plans as client circumstances evolve.

Advisor Partnership

  • Partner with Wealth Advisors, Trust Officers, and other relationship managers to identify planning opportunities.

  • Participate in client meetings to explain planning strategies and answer technical questions. Serve as the technical planning resource for Wealth Management.

  • Assist advisors in converting planning opportunities into new client relationships and expanded services.

  • Serve as a consultative planning partner by proactively identifying opportunities to deepen client relationships through advanced planning strategies and cross-line-of-business collaboration.

Technical Expertise

  • Research changes in tax law, retirement regulations, estate planning, financial planning best practices, and emerging Wealth Management trends.

  • Identify sophisticated planning concepts and industry innovations that create new opportunities for clients and the Wealth Management division.

  • Develop planning resources, best practices, and educational materials for advisors.

  • Share planning insights with advisors and business partners through presentations, training sessions, and internal communications.

Other

  • Represents the Bank in community organizations and activities to enhance the Bank’s image.

  • Occasional travel for training and team meetings, and willingness to travel periodically to locations within market as needed.

  • May require work in a Midland office to ensure collaboration and support of internal and external customers.

  • Maintain compliance with all applicable regulations including, but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA).

  • Other duties as assigned.

Position Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Financial Planning, Business, Accounting or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 7-10+ years comprehensive financial planning experience supporting high-net-worth clients.

  • Demonstrated experience developing sophisticated financial plans involving retirement, tax, estate, insurance, and wealth transfer strategies.

  • Demonstrated ability to stay current on emerging financial planning strategies, regulatory developments, and industry trends, and translate those insights into practical client and advisor solutions.

  • Experience working collaboratively with Wealth Advisors, Trust Officers, attorneys, and CPAs.

  • CFP (Certified Financial Planner) designation preferred.

  • Advanced proficiency with eMoney and/or MoneyGuide Pro.

  • FINRA Series 65 (or ability to obtain within 12 months)

  • State Life, Health, and Annuity license (or ability to obtain within 12 months)

  • Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Strong organization and time management skills.

  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

​​Competencies:

​

  • ​Business insight

  • ​Cultivates innovation

  • ​Drives results

  • ​Makes sound decisions

  • ​Being a brand champion

  • ​Collaborates

  • ​Communicates effectively

  • ​Customer focus

  • ​Being Authentic

  • ​Emotional Intelligence

  • ​Self development

  • ​Being flexible and adaptable

title: 2027 Accelerated Development Program - BrainBox AI
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

On-Site (5 days)

Ce que vous y gagnez:

Faites partie de notre mission! En tant que chef de file mondial dans la création d’environnements confortables, durables et efficaces, il est de notre responsabilité de mettre la planète au premier plan. Chez Trane Technologies, la durabilité n’est pas seulement notre façon de faire des affaires — c’est notre raison d’être. Avez-vous l’audace de regarder les défis du monde et d’y voir des possibilités porteuses d’impact? Voulez-vous contribuer à bâtir un avenir meilleur? Si la réponse est oui, nous vous invitons à envisager de vous joindre à nous pour repousser avec audace les limites du possible pour un monde durable.

Épanouissez-vous au travail et à la maison:

· Les avantages sociaux commencent dès le PREMIER JOUR pour vous et votre famille, y compris l’assurance maladie et des programmes de mieux-être holistiques comprenant de généreux incitatifs – NOUS OSONS PRENDRE SOIN!

· Les avantages liés à la fondation d’une famille comprennent la couverture des traitements de fertilité ainsi que l’aide à l’adoption et à la gestation pour autrui.

· Contribution de contrepartie au 401K jusqu’à 6 %, plus une contribution de base additionnelle de 2 % = jusqu’à 8 % de contribution de l’entreprise.

· Congés payés, y compris pour répondre aux besoins de bénévolat et de congé parental.

· Possibilités d’éducation et de formation par l’entremise des programmes de l’entreprise, ainsi qu’une aide aux frais de scolarité et un soutien pour la dette étudiante.

· Apprenez-en davantage sur nos avantages sociaux ici!

Ce que vous ferez:

Programme de développement accéléré – IA et analytique Canada

Les programmes de développement accéléré (ADP) de Trane Technologies offrent aux personnes récemment diplômées de l’université des affectations stimulantes, une formation en leadership et une exposition précieuse aux hauts dirigeants de notre entreprise. Grâce à des rotations et à des expériences dans plusieurs emplacements géographiques et secteurs d’activité, vous pourrez développer des compétences diversifiées et une base solide pour une carrière réussie et enrichissante chez Trane Technologies. Ces affectations sont choisies stratégiquement afin d’assurer votre apprentissage continu et votre développement personnel.

L’expérience en IA et analytique comprendra des rotations comportant une exigence de présence sur site. Les emplacements sont déterminés selon les besoins de l’entreprise. Une présence physique à votre lieu de travail assigné est requise 5 jours par semaine.

Notre programme de développement accéléré en IA et analytique au Canada comprend les rotations suivantes:

· Introduction à l’IA et à l’analytique (12 mois, axée sur les données, la technologie et/ou l’apprentissage automatique) au laboratoire d’IA BrainBox AI Trane Technologies à Montréal, Québec

· IA et analytique appliquées (9 mois, axée sur l’application de l’IA aux occasions d’affaires) chez Trane Technologies, Trane ou Thermo King, à Davidson, NC, ou Minneapolis, MN

· Solutions d’IA (9 mois, axée sur la conception et le déploiement de solutions d’IA pour les clients) au laboratoire d’IA BrainBox AI Trane Technologies à Montréal, Québec

Les participantes et participants au programme ADP développeront une base solide en exploration de données, analytique, science des données, apprentissage automatique, intelligence artificielle, ingénierie de solutions d’IA et déploiement de l’IA au cours du programme de 2,5 ans. Ils acquerront des compétences dans notre pile technologique, le développement de pipelines et la création de solutions d’IA afin d’aider nos entreprises et nos clients à optimiser l’efficacité et la performance. Les affectations sont choisies stratégiquement afin d’assurer un apprentissage continu et un développement personnel dans une variété de secteurs d’activité.

Le programme peut comprendre jusqu’à trois déménagements physiques. Une aide à la relocalisation est offerte pour les nouveaux lieux de travail lorsque la distance est d’au moins 50 miles.

Ce que vous apporterez:

Les responsabilités propres à la fonction varieront selon l’affectation. Une personne candidate retenue pour le programme de développement accéléré démontrera les éléments suivants:

· Baccalauréat en analytique ou dans un domaine connexe, comme l’informatique, le génie logiciel, la gestion des systèmes d’information, les statistiques, les mathématiques, l’analytique, la science des données ou un domaine similaire, avec une moyenne cumulative générale de 3,0 ou plus, complété avant la date d’entrée en fonction.

· Fort intérêt pour une carrière comme ingénieure ou ingénieur en IA, ingénieure ou ingénieur de données, analyste de données ou scientifique des données.

· Compétences démontrées en leadership: au moins deux exemples, comme dirigeante ou dirigeant d’un club scolaire, capitaine d’une équipe sportive, conseillère ou conseiller en résidence, etc., ou un leadership exceptionnel dans des projets de travail.

· Expérience de travail: au moins un stage lié au diplôme ou six mois d’expérience de travail connexe en IA

· Voit les problèmes comme des occasions et peut s’adapter rapidement à des circonstances d’affaires nouvelles ou changeantes.

· Cherche avec empressement et de manière proactive à acquérir de nouvelles informations, compétences et expériences, en tirant parti des occasions d’apprentissage.

· Travaille efficacement avec les autres pour coordonner les efforts et produire des résultats dans un environnement de travail positif.

· Motivation à mettre à profit les principaux apprentissages et expériences pour faire progresser votre propre carrière tout en contribuant à la croissance de Trane Technologies.

· Maîtrise des outils analytiques tels que: Python, R, SQL, Tableau ou d’autres logiciels de visualisation, ainsi que des outils infonuagiques comme BigQuery, Redshift.

· Capacité à comprendre les problèmes présentés par l’entreprise et à recommander la meilleure approche pour répondre aux besoins des clients internes.

· Demeurer flexible sur le plan géographique pendant et après la fin du programme.

· Être citoyenne ou citoyen canadien ou avoir le droit légal de travailler au Canada sans nécessiter de parrainage maintenant ou à l’avenir.

What’s in it for you:

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient environments, it’s our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world.

Thrive at work and at home:

· Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE!

· Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance.

· 401K match up to 6%, plus an additional 2% core contribution = up to 8% company contribution.

· Paid time off, including in support of volunteer and parental leave needs.

· Educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support.

· Learn more about our benefits here!

What you will do:

Accelerated Development Program – AI & Analytics Canada
Trane Technologies Accelerated Development Programs (ADPs) provide recent college graduates with challenging assignments, leadership training and valuable exposure to our company's senior leaders. Through rotations and experiences in multiple geographic and business locations, you will be able to build diverse skill sets and a strong foundation for a successful and fulfilling career with Trane Technologies. These assignments are strategically chosen to ensure your continuous learning and personal development.


AI & Analytics experience will have rotations that have onsite expectation. Locations are determined by the needs of the business. Physical presence at your assigned work location required 5 days per week.


Our Accelerated Development Program in AI & Analytics in Canada consists of these rotations:

· Intro to AI & Analytics (12 months, focused on data, technology, and/or machine learning) in the BrainBox AI Trane Technologies AI Lab in Montreal, Quebec

· Applied AI & Analytics (9 months, focused on applying AI to business opportunities) in Trane Technologies, Trane, or Thermo King, in Davidson, NC, or Minneapolis, MN

· AI Solutions (9 months, focused on building and deploying AI solutions for customers) in the BrainBox AI Trane Technologies AI Lab in Montreal, Quebec

ADP participants will develop a solid foundation in data exploration, analytics, data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, AI solutions engineering, and AI deployment over the course of the 2.5 year program. They will gain skills in our technology stack, pipeline development, and the creation of AI solutions to help our businesses and customers optimize efficiency and performance. Assignments are strategically chosen to ensure continuous learning and personal development in a range of businesses.

The program can include up to three physical moves. Relocation assistance is provided for new work locations where the distance is at least 50 miles.

What you will bring:

Function specific responsibilities will vary based on the assignment. A successful candidate for the Accelerated Development Program will exhibit the following:

· BS/BA in Analytics related field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management of Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science or similar with a cumulative overall GPA at or above 3.0, completed prior to start date.

· Strong interest in a career as an AI engineer, data engineer, data analyst, or data scientist.

· Demonstrated leadership skills: minimum of two examples such as school club officer, sports team captain, resident advisor, etc. or exceptional leadership of work projects.

· Work Experience: Minimum of one degree-related internship or six months of related AI-based work experience

· Views problems as opportunities and can adapt quickly to new or changing business circumstances.

· Eagerly and proactively seek new information, skills, and experiences, capitalizing on learning opportunities.

· Works effectively with others to coordinate efforts and produce results in a positive work environment.

· Motivated to leverage key learnings and experiences to grow your own career while contributing to the growth of Trane Technologies.

· Proficient in utilizing analytical tools such as : Python, R, SQL, Tableau, or other visualization software, cloud-based tools like BigQuery, Redshift.

· Ability to understand problems presented by the business, and to recommend the best approach to address the needs of internal customers.

· Remain geographically flexible both during and after completion of the program.
