title: PHYSIOTHERAPIST, REHABILITATION
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Physiotherapist is a licensed clinician responsible for providing an efficient, effective, and evidence-based physiotherapy service to both in-patients and out-patients. The primary objective is to maximize each patient's functional abilities through expert evaluation, coordination, and implementation of individualised treatment programs. The role requires adherence to internationally recognized standards of physiotherapy practice, ethical conduct, and active collaboration within the multidisciplinary healthcare team.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Main Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive and ongoing patient assessments to identify problems and needs, and develop appropriate treatment and discharge plans tailored to age, culture, support system, and clinical condition.
  • Provide high-quality physiotherapy interventions based on assessment findings and patient goals, ensuring continuity of care and maximising functional abilities.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely documentation of assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and billing in KCIS/EHR, and report significant findings to referring doctors.
  • Provide counselling, education, and home program guidance to patients, caregivers, and families to support self-management and continuity of care.
  • Work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary rehabilitation team, including occupational therapists, speech therapists, doctors, nurses, and rehab aides to ensure coordinated service delivery.
  • Support administrative functions such as service operations, scheduling, coordination of rehabilitation activities, and maintaining statistical data for KPIs and performance indicators.
  • Participate in staff orientation, supervision, coaching, and mentorship of junior therapists, interns, and rehabilitation assistants; monitor their performance and care delivery.
  • Engage actively in continuous professional development (CPD) via training, workshops, competency assessments, privileging processes, and evidence-based practice updates.
  • Ensure compliance with KPJ policies, MSQH/JCI/ISO standards, MOH regulations, PDPA requirements, and ethical principles in all clinical and administrative tasks.
  • Implement, adhere to, and monitor services SOPs for assessments, interventions, documentation, and quality assurance processes.
  • Ensure a safe, hygienic, and functional therapy environment in accordance with hospital safety, infection control, occupational safety and health standards, and emergency procedures.
  • Oversee, maintain, and ensure proper functioning of all physiotherapy equipment, including conducting inspections, reporting faults, managing inventory, and ensuring asset safekeeping.
  • Participate in quality and safety initiatives including incident reporting, Q-Radar compliance, RCA investigations, continuous quality improvement initiative projects, and promoting a patient-safety culture.
  • Serve as a patient advocate, ensuring that therapy services comply with legal, ethical, and institutional standards while maintaining professionalism and positive work culture.
  • Facilitate duties assigned by the Head of Service or hospital management in supporting marketing and service promotion activities.

Other Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform any other responsibilities as assigned by immediate superior or hospital management

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education:

  • Minimum Requirement
  • Diploma or Degree in Physiotherapy from a recognized institution.
  • Possession of a valid Practicing Certificate issued by the Malaysian Allied Health Professions Council (MAHPC) (or equivalent national body)
  • Preferred Qualifications and Experience
  • Degree in Physiotherapy.

Knowledge and Experiences:

  • Minimum Requirement
  • 2 years of clinical experience. (Nil minimum mentioned, but experience is preferred)
  • Preferred Qualifications and Experience
  • 5 years or more experience in a hospital, ambulatory care, or related setting.

Skills & Competencies:

Special skills required

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation abilities
  • Empathy and active listening in patient and staff interactions
  • Coaching and motivation for team empowerment
  • Cultural sensitivity and emotional intelligence
  • Collaborative leadership within multidisciplinary setting

Personal attributes

  • Compassionate, patient-centered, and ethical in practice
  • Adaptable and resilient under pressure
  • Accountable and responsible for outcomes
  • Proactive and solution-oriented
  • Professional integrity and confidentiality
  • Supportive team player with a positive attitude
  • Committed to continuous learning and service improvement

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Grow Your Career with GTT!

Join GTT to be part of a global mission to simply and securely connect people and data through innovative, AI-driven solutions. We empower curious, adaptive professionals to take ownership of their work, offering a culture where your ideas have a visible, real-world reach. If you are energized by complex challenges and a supportive team that lifts each other up, GTT is the place to build a rewarding career.

Join a team where your expertise will directly support the performance, stability, and security of critical business infrastructure.

We are looking for a Systems Engineer to take ownership of the administration, maintenance, and optimisation of our infrastructure environment. This is an opportunity to work across a varied technology stack, supporting both Windows and Linux platforms while ensuring high availability, operational efficiency, and system resilience. You will play a key role in troubleshooting complex technical issues, implementing improvements, and supporting the ongoing evolution of our infrastructure.

About the Role

As a Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of infrastructure platforms and supporting technologies. Working closely with internal teams and external vendors, you will help maintain secure, reliable, and scalable systems while contributing to infrastructure design and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and monitor Windows and Linux operating systems and supporting infrastructure.
  • Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, application software, and system management tools.
  • Ensure the highest levels of system and infrastructure availability through proactive monitoring and maintenance.
  • Monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and work with development teams to implement effective solutions.
  • Maintain security controls, backup solutions, and redundancy strategies, including NetBackup.
  • Develop and maintain scripts to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
  • Contribute to the design and enhancement of information and operational support systems.
  • Provide 2nd and 3rd line technical support for infrastructure-related issues.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal IT teams to resolve technical problems and improve service delivery.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

  • 3 years of network administration-level work experience.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows and Linux environments.
  • Solid experience administering EMC and major SAN solutions.
  • Experience with VMware/ESX administration and configuration.
  • Experience with virtualization and containerization technologies, including Docker.
  • Experience with monitoring tools including Zabbix and Nagios.
  • Experience with automation platforms such as SaltStack and Puppet.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure availability, performance monitoring, and systems administration best practices.
  • Currently hold or be able to attain SC/NPPV3 clearance.

Nice to have

  • Experience in Telecommunications, Technology, or complex B2B services environments.

Hours / Travel / Shift

Normal Office Hours. Remote with flexibility to travel as and when required for customer/team meetings.

Why Join GTT?

At GTT, you’ll join a global, collaborative culture built around ownership, customer focus and continuous learning.

  • Adaptive mindset: We meet change head-on to build the capabilities we need now. We take personal ownership of our professional development to keep pace with change and actively drive it.
  • Collective impact: We treat innovation as a team sport, working powerfully together to create extraordinary impact. We collaborate openly and with a shared purpose and amplify our unique human strengths to solve complex challenges that technology alone cannot.
  • Customer ownership: We own our customers’ success, whether an internal stakeholder or an external client. We take full accountability, anticipate their needs and create smooth experiences to build trust with every touchpoint. In an automated world, personal ownership is GTT’s competitive edge.

You’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact, grow your career and help shape how GTT delivers value to enterprise customers worldwide.

Job Description :

As one of the country’s fast-growing Internet service providers, Breezeline offers our colleagues a vibrant workplace culture and excellent career opportunities. As a proudly diverse and inclusive organization, we believe that every person’s unique individuality should be welcomed and celebrated, and their abilities and potential should be honored and recognized. We’re proud that Breezeline is unlike any other employer in the industry. We work hard, but we never lose sight of the big picture. We understand that our colleagues are looking for more than just a great job – they want an extraordinary life – and at Breezeline, we want to make that a reality.

And here is how we do it.

Fun: We laugh a lot. It makes every day brighter, and if you don’t love what you do, you’re not doing it right.

Job flexibility: We think everything you do matters – at work and home.

Discounted services: We offer our customers some fantastic services, and we think you deserve to enjoy them in your home, too.

Total Rewards: Let’s be honest, everyone wants to make a good salary. We offer attractive total rewards and a great culture to go along with it. We’ve got you and your family covered with one of the best packages in the business.

Career evolution: At Breezeline, you get more than just a job. You get all the tools you need to learn, grow, and achieve your career goals!

Cutting-edge technology: Do you have a passion for technology? Great, we do, too. At Breezeline, you will get the opportunity to manage, influence, play, create, fix, and re-shape the industry.

Summary

Under general supervision, the Customer and Network Facing Technician is a universal technician that is responsible for performing field installation and service work, troubleshooting, repair and maintenance of cable television, internet, and telephony systems. This role supports the growth of the system by ensuring the quality performance of technical services, installation setup, testing, and maintenance of all current and future products and services over Hybrid Fiber Coax (HFC) and Fiber to the Home (FTTH) networks. The incumbent ensures the quality of services provided to end-users meets or exceeds established industry and company performance standards and complies with FCC requirements and protocol.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, disconnect, and troubleshoot television, high-speed internet, telephony, and automation systems for residential and business clients.

  • Performs preventative maintenance and repair of the HFC and FTTH networks, including all associated equipment, in accordance with company engineering standards.

  • Read and accurately interpret system/network design maps.

  • Install and replace HFC physical plant network components such as coax, actives, passives, grounding systems, pedestals, riser guards, conduit, etc., according to technical specifications.

  • Identify and repair upstream and downstream ingress.

  • Complete end-of-line network testing to meet technical specifications.

  • Regularly test all HFC network components using test equipment including: signal level meters, volt-ohm meters, leakage detector, Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR), and Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR).

  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot, and update records of standby power supplies according to technical specifications.

  • Troubleshoot and repair basic distribution problems associated with RF, AC, and DC elements of the forward and reverse plant.

  • Restore system service outages.

  • Perform CLI rideouts and monitor and repair signal leakages.

  • Maintain tools and equipment inventory.

  • Accurately complete work orders in a timely manner.

  • Maintain, secure, and stock assigned vehicle and equipment.

  • Ensure productivity is being tracked through company applications (e.g., NRBY, WFX, Stratusync, iGlass).

  • Work alongside Headend personnel to properly OTDR any damaged fiber.

  • Properly assist on projects such as Remote Phy, 5-85 Mhz, Node activation, E2E testing on new properties, etc.

  • Prepare for daily work assignments by requisitioning equipment and supplies from the warehouse and stocking the vehicle as needed.

  • Maintain company truck and other equipment per service requirements and safety guidelines.

  • Drive a company vehicle between office/home, warehouse, and work sites in a safe and courteous manner, and in accordance with all laws and company policies.

  • Communicate with dispatch (via WFX, phone, etc.) for assistance, status on current installs, or new service requests.

  • Consult with supervisor and other technicians for advice and assistance as needed.

  • Interact with customers in a professional, courteous manner, including when responding to escalations and repeated customer concerns.

  • Educate customers regarding their existing and new services and promote other company services.

  • Comply with all safety procedures and policies.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Integrity: Tactful, maintains confidence, fosters an ethical work environment, prevents inappropriate behaviors by coworkers.

  • Initiative: Brings about great results from ordinary circumstances; prepares for problems or opportunities in advance; transforms leads or ideas into productive business outcomes; undertakes additional responsibilities and responds to situations as they arise without supervision.

  • Planning, Prioritizing, and Goal Setting: Prepares for emerging customer needs; manages multiple projects; determines project urgency; uses goals to guide actions and creates detailed action plans.

  • Communication: Clearly conveys information through a variety of media (verbal, written, e-mail, v-mail, etc.) in a way that engages the audience and helps them understand and remember the message; listens well.

  • Self-Development and Continuous Learning: Stays informed of current industry trends; actively identifies opportunities for learning; learns and applies new concepts to improve job performance; shares information with others on the job; takes responsibility for career development.

  • Customer Focus: Demonstrates a high level of service delivery; does what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; addresses and resolves service failures; prioritizes customer needs; makes customers and their needs a primary focus of actions.

  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Recognizes others’ perspective, objectives and motives; works collaboratively towards solutions that benefit all involved parties and help accomplish common Cogeco objectives.

  • Attention to Detail: Alert in high intensity/high-risk environments; follows detailed procedures and ensures accuracy in documentation and data; carefully monitors gauges, instruments, or processes; concentrates on routine work detail and organizes and maintains a system of records.

  • Adaptability: Works with little supervision; manages ambiguity and autonomy; flexibility to work in an unstructured environment; deals effectively with uncertainty and change.

Qualifications

Minimum

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Core Technician skillsets.

  • Valid state driver’s license and a good driving record within Company required standards.

  • Certifications and licenses, as required by state and municipal laws.

  • Successfully meet (and maintain) additional background check requirements for specialized projects/services.

  • Preferred 3 years or more of work experience in a comparable field (e.g., related hands-on trade role) or a one-year certificate from college or technical school; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum of one year of direct customer service experience.

  • PC and Windows software skills.

  • Able to work required shifts and overtime (if necessary), including regularly scheduled days as well as unscheduled days and beyond regular work hours (including on-call rotation) due to customer or operational demands.

  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

  • Communicates professionally and effectively with customers, vendors, and employees.

  • Ability to apply concepts of basic mathematics, algebra, and geometry.

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.

  • Ability to accurately measure distances, using tapes or other measuring devices.

  • Ability to adhere to Local, Federal regulations and Company policies.

  • Ability to carry, climb, and operate extension ladders up to and including 32’ high and up to 75 pounds.

  • Ability to Operate Aerial Lift Equipment rated with a 350lb maximum total load capacity.

  • Ability to differentiate between different sizes and colors of wires.

  • Ability to drive company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner.

  • Ability to make cable connections in tight spaces by bending, reaching, twisting.

  • Ability to operate appropriate computer or test equipment associated with position.

  • Ability to prioritize and organize effectively.

  • Ability to carry and use a variety of hand tools, power tools and equipment..

  • Ability to frequently bend, stoop, and crawl.

  • Requisite ability to drive commercial vehicle (DOT physical may be required).

  • Ability to lift an 88lb power supply from floor to 42”.

  • Occasionally sit and climb ladders/stairs; performs fine motor and pinching movements, and pivots with feet and bends, twists, and laterally flexes back & reaches at overhead shoulder, knee, and floor levels, stoops, squats, crouches, kneels, and crawls and press foot pedals.

  • Frequently stands and walks & pushes/pulls with arms and grasps with hands & reaches at waist.

  • Ability to climb ladders and/or utility poles and work in high places including roofs..

  • Ability to work in small / confined spaces (such as crawl spaces and attics) to tolerate typical residential and commercial controlled work environments as well as uncontrolled weather-related heat and cold for extended periods of time.

  • Ability to work outdoors and in extreme weather conditions and varying topographic, wet and dry locations.

  • Travel as business needs dictate.

Preferred

  • High school degree or GED equivalent preferred; post-high school education a plus.

  • Spanish proficiency is desirable in some locations.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; risk of electrical shock and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; fumes or airborne particles and extreme heat. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

description:
Job Description

Operations Summer 2027 Analyst Program

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

RBC Capital Markets is a premier investment bank that provides a focused set of products and services to corporations, institutional investors and governments around the world. With more than 7,100 professionals, we operate out of 70 offices in 15 countries across North America, the U.K., Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

We work with clients in over 100 countries around the globe to deliver the expertise and execution required to raise capital, access markets, mitigate risk and acquire or dispose of assets. According to Bloomberg and Dealogic, we are consistently ranked among the largest global investment banks.

RBC Capital Markets (RBCCM) is part of a leading provider of financial services, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC). Operating since 1869, RBC is one of the top 15 largest banks in the world and the fifth largest in North America, as measured by market capitalisation. With a strong capital base and consistent financial performance, RBC is among a small group of highly rated global banks.

Operations Summer 2027 Program

Internship opportunities exist within RBCCM for energetic, bright and talented undergraduate students. There are opportunities in a range of business support and product areas in Operations that suit the interests of driven and focused students looking for a career in Capital Markets.

While working and learning alongside our experienced technical professionals, Summer Interns are given various responsibilities relating to the many areas of support for the Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) within the Capital Markets division, as well as exposure to the products and services offered by the FCM.

The Operations Summer Program provides interns the opportunity to gain in-depth, hands-on experience while working and learning alongside our experienced professionals.

In selecting intern candidates, we look for well-rounded individuals with a track record of outstanding academic achievement, proven technical and analytical skills and a diversity of extracurricular activities. Other essential qualities we look for include strong oral and written communication skills, leadership qualities, initiative and the ability to play a key role as a team member in a fast-paced and challenging work environment.

Students will be provided with practical training, hands-on capital markets experience and career-building mentorship throughout the 10-week program.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Operations Summer Analysts have the opportunity to gain experience in one of the different areas of the Futures Commission Merchant working alongside experienced Operations professionals. Some of the areas that participate in the program: trading, clearing, client services, settlements, financial and regulatory reporting.

Summer Analysts obtain hands-on experience working alongside experienced business professionals, exposure to the different areas of capital markets and an understanding of RBC Capital Markets capabilities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

  • Bachelor’s Degree with a focus in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or related field
  • Graduating December 2027 or Spring 2028
  • Basic market knowledge and a demonstrated keen interest in the financial markets
  • Strong analytical and personal skills

description:

Job Summary

Responsibilities include but are not limited to; maintenance of electrical and instrumentation equipment and participation as a member of a plant staff that is effective in operating and maintaining a combined cycle facility in a safe manner.

Job Description

Electrical Maintenance

  • Understand the basic AC/DC circuit theory, power plant cycle theory, and mechanics.

  • Perform common testing of heat trace systems

  • At all times, demonstrate safe electrical work practices

  • Manage and work with vendors and contractors.

I&C Maintenance

  • Analyze and repair boiler and turbine control systems.

  • Assisting in calibrations, repair and maintenance of all instrumentation and control equipment at the site including the plant DCS.

  • Troubleshoot and repair control systems as required to maintain plant output.

  • Repair, replace, or modify instrumentation as required to maintain plant’s operating status.

  • Assist in designing new control loops to improve control of plant operations, or to correct control system problems

  • Assist with maintaining the plant CEMS equipment.

  • Document and maintain records of instrumentation and control history.

  • Maintain data acquisition systems and their database to ensure reliable information

  • Run computer diagnostic programs.

  • Manage and work with vendors and contractors.

Other Functions

  • Experience with 120V, 480V, 5KV, 21KV, 345KV systems, DC systems, switchgear, MCC’s, breakers, contactors, protective relays, etc.

  • Familiar with operation and maintenance of rotating equipment.

  • Capable of lifting objects with weight of up to 50 pounds.

POSS / MASS exams are administered on an as-needed basis by Human Resources and all communication concerning the testing is sent to the candidate's email address provided during the application process.

  • Worker must possess knowledge of High, Medium, and Low Voltage electrical systems,

title: Structural Test Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

Join the Global Manufacturing Operations team within Cisco’s Supply Chain. As a Senior Structural Test Engineer, you will serve as a key technical authority, leading complex test strategy for our global manufacturing footprint. Our team operates at the intersection of product develop and high-volume manufacturing, ensuring that our next-generation technologies meet the highest quality standards. We are looking for an experienced leader who values multi-functional teamwork, strategic planning, and the pursuit of technical excellence to drive the future of our manufacturing test infrastructure.

Your Impact

In this senior-level role, you will define the structural test roadmap that underpins Cisco’s global supply chain. You will be responsible for the architectural integrity of our In-Circuit Test (ICT) and Flying Probe operations, driving strategies that optimize test coverage, improve cycle times, and ensure process consistency at our partner sites. Your impact extends beyond daily manufacturing support; you will influence build decisions at the pre-layout stage, mentor internal test engineers, and lead large-scale project implementations. Your expertise will be the primary link between the Cisco ICT Central team and our global contract manufacturers, ensuring our manufacturing processes are scalable, automated, and aligned with corporate revenue and quality goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Governance: Act as the technical lead for manufacturing test processes, coordinating technical quality metrics, systemic defect resolution, and sustaining product integrity across multiple global sites.

  • Design Influence: Represent structural test in high-level design reviews, setting DfT standards and negotiating probe access and coverage requirements to reduce risk in NPI and production.

  • Operational Leadership: Direct the development and deployment of complex ICT and Flying Probe programs. Oversee the qualification and release of test fixtures and assets, ensuring zero-defect compliance.

  • Technical Authority: Perform senior-level code reviews and lead global change control processes (ECOs/deviations) for test program source code and manufacturing recipes.

  • System Optimization: Lead the integration of advanced On-Board Programming (OBP) strategies and boundary scan (JTAG) flows into the manufacturing line to improve efficiency and test depth.

  • Mentorship & Influence: Define and promote debug methodologies for manufacturing site test engineers; act as the lead interface between Cisco and external fixture/hardware vendors.

  • Process Scalability: Champion the adoption of automated workflows, version control standards, and statistical process control (SPC) to drive continuous improvement across the global manufacturing footprint.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 8+ years of professional experience in structural test development, debug, and release on industry-standard ICT platforms (e.g., Keysight i3070/Series 6 or TRI).

  • 5+ years of experience with Flying Probe system development (e.g., SPEA FP4080 or equivalent).

  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end manufacturing test requirements, including program development, fixture procurement, and factory floor correlation.

  • Proven experience leading technical projects or providing technical guidance to multi-functional teams or external manufacturing partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Extensive knowledge of DfT principles, including the ability to influence PCBA design and influence CAD/BU teams to adopt test-friendly architectures.

  • Advanced programming proficiency in Python, with a history of automating complex manufacturing test workflows.

  • Experience with advanced version control and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Git/GitLab) in a hardware testing environment.

  • Strong strategic attitude with a track record of influencing partners at various organizational levels to achieve business outcomes with minimal direction.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Title

Maintenance Tech B - 2nd Shift

Position Overview

About the Role: Shaw is hiring a Maintenance Technician B! The Maintenance Technician (Level B) is a skilled maintenance professional responsible for ensuring production equipment operates safely, reliably, and efficiently. In this mid-level role, you will focus on maintaining and sustaining critical machinery, minimizing downtime, and supporting consistent product quality. Working in a collaborative team environment, you will apply your technical expertise while continuing to develop advanced maintenance and troubleshooting skills.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Maintenance & Repair

  • Perform hands-on maintenance and repairs on a wide range of industrial equipment.
  • Maintain mechanical systems including bearings, shafts, pulleys, belts, chains, motors, and gearboxes.
  • Service conveyance systems, piping, and utilities (steam, air, water).
  • Maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems to ensure reliable operation and reduced downtime.

Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution

  • Diagnose and resolve equipment issues impacting safety, quality, and production efficiency.
  • Identify root causes of mechanical failures and understand related electrical interactions.
  • Execute repairs efficiently and communicate findings, corrective actions, and recommendations to maintenance and operations teams.

Preventive & Predictive Maintenance

  • Preventive Maintenance (PM): Perform scheduled inspections, measurements, lubrication, and component replacements.
  • Predictive Maintenance (PdM): Use condition-monitoring tools (infrared thermography, oil analysis, basic ultrasonics) to identify early signs of equipment failure.
  • Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM): Address issues identified through PM and PdM activities and contribute to refining maintenance job plans.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Complete work orders supporting plant initiatives, upgrades, and reliability improvements.
  • Assist with equipment installations, modifications, and process enhancements.
  • Contribute to initiatives that improve operational efficiency and equipment performance.

Team Collaboration & Development

  • Collaborate with maintenance and operations teams to ensure effective execution of work.
  • Mentor and support the development of entry-level technicians (Levels C & D).
  • Partner with senior technicians (Level A) on more complex tasks, installations, and overhauls.
  • Actively contribute to a culture of teamwork, learning, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Skills

Required Experience

  • Strong background in industrial or manufacturing maintenance.
  • Proven mechanical troubleshooting skills.

Safety Expertise

  • Comprehensive understanding of safety requirements, including:
    • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
    • Confined space entry
    • PPE usage
    • Hot work procedures
    • Powered industrial trucks (PIT)
    • Fall protection
    • Hoisting and rigging
  • Demonstrated commitment to maintaining a safe work environment.

Technical Skills

  • Proficient with hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring instruments.
  • Ability to select and properly use the right tools for each task.
  • Experience using CMMS or basic computer systems to document work and manage parts.

Blueprint & Schematic Interpretation

  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings.
  • Capable of creating simple sketches or notes to communicate maintenance work.

Analytical Ability

  • Strong problem-solving skills and mechanical aptitude.
  • Solid math skills, including measurements, conversions, and basic formulas used in maintenance work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Troubleshooting: Working knowledge of electrical systems to troubleshoot.
  • Schematics: Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Fabrication Skills: Welding, machining, or equipment modification experience.
  • Advanced Predictive Maintenance: Experience with vibration analysis or advanced diagnostic tools.
  • Leadership Experience: Experience mentoring technicians or leading small-scale maintenance efforts.
  • 3 years of experience in Maintenance.

title: Site Superintendent
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Virtual

Trane Technologies has an exciting opportunity to join our Life Science Solutions team as a Site Superintendent. The Site Superintendent is responsible for assisting the Project Manager to assure that the projects are completed and maintain the standard of excellence established by the company and customer. The Site Supervisor primary role is to oversee the field activities of an Engineered Solutions contracting project. These activities include the technical onboarding of subcontractors, guidance of field work, and ongoing progress communication with the contracting team.

They will work closely with the Project Manager to manage and direct our subcontractors, ensuring work performed onsite fulfills the scope of the contract. They will also partner with Field Service Engineers and Remote Support Specialists identifying and rectifying project shortcomings, to ensure we exceed our customers’ quality standards. Certain tasks will be assigned by the Project Manager to take the lead on with little oversight. Along with working with the Project Manager, this role may be given opportunity to execute selected projects including managing financials, administration, implementation, and customer satisfaction. The Project Superintendent will ensure that quality standards are maintained across all tasks and projects within the project schedule timeline.

Where is the work:

This is a virtual position.

What you will do:

  • Coordinates and oversees job site logistics, daily work activities, day - to - day customer interactions, and progress of all subcontractors.
  • Directs and organizes onsite construction crews (subcontractors) as necessary to meet project milestones and quality. Provide guidance and training Day 1 with installation crews, including installation playbook review, pictures, and quality expectations.
  • Maintain customer satisfaction by investigating concerns, implementing corrective action, and communicating with stakeholders.
  • Review drawings and understand scope and schedules (critical milestones) with the intent of providing feedback and any risks. This includes the scope of the installation contractors.
  • Troubleshoot problems and provide guidance on the corrective actions necessary to resolve technical issues.
  • Identify and correct installation deficiencies with installation contractor and contracting team, as needed. Document deficiencies in daily log, and provide to the Project Manager for potential mitigation.
  • Maintain safety standards onsite, through site safety plan execution.

title: Associate Sales Engineer – Security Solutions & Demo Engineering, Singapore
description:
Cisco Systems | Sales Engineering – Cybersecurity (ASEAN)

About the Team

Our Cybersecurity Sales Engineering team partners with sales, TAC, customer success, and our partner ecosystem to design and deliver Cisco's security architecture across the ASEAN territory — spanning Hybrid Mesh Firewall, Secure Access & Identity, AI Security, XDR, SASE, and Hypershield. We work directly with customers to uncover their toughest security challenges and translate them into solutions they can see, touch, and trust before they buy.

We're a small, close-knit team, and every person on it multiplies what the rest of us can do. This role exists to give the team more hands on the build side of the house — turning validated use cases and requirements into working, customized demos and proofs of concept, so our senior SEs can spend more time where their experience matters most: in front of customers, designing complex solutions.

Position Summary

We're looking for an Associate Sales Engineer to join our security SE team as a technical builder. You'll work alongside senior SEs and account teams to take discovered use cases and requirements and turn them into tailored demonstrations, proof-of-concept environments, and automated builds that bring a proposed solution to life for the customer.

This is not a scripted-demo role. You'll be given a set of requirements — sometimes well-defined, sometimes rough — and you'll need to figure out how to build, configure, script, or automate your way to a working environment that proves the value of the design. You'll increasingly use AI-assisted tools to accelerate that build process: generating code, configuring agents, automating repetitive setup work, and iterating on demo environments faster than a manual build would allow.

Over time, as you build fluency with our security portfolio, you'll take on more of the solution-design conversation itself — this role is a deliberate on-ramp into full-scope Sales Engineering, not a permanent behind-the-scenes function.

What You'll Do

  • Translate discovered customer use cases and requirements (handed off from senior SEs or account teams) into working, customized demo environments and proofs of concept

  • Build, configure, and script across Cisco's security portfolio — Hybrid Mesh Firewall, Secure Access & Identity, AI Security, XDR, SASE, and Hypershield — to represent real customer scenarios

  • Use AI-assisted development tools and agents to automate demo builds, environment setup, and repetitive configuration tasks, shortening the time from requirement to working proof of concept

  • Maintain, refresh, and troubleshoot demo/POC environments so they stay reliable and reusable across the team

  • Partner closely with senior Sales Engineers to understand the "why" behind a solution design, not just the "what" — and flag technical gaps or better-fit approaches as you find them

  • Document builds and configurations so environments can be handed off, reused, or extended by others on the team

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with TAC, customer success, and partners when a build surfaces a product gap, bug, or integration question

  • Take on a growing share of customer-facing work over time as your product and solution-design depth increases

Who You Are
Required:

  • A technical background — computer science, IT, engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience with 2-3 years of relevant work experience.

  • Comfortable with programmability: scripting (Python or similar), APIs, automation tools, infrastructure-as-code, or network/security device programmability

  • Practical experience using AI tools to design, build, or automate — coding assistants, agent frameworks, or AI-driven workflow automation — and a genuine interest in getting faster and better with them

  • Strong troubleshooting instincts and comfort working in ambiguous, not-fully-specified environments

  • Good communication skills — you'll need to translate technical decisions to both senior engineers and, eventually, customers

  • Curiosity about cybersecurity and a desire to grow into a customer-facing Sales Engineering role

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to networking or security fundamentals (firewalls, identity/access, SASE, XDR concepts)

  • Any Cisco, cloud, or security certification (or active pursuit of one)

  • Experience with virtualization/lab platforms (e.g., dCloud, VMs, containers) used for building demo environments

  • Prior internship, lab, or project experience building POCs, demos, or automation tooling

Why This Role

  • A structured path from technical builder into full Sales Engineering — you'll grow alongside senior SEs, not stay boxed into one lane

  • Direct exposure to Cisco's security portfolio and to how real deals get won, from requirements to demo to close

  • Latitude to bring AI-driven tooling into how the team builds — this role is as much about improving how we build demos as building them

  • A small team where your work is immediately visible and valued, across a fast-growing ASEAN cybersecurity territory

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

· This position is responsible for the handling of birds and equipment for selection process by performing all essential duties in rotation with others. Other duties may be assigned.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

· Setup equipment for selection process per instructions (15%)

· Select birds by performing the following duties: Isolate no more than 200 birds into catch frame for selection as many times as necessary until all birds are selected; catch birds per animal welfare standards; identify gender; verify line by observing wing band color; hold clean wing band under scanner for data entry; place bird in scale cone to obtain weight repeating multiple times until complete; monitor bird groups and “stir” to avoid crowding per animal welfare guidelines; place birds received from selector in designated location such as market pen, breeder candidate coop per gender, full dissect, leg dissect based upon characteristics as instructed by selector. If designated as market remove wing bands and mark head with colored food grade dye prior to placing in area designated for market birds multiple times until complete (60%)

· Euthanize off condition birds using the cervical dislocation method based upon animal welfare guidelines (10%)

Other duties, responsibilities, and activities:

· Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. (15%)

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

· Personal Protective Equipment Required: safety goggles and/or glasses, chemical gloves, waterproof apron, and rubber boots are required. Must wear company provided facial covering. Ear plugs, arm protectors, and NIOSH approved N95 particulate respirators may be worn as desired.

· Chemicals Commonly Used: Disinfectants, vehicle fluids, and lubricants.

Bionova is actively seeking a highly motivated Maintenance and Calibration Technician to join our Facilities and Engineering team. The role requires experience with CMMS systems, equipment maintenance and troubleshooting, and quality documentation in support of clinical and commercial manufacturing. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical aptitude with a disciplined approach to quality compliance, vendor coordination, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

Bionova Scientific – Fremont, CA

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Perform and support basic repairs, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and inspection of laboratory and manufacturing equipment and process instrumentation.
  • Perform and/or coordinate calibration of GMP and non-GMP instrumentation, including but not limited to the following parameters: temperature, pressure, humidity, flow, level, mass, pH, and conductivity devices.
  • Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot critical utilities and building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, gases, fire protection, and general facility infrastructure.
  • Coordinate with external vendors for maintenance, calibration, and repairs beyond internal capabilities, including obtaining quotes and processing POs for service, scheduling on-site visits, shipping equipment off-site, and reviewing vendor documentation for completeness and GMP compliance.
  • Document all maintenance- and calibration-related tasks in the CMMS, ensuring timely completion and audit readiness.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, QA, Lab Operations, and Engineering teams to meet business needs and equipment readiness timelines.
  • Support triage of on-demand Facilities and Engineering Work Requests and creation of Work Orders as necessary.
  • Actively participate in development and continuous improvement of Maintenance and Calibration infrastructure by developing Work Plans, Measurement Data Sheets and spare parts and inventory lists, and submitting change requests to maintain the accuracy of asset information in the CMMS.
  • Complete and review GMP-compliant records including work orders, calibration reverse traceability reports, and maintenance documentation. Support root cause analyses, investigations, change control actions, work instruction revisions, and CAPAs as required.
  • Monitor, respond to, troubleshoot, and appropriately escalate equipment, utility, laboratory, and facility alarms and abnormal conditions to maintain system reliability and operational readiness.
  • Interpret and work from technical drawings including P&IDs, wiring diagrams, and schematics. Redline and communicate gaps as necessary.
  • Maintain safe working conditions by following OSHA and internal safety procedures and wearing appropriate PPE.
  • Participate in after-hours support, site shutdowns, and emergency maintenance as required.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Associate degree, technical certificate, military technical training, trade school education, or equivalent experience in a scientific, technical, engineering, maintenance, or related discipline.
  • 1-4 years of experience supporting facility operations, maintenance, calibration, manufacturing equipment, laboratory equipment, or related technical systems.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience executing maintenance and calibration activities and using Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
  • Experience following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), reading equipment drawings (e.g. P&IDs, wiring diagrams), and working from technical specifications.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical systems used in laboratory, manufacturing, and facility equipment.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work and manage multiple assignments.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to accurate maintenance, calibration, and GMP documentation.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office or similar software and completing technical documentation.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience within the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.
    • Working knowledge of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and regulatory compliance requirements.
    • Experience using building automation systems, facility management software, or other computerized monitoring systems.
    • Experience coordinating with external service providers and reviewing maintenance and calibration documentation.
    • Experience using AI-assisted tools such as Microsoft Copilot to support maintenance troubleshooting, technical documentation, and problem solving.

Working Conditions:

This position is required to work in a GMP manufacturing facility, development laboratories, and office environment. The role requires walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing of ladders. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds independently.

title: Contract Clinical Diabetes Specialist - Ottawa/Kingston, Ontario
description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.


STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery.

But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at .

This is a contract/full time fixed term role in the territory of Ottawa/Kingston.

Directly responsible for the promotion and sale of Tandem Diabetes products and clinical services within an assigned territory. The Clinical Diabetes Sales Specialist is expected to plan and ensure achievement of sales goals through clinical education and acceptance of Tandem products’ insulin pump therapy. Uses clinical expertise to provide account sales support and continuing education in direct contact to people with diabetes (PWD), physicians and other health care professionals on the technical use of insulin pump therapy and special considerations related to pump therapy in the marketplace in order to generate sales. Promotes Tandem Diabetes products and services by providing additional education on topics such as diabetes self-management skills, emergency management and community resources as determined by client needs.

  • Establishes and maintains excellent professional relationships with health care professionals to support the sale of Tandem Diabetes products /services.
  • Conducts educational classes for customers providing diabetes education in relation to insulin pump therapy and other advance diabetes management skills in order to gain prospective and retain existing customers.

  • 1-year related industry experience preferred in one of the following areas: diabetes, endocrinology, dia
  • Excellent communication skills regarding diabetes self-management skills such as insulin pump therapy dose adjustment, proper use of blood glucose monitoring equipment, carbohydrate counting instruction, medication management, infusion site management, chronic complications, emergency management and community resources.

We leverage industry-standard tools for FPGA design, incorporating various quality metrics to ensure a robust process. Our ultimate goal is to deliver bug-free RTL for first-pass success on the board. Additionally, we collaborate closely with our remote teams based in US and Italy.

  • Design and implementation of FPGAs.
  • Participate in the architecture definition, implementation and verification phases.
  • Detailed design specification and test plan development.
  • Develop and implement block level RTL, perform synthesis and achieve timing closure.
  • Work with multi-functional teams (hardware, software, diagnostics and signal integrity groups).
  • Assist in complex subsystem level lab bring-up, integration, and unit test validation.
  • Contribution to the design process adoption with in the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Educational Background: Requires 15+ years of experience in FPGA designs with MTech/BTech in EE/EC domain.
  • Experienced in crafting with Xilinx, Altera and Microsemi FPGAs or Proficiency in HDL languages (Verilog, VHDL and System Verilog)
  • Hands on experience with FPGA vendor tools like Vivado, Quartus and Libero
  • Hands-on experience with Ethernet based protocols, PCIe, AXI, memory controllers, OTN, I2C, SPI, UART etc. Familiarity with simulation flow like UVM and VMM will be an added advantage.
  • Basic knowledge on Unix system and script tool.
  • Promote continuous improvement in design methodologies and processes
  • Lead and mentor junior design engineers, offer technical guidance, and drive successful project execution
  • Facilitates/encourages knowledge sharing in the team (e.g., brownbags, demos, design sessions).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge on the signal integrity and system bring-up.
  • Good English written and verbal communications. Self-motivation, partnership and strong interpersonal skills are needed.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Service Lot Tech

description:
Considering a career with Ken Garff Automotive Group means you are in for a great ride (excuse the car metaphor)! We’re not your standard dealership or group of dealerships and we are pretty darn proud of that. We are out to do things differently and want to consistently change, grow, and progress. For that reason, our employees are proud of where they work!

Volkswagen of Gilbert, a Ken Garff Automotive Dealership, is currently looking for a Service Lot Attendant that aligns with our core values and acts with respect, integrity, growth, humility and teamwork.

Looking for:

  • Highly precise work and highly accountable

At first glance, there’s nothing remarkable at Ken Garff. Our uniforms aren’t flashy, and our buildings look a lot like the competition. Will you join us as a new Service Lot Attendant (Valet)? Will you throw your energy and focus behind what we’re doing? Will you live our values and do things differently than you’ve ever done them? Will you listen and build trust and foster relationships? This organization, that started as an idea by a man named Ken Garff way back in 1932, needs one thing to keep its vision intact and its purpose of reinventing an industry moving forward. It needs you.

The successful candidate ensures solutions are reliable, observable, secure, compliant, and easy to evolve, while mentoring engineers, establishing best practices, and translating business objectives into scalable technical solutions.

  • Evaluate and implement modern technologies, including containerized services, Kubernetes/OpenShift, APIs, event streaming, databases, reporting platforms, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Partner with data and AI teams to deliver governed, explainable intelligence, digital assistants, semantic search, automated financial analysis, and analytics-driven insights.
  • Mentor engineering teams through design reviews, technical leadership, and continuous improvement initiatives to elevate engineering maturity.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience as a senior technical lead and architect in complex enterprise environments.
  • Proven ability to design and deliver distributed systems, microservices, APIs, batch processing, data pipelines, rules engines, workflow services, and enterprise integrations at scale.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern engineering stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, REST APIs, event streaming, SQL, Oracle or comparable relational databases, Redis or similar caching technologies, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-native engineering practices, containerization, Kubernetes or OpenShift, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability, resiliency patterns, and secure software delivery.

title: Network Security Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We’re the world’s leading provider of secure financial messaging services, headquartered in Belgium. We are the way the world moves value – across borders, through cities and overseas. No other organisation can address the scale, precision, pace and trust that this demands, and we’re proud to support the global economy.

We’re unique too. We were established to find a better way for the global financial community to move value – a reliable, safe and secure approach that the community can trust, completely. We’re always striving to be better and are constantly evolving in an ever-changing landscape, without undermining that trust. Five decades on, our vibrant community reflects the complexity and diversity of the financial ecosystem. We innovate diligently, test exhaustively, then implement fast. In a connected and exciting era, our mission has never been more relevant. Swift now has a presence in 200+ countries and legal territories to serve a community of more than 12,000 banks and financial institutions.

At Swift, security is fundamental to everything we do. As technology and cyber threats continue to evolve, we continue to modernize our security architecture to strengthen resilience, reduce risk, and support the future needs of our business and community. The decisions we make today will help define how Swift protects its infrastructure and services in the years ahead.

We are looking for a manager to lead our Network Security Engineering team and help shape the future of network security at Swift. You will lead a group of highly skilled engineers responsible for protecting Swift's global network infrastructure and advancing modern security capabilities such as Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, attack surface reduction, and security architecture modernization. You will help define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for network security while fostering a culture of security excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-wide security strategy, shape the future of network security at Swift, and lead a talented team that helps strengthen the security and resilience of infrastructure supporting the global financial ecosystem.

Position Summary

As the Network Security Engineering Manager, you will bridge the gap between security strategy and execution. You will lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of network security engineers while aligning security capabilities with business objectives. You will oversee strategic vendor partnerships, manage budgets, and drive the evolution of modern network security capabilities, including Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, and attack surface reduction initiatives.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Empower and Lead: Build, mentor, and inspire a world-class team of network security engineers. Foster a culture of continuous learning, growth, and psychological safety.
  • Attack Surface Management: Proactively identify, analyze, and eliminate potential entry points for attackers. Drive initiatives to keep our corporate, cloud, and edge attack surfaces as minimal and hardened as possible.
  • Shape the Future: Define the technical roadmap for our network security capabilities, driving our transition toward modern architectures.
  • Drive SASE/SSE Innovation: Lead the strategy and deployment of SASE/SSE frameworks (including SD-WAN, SWG, CASB, and ZTNA) to seamlessly secure our global, remote workforce while reducing infrastructure exposure.
  • Secure & Comply: Partner with internal and external audit teams to ensure network compliance with frameworks like ISO 27001 or PCI-DSS.
  • Manage Resources: Evaluate and manage cutting-edge tool vendors, ensuring our team has the best-in-class resources while optimizing the security budget.
  • Collaborate and Champion: Act as a key bridge between technical teams (DevOps, Infrastructure) and executive stakeholders, translating complex risks into business insights.

What You Bring (Required Qualifications)

  • The Experience: 6+ years of experience across network engineering, network security, cybersecurity, or related infrastructure security disciplines, with a demonstrated track record of leading people and complex technical initiatives, driving cross-functional collaboration, and influencing technical direction.
  • Modern Tech Vision: A deep understanding of Next-Gen Firewalls, SIEM platforms, and modern identity systems.
  • SASE/SSE Expertise: Proven experience in the architectural oversight, deployment, or management of SASE/SSE frameworks to secure networks and remote users.
  • Defense-in-Depth Mindset: Practical experience with vulnerability management, network hardening, and proven methodologies for minimizing digital footprint exposure.
  • Leadership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence stakeholders, drive strategic outcomes, and build high-performing teams through mentorship, collaboration, and technical leadership.
  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to explain complex security threats and risk mitigation strategies cleanly to non-technical business leaders.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, Computer Science, IT Management, or equivalent practical industry leadership experience.

Bonus Points (Preferred Certifications)

  • Security Management: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) or CISSP
  • Methodology: Project Management Professional (PMP) or Agile/Scrum certifications
  • Technical Excellence: Advanced vendor or cloud security certifications (e.g., Palo Alto PCNSC, Cisco CCIE Security, AWS Certified Security, or specialized SASE/SSE vendor certs)

What we offer

We give you the freedom to be yourself. We are creating an environment of unique individuals – like you – with different perspectives on the financial industry and the world. A diverse and inclusive environment in which everyone’s voice counts and where you can reach your full potential.

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation related to accessibility during your application or interview, please contact accessibility-Sysgroup@swift.com or indicate this in your application.

Please note that this mailbox is not monitored for general recruitment enquiries and should only be used for accessibility or accommodation-related requests (for example related to vision, hearing or neurodiversity).

All requests are confidential and will not affect your candidacy.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Swift, we are dedicated to building a workplace where people can bring their full selves and ideas to the team, so if you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single qualification.

title: Agentic Software Test Engineer
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Virtual

Agentic Software Test Engineer — TRACE

At Trane Technologies® we Challenge Possible. Our brands – including Trane® and Thermo King® – create access to cooling and comfort in buildings and homes, transport and protect food and perishables, connect customers to elevated performance with less environmental impact, dramatically reduce energy demands and carbon emissions, and innovate with a better world in mind. We boldly challenge what's possible for a sustainable world.

The Role

The Agentic Software Test Engineer — TRACE sits on the Customer Driven Solutions (C.D.S.) Team and runs the agentic testing organization for TRACE — the building energy simulation platform that powers HVAC load calculations, equipment sizing, and ASHRAE-compliant reporting for engineers worldwide.

You direct a team of AI testing agents across a multi-repo .NET / Blazor codebase, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the TRACE software developers as their dedicated QA partner. You're the captain of the agent crew and the quality voice the developers trust — coaching the agents, raising the bar, and putting your name on the work that ships.

This is a hands-on engineering seat; you direct the agent crew; you partner with the humans.

What You'll Do

· Direct the agentic testing team — define agent personas, dispatch patterns, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for QA across TRACE.

· Author the prompts, context contracts, and knowledge bases that drive the agents through test plan generation, regression authoring, defect triage, exploratory testing, and accessibility sweeps.

· Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent output quality — false-positive rates on bug reports, regression coverage drift, flaky-test detection, eval-vs-production divergence — and tighten the loop sprint over sprint.

· Curate what the agents produce — test plans, automated scripts, exploratory findings, regression results — and ship the best of it into the engineering pipeline with your stamp on it.

· Hunt bugs through manual, automated, and agent-driven methods, and verify every agent-surfaced finding before it reaches the development team.

· Own TRACE's quality posture as the SME on HVAC simulation correctness, ASHRAE compliance reporting, EnergyPlus integration behavior, and cross-repo regression risk.

· Partner with developers and Product Owners on test coverage decisions, release readiness, and quality strategy.

· Run regression, functional, and data tests across the .NET 10.0 backend, Blazor frontend, PostgreSQL schema, and EnergyPlus calculation engine.

· Design adversarial verification workflows — parallel agents that try to refute a test result before it's trusted.

· Curate the agent learning loop — capture recurring failure patterns, encode them into spec rules, and feed them back into agent knowledge bases so the same defect class is caught earlier next sprint.

· Translate customer-impact reports into agent-runnable test scenarios and explain quality posture to non-technical stakeholders without hand-waving.

What You Bring

Required

· 5+ years in software quality assurance, with a real track record of shipping tested software.

· 1+ year hands-on with LLM-based agents, AI coding assistants, or multi-agent systems in a production or near-production workflow.

· Strong test-design instincts across unit, integration, system, functional, and exploratory layers; comfortable owning test plans, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, and release gating.

· Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or equivalent) and the Anthropic / OpenAI APIs.

· Working knowledge of prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON Schema), tool use, and multi-agent orchestration (parallel/pipeline/judge-panel/adversarial-verify).

· Comfort designing evals and treating eval results as a first-class quality metric.

· Bias toward human-in-the-loop verification — never trusting agent output blindly.

· Ability to read and modify production code in C#, Python, or JavaScript — not just test code.

· Experience with GitHub Actions testing pipelines.

· Working knowledge of Jira (or equivalent) and testing tools like Playwright, BUnit, xUnit / NUnit.

· Strong written and oral communication; able to explain agent behavior, eval results, and quality posture in plain language.

Preferred

· Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline (or equivalent experience — we care more about what you've shipped than where you studied).

· Familiarity with C#, .NET 10.0, Blazor, ASP.NET Core, Razor, plus the usual web stack (JavaScript / TypeScript / CSS / HTML).

· Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and EF Core, including database-aware test design (cascade-delete chains, FK integrity, schema migration testing).

· Background in building energy simulation, EnergyPlus, ASHRAE 140 software testing, ASHRAE 90.1 / 62.1 / 169 compliance reporting, or HVAC equipment sizing workflows.

· Agile / Scrum experience.

Working Style

This is an on-site role so you can pair tightly with the TRACE engineering team and the agent crew you're directing. Expect a fast feedback loop, candid technical conversation, and a team that takes both craft and outcomes seriously.

title: Senior Analyst Value Analysis

Senior Analyst Value Analysis


What you will be doing:

Senior Analyst, Value Analysis will be part of the system wide, Physician-led Value Analysis (VA) process. The Senior Analyst, Value Analysis will be tasked with assessing the impact of product function and cost across the Clinical Spend landscape utilizing cost, quality, and patient outcome data to identify opportunities. The Senior Analyst is responsible for creating and managing financial spend analysis, conducting supply chain operations analysis, identifying opportunity, conducting research, collecting, and analyzing data, and advising on next steps or changes based on interpreting results.


Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1 – 100%

  • Create and interpret spreadsheets, presentations, and other deliverables using Microsoft Office suite, Excel, Access, Power Point, Visio, and Project, as necessary.
  • Use expertise in Microsoft Word, Excel (Pivot Tables and V-lookups), PowerPoint, Access, project management software (e.g., MS Project) and flowcharting software (e.g., Visio) to create client deliverables accurately, with attention to detail, and on time.
  • Perform analysis of medical and surgical products to identify savings opportunities or perform analysis of supply chain operations activities and data to identify operational enhancements, transformation, and savings.
  • Responsible for client and internal presentation creation and development of quality deliverables.
  • Participate in identifying business and technical problems and work with team to create innovative solutions.
  • Responsible for conducting research, analyzing data, and using results to drive recommendations for opportunities.

title: Project Director
description:
Project Director

2-Year Fixed Term Contract

For candidates seeking to be located at our Stevenage site, this role will temporarily be based at Stevenage. However, the Company plans to relocate its offices to Cambridge, UK. The location of this role will therefore subsequently change to Cambridge, UK in accordance with timelines to be set by the Company. The relocation is currently proposed to take effect by early 2029.

Business Introduction
We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance. Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply. We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.

Position Summary

You will lead the delivery of a UK campus fit-out for a new collaboration hub and lab facility, overseeing a complex capital programme that delivers meaningful change for our UK business. You will work with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to define strategy, plan delivery and drive results. We value clear decision-making, practical leadership and collaboration. This role offers growth, visible impact and the chance to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Responsibilities
You will have end-to-end accountability for delivering a complex, multi-year programme, with responsibilities that include:

  • Leading full lifecycle delivery of the campus fit out, ensuring scope, schedule, cost and quality commitments are achieved.
  • Accountable for ongoing contract governance for outsourced project management and construction delivery organisations, including oversight of budget changes, performance against service partner KPIs, risk mitigation and effective handover to operations.
  • Build strong relationships with key R&D leaders and wider stakeholders across functions and levels, partnering to shape scope, align priorities and resolve business-driven changes that impact project delivery.
  • Owning the integrated delivery plan, coordinating resources and critical path activities to keep execution on track.
  • Designing and overseeing change and communications plans to support smooth transitions and strong employee engagement.
  • Proactively managing programme risks, issues and budgets, and providing clear, data-driven progress updates to senior stakeholders.
  • Coaching and developing project teams, creating an inclusive environment that supports learning, accountability and high performance.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Project Management, Engineering or Business.
  • Proven ability to manage complex engineering projects in a pharmaceutical R&D facility, including planning, execution and delivery, using frameworks such as PMF.
  • Proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders to secure decisions and resources.
  • Strong track record in planning and delivering change, including cutover, go-live or transition activities.
  • Practical skills in risk management, financial oversight and programme governance.
  • Clear communicator with experience coaching teams and driving cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering or Business related subject.
  • Sound technical knowledge of the pharmaceutical R&D process and GxP / project management requirements.
  • Ability to establish strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external contract partners to deliver project investment.
  • Thorough understanding of statutory legislation in a technically complex environment.
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into practical delivery plans and measurable benefits.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and able to act with sound judgement and pace.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are passionate about making a difference and have the skills and experience, we are looking for, we encourage you to apply.
