title: Access Optimization Specialist
description:
Current Saint Francis Colleagues - Please click HERE to login and apply.

JOB SUMMARY

The Access Optimization Specialist is responsible for advancing patient access, provider capacity, scheduling efficiency, and digital access across the healthcare system. This position serves as an internal subject matter expert and operational consultant, partnering with clinical departments, providers, practice leadership, Patient Access, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to evaluate and optimize provider scheduling templates, appointment workflows, capacity, and digital scheduling opportunities. The Access Optimization Specialist conducts structured reviews of departments and provider templates, analyzes access and capacity performance, identifies opportunities for improvement, and develops data-driven recommendations that balance patient access, provider productivity, clinical needs, and organizational standards. The position supports the organization's Access Governance structure by providing analysis, recommendations, performance reporting, and ongoing monitoring of access initiatives.

JOB DETAILS AND REQUIREMENTS

Education:

- Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, health information management, analytics, information systems, nursing, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience- required

Experience:

- Three (3) years in healthcare operations, ambulatory operations, patient access, scheduling, practice management, healthcare analytics, or related field- required

- Multi-specialty medical group, Epic scheduling functionality, digital scheduling technologies, process improvement, and physician partnership experience- preferred

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Why Work at Saint Francis?

Saint Francis Healthcare System began in 1875 when three courageous Franciscan Sisters answered a call to care for those in need. What started as a 12‑bed hospital has grown into the region’s leading healthcare system—recognized nationally for exceptional quality, safety, and patient experience.

Today, Saint Francis serves more than 715,000 people across five states. With a 306‑bed Medical Center, nearly 3,000 team members, and over 300 providers, Saint Francis is not only the largest healthcare system between St. Louis and Memphis—it’s a powerful economic anchor for the communities it serves.

You’ll find more than 50 specialties, the region’s only Level III Emergency and Trauma Center, and southeast Missouri’s first Level III NICU. The system’s employed physician group, Saint Francis Medical Partners, supports more than 40 outreach clinics and 70% of the area’s primary care providers.

A Mission That Matters

At Saint Francis, you’re not just doing a job - you’re part of a Catholic healing ministry rooted in compassion, dignity, and service. Every action is inspired by a commitment to honor human life and care for every person who walks through the doors.

Mission

To provide a ministry of healing, wellness, quality, and love inspired by our faith in Jesus Christ.

Vision

To be a leading Catholic healthcare system that celebrates and protects the gift of life by providing exceptional patient outcomes in quality, safety, access and value.

Values You Can Feel Every Day

  • Integrity: Doing what’s right, even when no one is watching

  • Stewardship: Managing resources wisely for the future

  • Faith: Believing in a purpose greater than ourselves

  • Hope: Lifting up those who feel discouraged

  • Joy: Serving others with a grateful, happy heart

  • Compassion: Seeing others through Christ's eyes

  • Excellence: Always striving to be the best

  • Dignity: Respecting human life from beginning to end

If You’re Looking to Make a True Impact…

Saint Francis offers a workplace where your work has purpose, your team feels like family, and your contributions support a mission that has been changing lives for more than 150 years.

Total Rewards

Our most important asset is our colleagues. That's why Saint Francis Healthcare System offers a comprehensive benefits program to meet all your needs. Colleagues working at least 24 hours per week will have access to our Total Rewards package as outlined below.

  • Comprehensive and affordable health coverage including medical, prescription, dental and vision - available on the first of the month after hire date

  • Saint Francis Medical Services Discount

  • Earned Time Off (ETO) based on relevant years of work history. ETO combines vacation, sick, holidays, and personal days into one balance to allow for flexibility

  • Retirement benefits including SFHS immediate matching

  • Education Assistance benefits up to $5,000 per calendar year for one year of service after graduation

  • Other benefits including: Benefit Support through Health Advocate, Employee Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts, Identity Theft Protection, Pet Insurance, Earned Wage Access

To learn more about our Total Rewards package and eligibility, visit .

Saint Francis Healthcare System provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Saint Francis Healthcare System complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Industrial Fabricator
description:
GFL Environmental is looking for an Industrial Fabricator to join our team in Byron Center, MI. This role is responsible for fabricating finished goods using industrial cutting tools, machines, and PVC high-temperature air welders. Compensation range is $19-21/hr. Full-time permanent position with benefit package.

We are willing to train the right candidate for this position. This is a great opportunity for those beginning their career or looking to develop new skills—we're ready to invest in your growth!

At GFL our goal is to invest in our people and provide opportunities to grow for life!
Our employees are affectionately known as team green, a name that unites us all under our shared purpose of providing sustainable solutions to enable our customers and communities to be GREEN FOR LIFE!

  • 3 weeks PTO annually

  • 4 medical plan options including an HSA with employer contribution, dental, and vision coverage.

  • 401(k) with an employer match

  • Work boot reimbursement

  • Paid holidays

  • Employee Assistance Program with free counseling services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review blueprints and daily production plans provided by the Product Manager.

  • Utilize rolls of purchased PVC and Fiberglass materials to fabricate into finished goods.

  • Operate industrial cutting tools, machines, and PVC high-temperature air welders on a daily basis.

  • Operate a forklift to move materials and finished products safely.

  • Perform basic math calculations (adding and subtracting) for material measurements and production tracking.

  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment.

Requirements:

  • Ability to read, write, and speak English.

  • Proficient ability to utilize hand tools and perform precise measurements with tape measure.

  • Ability to operate a forklift.

  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and work effectively alone.

  • Strong basic math skills (adding and subtracting).

  • Ability to lift materials up to 40 pounds throughout the day.

  • Flexibility to work overtime as required by customer needs.

#GFLTalent

El puesto tiene como finalidad proporcionar apoyo operativo y administrativo especializado para garantizar la prestación eficiente de servicios dentro de la organización. Los titulares pueden desempeñar funciones de apoyo a equipos, unidades o áreas específicas en oficinas de país, despachos regionales o la Sede, trabajando con un alto grado de autonomía y asegurando la correcta ejecución de procesos estándar.

En el contexto de esta asignación, el puesto brindará apoyo temporal al área de Recursos Humanos para fortalecer e implementar iniciativas relacionadas con bienestar, diversidad, inclusión y cultura de respeto en la Oficina País. Sus responsabilidades incluyen apoyar actividades de comunicación, sistematización y análisis de información, elaboración de materiales, seguimiento de datos y coordinación de acciones de sensibilización.

La asignación busca ampliar la capacidad operativa del equipo de Recursos Humanos, contribuir al cumplimiento oportuno del plan de trabajo del área, facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en evidencia y promover un entorno laboral seguro, inclusivo y orientado al bienestar del personal.

Job Title : Asistente de Recursos Humanos

Type of contract : SSA-5

Unit : Recursos Humanos

Duty Station : Quito

Duración : 6 meses

Background and purpose of the assignment

El Programa Mundial de Alimentos (WFP por sus siglas en inglés) es la organización humanitaria más grande del mundo, enfocada en salvar vidas durante emergencias y construir medios de vida sostenibles para las poblaciones más vulnerables. En Ecuador, WFP trabaja con el Gobierno Nacional, organismos internacionales, donantes, sector privado y organizaciones de la sociedad civil para fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria, la resiliencia climática, la protección social y la integración socioeconómica de poblaciones vulnerables.

En el marco de la creciente demanda operativa del Programa Mundial de Alimentos (WFP) en Ecuador y de la necesidad de garantizar una gestión eficiente, oportuna y alineada con las políticas institucionales de Recursos Humanos, se requiere la contratación de un Asistente de Recursos Humanos bajo modalidad SSA para brindar apoyo técnico y administrativo a los procesos de gestión de talento. Esta posición contribuirá a la adecuada implementación de las políticas, procedimientos y servicios de Recursos Humanos, especialmente en actividades relacionadas con selección de personal, administración de personal, mantenimiento de registros, elaboración de documentación, generación de reportes, incorporación de nuevos colaboradores y apoyo a iniciativas de fortalecimiento de la cultura organizacional.

Asimismo, permitirá asegurar la atención oportuna de consultas, la actualización de información en los sistemas corporativos y la coordinación con áreas internas, fortaleciendo la capacidad de la oficina para ofrecer servicios de Recursos Humanos estratégicos, eficientes y centrados en las personas, en apoyo al cumplimiento de los objetivos institucionales del WFP en el país.

El/la titular del puesto rinde cuentas al Oficial de Recursos Humanos . En este nivel, el titular debe asumir la responsabilidad de llevar a término toda una serie de actividades de recursos humanos que requieren un cierto nivel de interpretación de las directrices y prácticas estándar. Además, puede recomendar una determinada línea de acción en su esfera de competencia y quizá deba proporcionar orientación a otros funcionarios

Finalidad del Puesto: Realizar una serie de tareas de recursos humanos para apoyar la aplicación precisa de las políticas y procedimientos del PMA y facilitar el funcionamiento eficaz de los servicios de recursos humanos estratégicos y centrados en el cliente

Accountabilities/ Responsibilities

Proporcionar asistencia en las consultas generales sobre recursos humanos y las medidas de seguimiento correspondientes, para garantizar que se presten a los clientes servicios de recursos humanos coherentes y de alta calidad.

Proporcionar orientación y capacitación en el empleo a otros miembros del personal, para apoyar su desarrollo y aumentar el conocimiento de los sistemas y procedimientos en materia de recursos humanos necesarios para el desempeño de sus funciones.

Actuar de enlace con otras dependencias internas u oficinas en los asuntos relacionados con los recursos humanos (como la nómina, los contratos, etc.), y facilitar la información necesaria para que los servicios de recursos humanos puedan prestarse oportunamente.

Extraer y compilar datos de recursos humanos acerca de la contratación y selección de personal, las condiciones contractuales, los derechos, el desempeño y los requisitos de formación, para apoyar las necesidades de análisis y presentación de informes.

Prestar apoyo administrativo en diversas actividades de recursos humanos en las esferas de actividad asignadas por el funcionario del cuadro orgánico, incluida la acogida de nuevos miembros del personal de conformidad con los procesos y procedimientos pertinentes.

Mantener expedientes del personal confidenciales, bases de datos de recursos humanos y archivos, para garantizar que los datos y los ficheros se almacenen con precisión y se actualicen de conformidad con las normas establecidas.

Elaborar los diversos documentos de recursos humanos que se necesiten en la esfera de actividad específica (por ejemplo, contratos de trabajo, cartas de traslado, documentos relacionados con la capacitación, etc.), garantizando la exactitud y respetando los plazos establecidos.

Utilizar los sistemas de gestión de recursos humanos para introducir y actualizar una amplia gama de datos, y prestar asistencia en el seguimiento de los diversos plazos, garantizando el cumplimiento de los plazos establecidos y la precisión de los datos.

Apoyar el despliegue del personal y las medidas administrativas conexas, incluida la preparación de informes básicos, para facilitar un servicio de recursos humanos eficiente que permita al PMA responder rápidamente a una crisis.

Apoyo en la implementación de iniciativas de fortalecimiento de cultura organizacional .

Deliverables at the end of the contract

Procesos de selección gestionados y debidamente documentados, incluyendo publicaciones, organización de postulaciones, filtros curriculares iniciales y seguimiento de candidatos

Documentos de Recursos Humanos preparados y organizados, incluyendo contratos, cartas, formularios y documentos de incorporación.

Sistemas, bases de datos y registros de Recursos Humanos actualizados con información precisa.

Coordinaciones administrativas con otras dependencias internas u oficinas realizadas y documentadas.

Actividades de incorporación y acogida de nuevos miembros del personal apoyadas y organizadas.

Contratos, vencimientos y plazos administrativos registrados y actualizados en las herramientas de seguimiento.

Sesiones informativas y actividades de orientación sobre procedimientos de Recursos Humanos apoyadas y coordinadas.

Iniciativas de fortalecimiento de la cultura organizacional apoyadas, coordinadas, y documentadas conforme a las orientaciones de la supervisión

Reportes básicos y consolidados de actividades de Recursos Humanos preparados de acuerdo con los requerimientos de la supervisión.

Qualifications & Experience Requiered

Education.- Formación de tercer nivel en administración, psicología organizacional, desarrollo organizacional, recursos humanos o áreas afines .

Experience : Al menos 5 años de experiencia en : gestión y aplicación de políticas y procedimientos de Recursos Humanos, gestión de actividades específicas de servicios de recursos humanos (p. ej: reclutamiento, contratación, administración de personal, etc), orientación a personal menos experimentado, organización de sesiones informativas en proceso de incorporación, así como experiencia apoyando iniciativas de fortalecimiento organizacional .

    

Knoweledge skills.-

Habilidades de comunicación, sistematización de información, atención al detalle y precisión. Manejo de Office. Manejo grupos y dinámicas. Capacidad de trabajo autónomo y colaborativo.

Language : Ingles nivel B2

Job Title: CYBERSECURITY ADVISORY CONSULTANT (IAM & Endpoint Protection)

Type of contract: Consultant Level II

Unit/Division: Technology Division, Information Security

Duty station: Remote working

Duration: 11 months

Background and purpose of the role:

Under the general supervision of the Chief Information Security Officer and supervision of the Head of Cybersecurity Advisory Services, the incumbent will conduct consulting activities to the business, including, but not limited to:

• Authorization to Operate and cyber security compliance

• Application security

• Definition, assessment and continuous improvement of authentication, authorization, device security and access management controls.

• Security architecture

• Securing critical applications such as beneficiary management systems

• Azure and Active Directory security

• Strengthen the organization's identity security and endpoint protection capabilities

Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

1. Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and lead the Authorization to Operate (ATO) process for IT systems and services, ensuring that security risks are appropriately identified, evaluated, documented, mitigated and communicated to relevant stakeholders.

2. Design, review and oversee the security architecture of new and existing applications, platforms, cloud services and technology initiatives, ensuring that appropriate security controls are embedded by design and aligned with organizational policies, data classification requirements and industry best practices.

3. Assess and strengthen identity and access management controls across applications, cloud services and enterprise platforms, including authentication, authorization, privileged access, access lifecycle management and periodic access reviews.

4. Define and review endpoint protection requirements and security baselines for corporate endpoints, mobile devices and other managed devices, addressing device compliance, configuration hardening, threat protection, encryption and security monitoring.

5. Provide security guidance on the integration of identity and endpoint controls, ensuring that access decisions appropriately consider user identity, device security posture, privilege level and information sensitivity.

6. Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of cybersecurity procedures, services, methodologies and governance frameworks aimed at protecting organizational information assets, systems and services.

7. Research, evaluate and propose innovative technologies, security capabilities and process improvements that strengthen the cybersecurity posture of the organization while demonstrating measurable business value and operational effectiveness.

8. Propose and maintain new security standards, procedures and guidelines to help raise the current security maturity level of the organization. In close collaboration with the Architecture branch, perform regular baseline and hardening reviews of WFP security solutions and technologies.

9. Provide expert cybersecurity advisory services and technical guidance to County Offices, Regional Bureaus and HQ divisions to address cybersecurity challenges and maintain compliance with organizational security standards.

10. Provide guidance to IT solution owners across the organization to:

- Design security controls appropriate to the technology and risk landscape.

- Protect information according to its classification and sensitivity

- Implement secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices.

- Integrate security requirements into project and solution lifecycles

- Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and requirements.

11. Advise stakeholders on cybersecurity risks associated with emerging technologies, including cloud services, artificial intelligence, software-as-a-service (SaaS), digital transformation initiatives and data-driven solutions.

12. Maintain a record of decisions taken and assessments performed, in cooperation with other members of the Advisory team.

13. Identify and execute improvements to existing processes, through solutions to address recurring problems and enhancements to existing solutions or documentation.

14. Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned technologies, platforms , business applications and cybersecurity domains.

15. Prepare and present high-quality reports, risk assessments, executive briefings, architecture recommendations and management updates tailored to technical and business audiences

16. Mentor, coach and provide technical leadership to junior team members, contributing to knowledge sharing, capability development and continuous improvement within the Advisory team

17. Represent the Cybersecurity Branch in meetings, working groups, steering committees, audits, assessments and enterprise initiatives as required.

18. Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required in support of TECI Cybersecurity objectives.

Qualifications and Experience required:

Education: Degree in the field of Computer Science/Engineering or related STEM disciplines or equivalent working experience.

Experience: At least 6 years of relevant work experience.

Knowledge and Skills:

- Solid IT Security skills, with both academic background and professional experience
- Solid IT SDLC expertise.
- Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies and concepts.
- Experience with endpoint protection technologies and security controls, including endpoint detection and response (EDR), device compliance, configuration hardening and mobile device management (MDM).
- Ability to assess and design identity-centric and device-based security controls, supporting Zero Trust, conditional access and risk-based access management approaches.
- Understanding of IT architecture and design concepts.
- Ability to manage stakeholder relationships, aligning cybersecurity risk strategies with business objectives.
- Understand cybersecurity risk concepts to assess threats, vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.
- Good project management skills.
- Experience in multinational organizations
- IT Security and IT Audit certifications
- Security architecture in the cloud.
- Understanding of AI security concepts and framework
- Experience in ISO, NIST, HIPAA or PCI compliance processes.

Languages: Fluency in oral and written English is mandatory with an intermediate knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian and Spanish) or Portuguese (one of WFP’s working languages) is desirable.

title: Mars Global Direct Tax Transformation Tax Lead
description:
Job Description:

The Mars Global Direct Tax Transformation Tax Lead is responsible for defining and leading the enterprise direct tax strategy, operating model, data architecture, and technology requirements within a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role serves as the senior Tax representative for US GAAP tax reporting, tax provision, corporate income tax compliance, and local non-US tax reporting requirements.

This role partners with Global Tax, Regional and Country Tax teams, Finance, Controllership, Data and Analytics, and IT to ensure that SAP S/4HANA, Central Finance (CFIN), enterprise data lake capabilities, and supporting tax technologies provide complete, accurate, and tax-ready financial data. The lead establishes the global design principles, controls, governance, and analytical capabilities needed to improve tax reporting, compliance, forecasting, audit readiness, and access to legal-entity-level data.

What are we Looking For?

  • 10+ years of experience in direct tax, tax accounting, tax compliance, tax technology, or tax transformation.
  • Significant leadership experience within a multinational corporation, major consulting organization, or Big Four environment.
  • Deep knowledge of US GAAP income tax accounting, including ASC 740 tax provision requirements.
  • Strong understanding of current and deferred tax, effective tax rate reconciliation, uncertain tax positions, tax account rollforwards, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Experience with local non-US corporate income tax compliance and country-specific tax reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate global and local direct tax requirements into finance, data, technology, and control designs.
  • Experience leading direct tax workstreams within SAP S/4HANA or comparable global ERP transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance, including the Universal Journal, ledgers, company codes, charts of accounts, profit centers, cost centers, and intercompany data.
  • Practical experience with SAP Central Finance and the use of CFIN to harmonize data from SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Experience defining enterprise data lake requirements, tax data models, data products, data lineage, and data quality controls.
  • Experience working with large and complex financial datasets across multiple ERP systems, legal entities, ledgers, currencies, and jurisdictions.
  • Experience designing tax reporting and analytical solutions using SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks, Alteryx, or comparable technologies.
  • Understanding of data integration, transformation, mapping, reconciliation, and reporting architectures.
  • Experience with tax provision, tax compliance, tax reporting, or tax data management platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Record-to-Report, financial close, consolidation, intercompany accounting, statutory reporting, and legal entity reporting processes.
  • Experience defining and operating tax controls within a SOX or comparable internal-control environment.
  • Proven success leading global requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
  • Ability to balance global template standardization with legitimate local tax compliance requirements.
  • Strong governance, program management, risk management, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior Tax, Finance, Data, and IT stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
  • CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA, MST, JD, MBA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.

What are the Key Responsibilities?

  • Lead the global direct tax transformation workstream for the SAP S/4HANA program.
  • Define the direct tax transformation strategy, roadmap, operating model, and global design principles.
  • Represent Global Direct Tax in SAP S/4HANA, CFIN, data lake, finance architecture, and enterprise data governance decisions.
  • Define requirements for US GAAP tax provision, tax accounting, effective tax rate analysis, and tax-related financial statement disclosures.
  • Define financial data and reporting requirements for local non-US corporate income tax compliance, tax returns, and supporting schedules.
  • Translate direct tax policies and reporting requirements into business, data, process, system, and control requirements.
  • Define tax data requirements at the legal entity, company code, ledger, account, profit center, cost center, business unit, jurisdiction, and transaction levels.
  • Ensure tax-relevant data is consistently captured, retained, mapped, reconciled, and made available from SAP S/4HANA and legacy systems.
  • Define the role of CFIN in consolidating and harmonizing tax-relevant financial data from SAP and non-SAP source systems.
  • Partner with enterprise data teams to design tax data products, data models, and data pipelines within the enterprise data lake.
  • Define requirements for tax reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and analytics using tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks, and Alteryx.
  • Partner with Finance and Controllership on chart of accounts, Universal Journal, ledger, intercompany, legal entity, and financial reporting design decisions.
  • Establish requirements for book-to-tax adjustments, permanent and temporary differences, tax basis data, deferred taxes, and return-to-provision processes.
  • Partner with Transfer Pricing, Statutory Reporting, Indirect Tax, Treasury, and Legal Entity teams to manage cross-functional direct tax dependencies.
  • Define direct tax controls covering data completeness, data quality, reconciliation, adjustment approval, reporting, and audit evidence.
  • Lead global and regional requirements workshops, fit-to-standard assessments, solution reviews, and design governance.
  • Evaluate country requirements and determine whether they should be addressed through the global template, regional solutions, data products, or controlled local processes.
  • Own direct tax testing strategy, business acceptance criteria, defect prioritization, and readiness sign-off.
  • Provide leadership for tax data conversion, historical data access, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Manage direct tax risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and escalations across the transformation program.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on direct tax readiness, solution gaps, risks, decisions, and expected business value.
  • Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across global direct tax operations.

Key Deliverables

  • Global direct tax transformation strategy, roadmap, and target operating model.
  • Direct tax design principles and requirements for the SAP S/4HANA global template.
  • Global requirements for US GAAP tax provision and tax accounting.
  • Country and regional requirements framework for local non-US income tax compliance reporting.
  • Direct tax process designs covering tax provision, compliance, forecasting, audit support, and return-to-provision.
  • Tax data architecture spanning SAP S/4HANA, CFIN, the enterprise data lake, and downstream tax applications.
  • Tax data model and data dictionary defining required fields, attributes, hierarchies, ownership, and lineage.
  • CFIN requirements for harmonization, replication, mapping, reconciliation, and access to tax-relevant financial data.
  • Legal-entity-level reporting requirements, including account, ledger, jurisdiction, profit center, cost center, intercompany, and transactional detail.
  • Tax data lake requirements and reusable direct tax data products.

Enterprise Architect – Data & AI Enabled Enterprise
Location: Plano, TX / Remote Job Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Enterprise Architect to drive the alignment of business strategy, technology investments, data, and AI capabilities across the organization.

The Enterprise Architect will lead the evolution of the organization's business, technology, data, AI, product, and platform architecture strategy. This role ensures technology investments accelerate business outcomes through AI-enabled products, reusable platforms, modern software engineering practices, and governance frameworks that promote responsible innovation.

The Enterprise Architect will define enterprise-wide architecture standards supporting AI-powered software development, platform engineering, product-centric delivery, and responsible use of Generative AI across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Strategy & Business Alignment

· Partner with executive leadership to translate business strategy into technology and architecture roadmaps.

· Develop and maintain enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, and guiding principles.

· Align business capabilities, processes, applications, information, and technology platforms with strategic objectives.

· Establish future-state architecture blueprints that support organizational growth, innovation, and operational efficiency.

· Identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, and optimize the enterprise technology landscape.

Architecture Governance & Decision Support

· Lead enterprise architecture governance processes and architecture review boards.

· Define standards for application architecture, integration patterns, cloud adoption, platform engineering, and AI-enabled solutions.

· Evaluate technology investments and provide recommendations that balance business value, risk, complexity, and cost.

· Drive architecture consistency across business units and technology teams.

· Ensure traceability between strategic objectives, business capabilities, and technology solutions.

Data, Analytics & AI Enablement

· Define enterprise data architecture strategies that support trusted, accessible, and governed data.

· Partner with data, analytics, and engineering teams to build scalable data platforms and AI capabilities.

· Promote AI-first and data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

· Establish architecture patterns that enable advanced analytics, machine learning, automation, and generative AI solutions.

· Ensure alignment with responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Technology Transformation & Modernization

· Lead enterprise-wide modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, application rationalization, platform transformation, and digital innovation.

· Develop transition roadmaps from current-state to future-state architectures.

· Identify emerging technologies and assess their applicability to business challenges and growth opportunities.

· Guide modernization efforts involving APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, automation platforms, and SaaS services.

· Collaborate with engineering and product teams to accelerate technology delivery and improve operational resilience.

Security, Risk & Compliance

· Incorporate security, privacy, regulatory, and resilience requirements into enterprise architecture decisions.

· Partner with cybersecurity and risk teams to ensure architectures meet security and compliance standards.

· Support business continuity, resilience, and disaster recovery planning through architecture design.

· Balance innovation objectives with governance, risk management, and operational requirements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership

· Act as a strategic advisor to executives, business leaders, product organizations, and engineering teams.

· Facilitate collaboration across business and technology functions to achieve enterprise objectives.

· Mentor solution architects, domain architects, and technical leaders.

· Communicate architectural concepts and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and architectural excellence.

Qualifications

Required Experience

· 12+ years of experience in information technology, with significant experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or technology strategy leadership roles.

· Proven experience developing enterprise architecture strategies, roadmaps, and governance frameworks.

· Strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture disciplines.

· Experience leading large-scale digital transformation and modernization initiatives.

· Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

· Knowledge of modern architectural patterns including microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and platform engineering.

· Experience supporting enterprise data, analytics, or AI initiatives.

· Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, FEAF, or Gartner Enterprise Architecture methodologies.

· Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, and data governance frameworks.

· Knowledge of enterprise integration platforms, data lakehouse architectures, and cloud-native development ecosystems.

· Experience supporting merger, acquisition, or enterprise platform consolidation initiatives.

· TOGAF certification or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.

Leadership Competencies

· Strategic thinker capable of linking technology investments to business outcomes.

· Strong systems-thinking and problem-solving abilities.

· Influential leader who can drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

· Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.

· Ability to balance innovation, standardization, risk, and operational efficiency.

· Passion for enabling a modern, data-driven, AI-enabled enterprise.

Success Measures

In this role, success will be measured by:

· Improved alignment between business strategy and technology investments.

· Reduction in technology complexity and technical debt.

· Increased adoption of architecture standards and governance practices.

· Successful delivery of modernization and transformation programs.

· Increased reuse of enterprise platforms, services, and data assets.

(1x Perm, 1x FTC/Secondment)

We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.

GSK Barnard Castle is a key secondary manufacturing site and has invested heavily in industry 4.0 state of the art, bespoke equipment to support sustained new product introductions and volume increases, and as a key supplier of some of GSK’s blockbuster products, the site contributes revenues of ~$2Bn annually.

This role offers significant opportunities for professional growth, the chance to make a measurable impact on patient supply, and the opportunity to help unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

- Plan, lead and execute validation activities for processes, facilities, equipment and simple computerised systems.
- Provide quality oversight for new product introduction, technical transfers and batch documentation.
- Prepare and maintain validation protocols, test scripts, final reports and supporting evidence.
- Make timely, documented, risk-based quality decisions and clearly communicate rationale to stakeholders.
- Support internal and external inspections, prepare evidence and close agreed actions.
- Drive improvements to validation processes, templates and tools to increase efficiency and compliance.

Why You?

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
- Degree in a scientific, technical or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Practical experience in validation or quality assurance in a regulated environment.
- Experience in computerised system validation or lifecycle activities for IT/automation systems.
- Working knowledge of good manufacturing practice (GMP) and quality management systems.
- Experience producing and reviewing validation and batch release documentation.
- Clear communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

- Advanced degree in science, engineering or a related technical field.
- Experience applying GAMP principles and data integrity requirements.
- Proven experience supporting regulatory inspections and interactions.
- Track record delivering validation for MES, automation or laboratory systems.
- Strong risk assessment skills and experience documenting risk-based decisions.
- Experience driving continuous improvement and validation tooling.

Working pattern
This role is a full time onsite role at Barnard Castle in the United Kingdom. On-site presence will be required for inspections, validations and technical transfer activities.

We look for people who are curious, collaborative and accountable. We welcome different perspectives and aim to create an environment where everyone belongs. You will be supported to develop your skills and grow your career while helping deliver high quality products to patients.

Data Integrity, Detail-Oriented, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Influencing Without Authority, Lean Management, Problem Solving, Project Management, Quality Assurance (QA), Risk Awareness, Technical Writing, Validation Processes

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, trainers, facilitators, and HR stakeholders to ensure learning solutions are engaging, scalable, operationally excellent, and aligned to business priorities. This position offers the opportunity to influence talent development strategy, elevate program quality, and create a consistent, high-impact learner experience across Energy Services.

What you will do:

Key Responsibilities

Instructional Design & Learning Experience Ownership

  • Design, develop, and manage engaging learning solutions for the Energy Services & Controls business across online, blended, and instructor-led formats.
  • Build and maintain digital learning content that advances technical, functional, and professional capability development.
  • Own the learner experience for assigned programs by ensuring content is relevant, accessible, well-structured, and aligned with adult learning principles.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and business stakeholders to identify learning needs, define objectives, and translate business requirements into effective learning solutions.
  • Manage course creation, updates, assignments, and deployment within Workday Learning, helping establish efficient and scalable learning administration practices.
  • Evaluate and continuously improve training content based on stakeholder feedback, learner insights, and evolving business needs.
  • Bring creativity and innovation to the design process through modern instructional methods, digital tools, and interactive learning approaches.

Program Coordination & Delivery Management

  • Serve as the primary coordinator for communications with managers, participants, trainers, and facilitators before, during, and after training events.
  • Coordinate training logistics, including space reservations, room setup, material preparation, catering arrangements, and on-site assistance.
  • Ensure all training materials, resources, and program details are prepared accurately and delivered on schedule.
  • Maintain program calendars, timelines, and logistics plans to ensure consistent execution across multiple learning initiatives.
  • Anticipate and resolve operational issues quickly while maintaining a professional and learner-focused experience.

Collaboration, Program Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner closely with the Talent Development Leader to advance learning priorities for the Energy Services & Controls business.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with HR, business leaders, facilitators, vendors, and subject matter experts to execute learning initiatives that advance capability building and business performance.
  • Provide coordination and project leadership across multiple simultaneous programs, helping align deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Recommend process improvements that enhance training operations, learner engagement, and overall program effectiveness.
  • Contribute to reporting, program metrics, and feedback collection to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

What you will bring:

Qualifications

  • Experience in instructional design, training coordination, talent development, learning operations, or program management.
  • Experience developing and managing digital learning content and coordinating instructor-led training programs.
  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and levels of the organization.
  • Ability to build strong partnerships and work collaboratively with stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering a high-quality learner and stakeholder experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of adult learning principles, learner engagement strategies, and instructional design best practices.

title: Enterprise Risk Analyst
description:

We’re the world’s leading provider of secure financial messaging services, headquartered in Belgium. We are the way the world moves value – across borders, through cities and overseas. The Enterprise Risk Analyst works closely with the Head of Enterprise Risk Framework as well as key stakeholders across the ERM Policy & Methodology team, the Risk Department and Swift to ensure Swift’s Enterprise Risk Framework is effective, efficient and embedded.

This includes:

ERM Framework and Methodology:

  • Support the Head of Enterprise Risk Framework to design, develop, implement and embed methodology change to ensure Swift’s approach to Enterprise Risk Management continuously improves and remains dynamic, aligns with regulatory and meets industry standards.
  • Maintain effectiveness of Swift’s ERM Framework collateral to meet business owner and Risk Partner needs.
  • Support in the refresh and delivery of core components of Swift’s ERM Framework including Risk Appetite and Key Risk Indicators as well as organisational tolerances.

Risk System (GRC tooling):

  • Lead on engagement across Swift in governing and managing change to ERMF elements of Swifts Risk System.
  • Take ownership of Risk components of GRC Tooling design ensuring requirements of Swifts ERMF are maintained in the development of new and changes to existing Swifts Risk System configurations.
  • Engage with Risk Performance team to facilitate risk data quality management and Risk Governance team to ensure effective training of Swift-wide stakeholders on Risk Management activities in GRC Tooling.

Data and Reporting:

  • Perform analysis of Enterprise Risk data to assess implementation of Swift’s ERM Framework and working closely with Risk Partners to continuously improve implementation as well as data quality.
  • Develop and support effective risk reporting that has organisational impact and creates insight for decision-making.

What will make you successful:

  • 3+ years’ experience working in Enterprise Risk Management or with ServiceNow Design Subject Matter Expertise.
  • ISO31000 or similar Enterprise Risk Management certification
  • ServiceNow IRM certification
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience developing and producing impactful risk reporting for senior audiences.

  • Driven by engaging on varied activities and thrive in a high-paced environment

  • Sound interest in the financial services industry.

What we offer

We give you the freedom to be yourself. We are creating an environment of unique individuals – like you – with different perspectives on the financial industry and the world. A diverse and inclusive environment in which everyone’s voice counts and where you can reach your full potential.

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation related to accessibility during your application or interview, please contact accessibility-Sysgroup@swift.com or indicate this in your application.

Job Description - Readiness and Response Consultant

Consumer Business Continuity supports the continuity of critical business operations across Financial Centers, Contact Centers, and administrative functions. This role is responsible for assessing, coordinating, and managing response activities for a wide range of operational disruptions, helping restore normal business operations while minimizing impacts to clients and teammates.

The Consultant serves as a key partner during disruptive events, leveraging established business continuity plans, response playbooks, and enterprise partnerships to drive timely resolution and recovery. Responsibilities include managing multiple concurrent events, coordinating cross-functional response efforts, and providing guidance to business partners on operational resilience and continuity practices.

This role works closely with Financial Center, Contact Center, Technology, Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Security, and other enterprise partners to address disruptions ranging from technology outages and facility incidents to severe weather events and other business-impacting situations. The Consultant also supports ongoing readiness efforts by identifying process improvements, enhancing response procedures, and strengthening preparedness capabilities across the organization.

Success in this role requires strong operational leadership, sound judgment, effective communication, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver who can assess impacts, coordinate recovery efforts, and build strong partnerships across lines of business to ensure the continuity of critical services and support for clients and teammates.

Responsibilities

  • Respond to a broad range of business disruptions, including facility incidents, technology outages, natural disasters, physical security events, and reputational risks.

  • Assess business impacts and coordinate response efforts to minimize disruption to clients, teammates, and critical business operations.

  • Manage multiple concurrent events with a high degree of accuracy, urgency, and attention to detail.

  • Partners across Consumer, Technology, Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Security, and other enterprise teams to support the timely restoration of services and operations.

  • Coordinate response and recovery activities for Financial Centers and administrative sites impacted by operational disruptions.

  • Leverage available tools, resources, and established procedures to resolve issues and support business recovery efforts.

  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with line of business stakeholders, serving as a trusted point of contact during disruptive events.

  • Communicate effectively with business partners and leadership, providing timely updates, guidance, and escalation support as needed.

  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives, discussions, and exercises to strengthen business continuity preparedness and recovery capabilities.

  • Identify potential business continuity risks, operational gaps, and opportunities for process improvement, escalating concerns when appropriate.

  • Develop and enhance procedures, job aids, and business processes to improve operational readiness and response effectiveness.

  • Manage and prioritize requests received through the Readiness & Response shared inbox and workflow tools, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.

  • Consistently meet established timelines, service level agreements (SLAs), and operational commitments.

  • Foster strong collaboration and partnership across Consumer Business Continuity and key enterprise stakeholders.

  • Requires participation in a rotating on-call schedule for one week at a time, approximately every 4-6 weeks from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET, seven days a week, with 24-hour support provided through the toll-free number.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of leadership experience within the Financial Center and/or Contact Center line of business.

  • Understanding Business Continuity and operational resilience principles, including preparedness, response, recovery, and minimizing the impact of business disruptions.

  • Strong understanding of the Enterprise Risk Framework.

  • Strategic, solutions-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams to achieve shared objectives.

  • Ability to build partnerships and foster a positive, inclusive team culture within a diverse workforce.

  • Solid understanding of Consumer business operations and cross-functional partner dependencies across the organization.

  • Experience managing operational disruptions, incident response activities, and business recovery efforts.

  • Ability to assess business impacts and drive timely resolution through effective stakeholder engagement and coordination.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver results.

Cutting-edge technology: Do you have a passion for technology? Great, we do, too. At Breezeline, you will get the opportunity to manage, influence, play, create, fix, and re-shape the industry.

Summary

Under general supervision, the Customer and Network Facing Technician is a universal technician that is responsible for performing field installation and service work, troubleshooting, repair and maintenance of cable television, internet, and telephony systems. This role supports the growth of the system by ensuring the quality performance of technical services, installation setup, testing, and maintenance of all current and future products and services over Hybrid Fiber Coax (HFC) and Fiber to the Home (FTTH) networks. The incumbent ensures the quality of services provided to end-users meets or exceeds established industry and company performance standards and complies with FCC requirements and protocol.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, disconnect, and troubleshoot television, high-speed internet, telephony, and automation systems for residential and business clients.

  • Performs preventative maintenance and repair of the HFC and FTTH networks, including all associated equipment, in accordance with company engineering standards.

  • Read and accurately interpret system/network design maps.

  • Install and replace HFC physical plant network components such as coax, actives, passives, grounding systems, pedestals, riser guards, conduit, etc., according to technical specifications.

  • Identify and repair upstream and downstream ingress.

  • Complete end-of-line network testing to meet technical specifications.

  • Regularly test all HFC network components using test equipment including: signal level meters, volt-ohm meters, leakage detector, Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR), and Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR).

  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot, and update records of standby power supplies according to technical specifications.

  • Troubleshoot and repair basic distribution problems associated with RF, AC, and DC elements of the forward and reverse plant.

  • Restore system service outages.

  • Perform CLI rideouts and monitor and repair signal leakages.

  • Maintain tools and equipment inventory.

  • Accurately complete work orders in a timely manner.

  • Maintain, secure, and stock assigned vehicle and equipment.

  • Ensure productivity is being tracked through company applications (e.g., NRBY, WFX, Stratusync, iGlass).

  • Work alongside Headend personnel to properly OTDR any damaged fiber.

  • Properly assist on projects such as Remote Phy, 5-85 Mhz, Node activation, E2E testing on new properties, etc.

  • Prepare for daily work assignments by requisitioning equipment and supplies from the warehouse and stocking the vehicle as needed.

  • Maintain company truck and other equipment per service requirements and safety guidelines.

  • Drive a company vehicle between office/home, warehouse, and work sites in a safe and courteous manner, and in accordance with all laws and company policies.

  • Communicate with dispatch (via WFX, phone, etc.) for assistance, status on current installs, or new service requests.

  • Consult with supervisor and other technicians for advice and assistance as needed.

  • Interact with customers in a professional, courteous manner, including when responding to escalations and repeated customer concerns.

  • Educate customers regarding their existing and new services and promote other company services.

  • Comply with all safety procedures and policies.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Integrity: Tactful, maintains confidence, fosters an ethical work environment, prevents inappropriate behaviors by coworkers.

  • Initiative: Brings about great results from ordinary circumstances; prepares for problems or opportunities in advance; transforms leads or ideas into productive business outcomes; undertakes additional responsibilities and responds to situations as they arise without supervision.

  • Planning, Prioritizing, and Goal Setting: Prepares for emerging customer needs; manages multiple projects; determines project urgency; uses goals to guide actions and creates detailed action plans.

  • Communication: Clearly conveys information through a variety of media (verbal, written, e-mail, v-mail, etc.) in a way that engages the audience and helps them understand and remember the message; listens well.

  • Self-Development and Continuous Learning: Stays informed of current industry trends; actively identifies opportunities for learning; learns and applies new concepts to improve job performance; shares information with others on the job; takes responsibility for career development.

  • Customer Focus: Demonstrates a high level of service delivery; does what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; addresses and resolves service failures; prioritizes customer needs; makes customers and their needs a primary focus of actions.

  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Recognizes others’ perspective, objectives and motives; works collaboratively towards solutions that benefit all involved parties and help accomplish common Cogeco objectives.

  • Attention to Detail: Alert in high intensity/high-risk environments; follows detailed procedures and ensures accuracy in documentation and data; carefully monitors gauges, instruments, or processes; concentrates on routine work detail and organizes and maintains a system of records.

  • Adaptability: Works with little supervision; manages ambiguity and autonomy; flexibility to work in an unstructured environment; deals effectively with uncertainty and change.

Qualifications

  • Valid state driver’s license and a good driving record within Company required standards.

  • Certifications and licenses, as required by state and municipal laws.

  • Successfully meet (and maintain) additional background check requirements for specialized projects/services.

  • Preferred 3 years or more of work experience in a comparable field (e.g., related hands-on trade role) or a one-year certificate from college or technical school; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum of one year of direct customer service experience.

  • PC and Windows software skills.

  • Able to work required shifts and overtime (if necessary), including regularly scheduled days as well as unscheduled days and beyond regular work hours (including on-call rotation) due to customer or operational demands.

  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

  • Communicates professionally and effectively with customers, vendors, and employees.

  • Ability to apply concepts of basic mathematics, algebra, and geometry.

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.

  • Ability to accurately measure distances, using tapes or other measuring devices.

  • Ability to adhere to Local, Federal regulations and Company policies.

  • Ability to carry, climb, and operate extension ladders up to and including 32’ high and up to 75 pounds.

  • Ability to Operate Aerial Lift Equipment rated with a 350lb maximum total load capacity.

  • Ability to differentiate between different sizes and colors of wires.

  • Ability to drive company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner.

  • Ability to make cable connections in tight spaces by bending, reaching, twisting.

  • Ability to operate appropriate computer or test equipment associated with position.

This entry-level role offers hands-on design, analysis, and project execution experience, with mentorship, training, and opportunities to grow your expertise from day one.

In this role, you will serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of Premier accounts, focusing heavily on modernizing their infrastructure through Switching and Campus Fabric architectures. Be responsible for designing resilient, scalable, and secure network environments that empower our customers to achieve their digital transformation goals.

Beyond design and deployment, your impact will be measured by your ability to bridge the gap between complex engineering and executive stakeholders. You will act as a mentor and technical lead, ensuring that our internal teams and the customer’s engineering staff are fully enabled to support and evolve these environments.   • Consistent record of designing and running Campus Fabric deployments for enterprise environments.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical staff and business leadership.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: AI Researcher
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/21/2026

Meet the Team

Join Cisco's AI Platform Team to shape the future of enterprise AI. We're building next-generation infrastructure that powers intelligent, secure, and scalable AI solutions across Cisco's ecosystem—from advancing Small Language Model capabilities and building Agentic frameworks to ensuring trustworthy AI deployment at scale. You'll join as a core member of our team, working with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to transform research into real business impact. In this role, you'll translate cutting-edge AI research into production solutions for internal business units and external customers. If you're passionate about solving hard technical problems and shaping how AI transforms the enterprise, this is where you'll make it happen.

Your Impact

As an Applied AI Researcher, you will work with other AI researchers to take methods from paper and prototype into production models on NeuralFabric—domain models, RL, and agent simulation that Cisco and customers can actually use.

  • Partner with AI researchers to design, train, and fine-tune Small Language Models for network, security, observability, and operations problems using current post-training techniques.

  • Advance reinforcement learning, Auto Gym, and agent-simulation methods with the research team, and turn those methods into reusable training and evaluation recipes on the platform.

  • Define evaluation methods and promotion gates with researchers and engineers so model quality is measurable and repeatable.

  • Stay current with LLMs, SLMs, multi-modal models, and agents, and apply that research to internal and customer use cases through technical deep-dives—not as a dedicated forward-deployment owner.

Minimum Qualifications

  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in applied AI/ML research or engineering.

  • Experience independently designing, training, and fine-tuning language models for production or applied research use.

  • Previous use of Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or Hugging Face Transformers.

  • Experience with advanced post-training methods such as LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, instruction tuning, supervised fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human or AI feedback.

  • Track record of leading applied AI projects from research through production deployment, with documented outcomes across more than one domain or problem.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications in top AI conferences such as ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, ICML, NAACL, or NeurIPS.

  • Experience with Small Language Models, efficient architectures, model compression, reinforcement learning, gym-style training environments, or agent evaluation harnesses.

  • Familiarity with networking, cybersecurity, observability, or IT operations domains.

  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), advanced evaluation methodologies, and model promotion or lineage gates.

  • Ability to work closely with other AI researchers and engineers, explain technical work and collaborate with business-unit or customer partners when a use case requires it.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

(30%)

Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth per caption; and the ability to adjust focus.

If a Team Member has a medical condition or disability that prevents them from wearing the mask, Cobb will engage in an interactive process to determine whether a reasonable accommodation can be provided that addresses the safety concerns associated with the Pandemic and allow the Team Member to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Chemicals Commonly Used: Formaldehyde is in use at the facility. Also used is disinfectants and lubricants.

  • Safety: Team member is expected to follow all applicable safety policies and procedures. These include but are not limited to Hazard Communication, Respiratory Protection, LOTO and Personal Protective Equipment. Team member is expected to identify, address and mitigate safety related risks.

The relocation is currently proposed to take effect by early 2029.

Key Responsibilities:

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career, these responsibilities include some of the following.

  • Act as the Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation representative on cross-functional medical development teams, shaping strategy for assigned infectious disease assets.
  • Apply clinical pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic and modelling & simulation principles to support efficient clinical development, risk management, registration and lifecycle management.
  • Play a central role in selecting and justifying doses and dosing regimens, including characterising exposure-response relationships and recommendations for relevant patient populations.
  • Develop and apply population PK, PK/PD and exposure-response models, and conduct simulations to inform clinical trial design and development decisions.
  • Present clinical pharmacology strategy and model-based evidence to governance boards, development teams and regulatory agencies.
  • Apply relevant regulatory guidance to clinical pharmacology plans, study designs, analyses and development strategies.
  • Advance model-informed drug development through high-quality scientific collaboration, external engagement, publication and conference presentation where appropriate.
  • Design and interpret clinical pharmacology studies evaluating intrinsic and extrinsic factors affecting pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics.
  • Identify appropriate opportunities to apply PBPK and other in silico approaches to evaluate drug interactions and special populations.
  • Author and contribute to clinical development and regulatory documents, including protocols, reports, investigator brochures, briefing books, clinical pharmacology summaries and submission packages.
  • Contribute clinical pharmacology evidence throughout regulatory interactions, from development-stage meetings through registration and product labelling.
  • Learn and apply emerging modelling and simulation methodologies to improve programme efficiency and the quality of investment and development decisions.
  • Collaborate effectively with clinicians, statisticians, biologists, regulatory colleagues, drug metabolism scientists and other matrix partners.
  • Remain hands-on with quantitative analyses while providing strategic scientific leadership and clear recommendations to stakeholders.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications & Skills

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant life science discipline, such as a PhD, PharmD or MD, supporting a successful career in quantitative clinical pharmacology within pharmaceutical research and development.
  • Substantial experience in human clinical pharmacology, clinical pharmacokinetics, modelling & simulation and model-informed drug development, including the design, analysis and reporting of clinical studies.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience applying population PK, PK/PD or exposure-response models to clinical development questions.
  • Practical experience with common quantitative clinical pharmacology tools, including NONMEM or Monolix and R.
  • Experience using quantitative evidence to influence dose selection, clinical development plans and cross-functional programme decisions.
  • Experience contributing to regulatory interactions or submission documents and applying relevant regulatory guidance to clinical development plans and studies.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:

  • Demonstrated expertise in pharmacometrics and modelling & simulation; experience in vaccines, infectious diseases or anti-infectives would be beneficial but is not essential.
  • Knowledge of, or the ability to quickly learn, the mechanisms, endpoints, progression and treatment of diseases within infectious disease and other relevant therapy areas.
  • Experience supporting late-stage clinical development, registration, lifecycle management, regulatory briefing books, dossiers or clinical pharmacology product labelling.
  • Additional experience with Python, WinNonlin, Simcyp, SAS, MATLAB, PBPK or translational PK/PD approaches, alongside substantial human clinical development experience.
  • Ability to communicate complex quantitative evidence clearly and succinctly, build effective collaborations and take personal accountability for delivery.
  • Curiosity about emerging methodologies and technology, including high-performance computing and AI-enabled tools, with a willingness to learn and apply new approaches.

Power Every Connection. Build Relationships. Create Impact.

Geen dag is hetzelfde.

MILWAUKEE is wereldwijd één van de toonaangevende fabrikanten van Heavy-Duty elektrisch gereedschap, accessoires, Outdoor Power Equipment, handgereedschap, opslagoplossingen en persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen voor professionele gebruikers.

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van de elektrotechnische installatiesector én aan de verdere groei van Milwaukee in Nederland.

description:
Job Description

Are you energized by leadership, education, and the development of partnerships with key External Experts and Professional Bodies? If so, this Field Based Medical Science Liaison role could be an ideal opportunity to explore.

As Field Based Medical Science Liaison (MSL), you will be responsible for execution of the external engagement strategy aligned to the therapeutic portfolio, as well as implementation of the external engagement plan aligned to Therapy area strategies, driving a consistent approach to carrying out engagement activities in the field.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career, these responsibilities include some of the following…

  • Work with medical colleagues and other business partners to identify External Experts, professional groups, decision makers and other key stakeholders in the assigned therapy area and or geography

  • Respond compliantly to unsolicited information requests from healthcare professionals and associated individuals regarding licensed or un-licensed GSK medicines and indications; ensure all medical information responses are factual, fair and balanced, scientifically rigorous and strictly comply with GSK standards and policies and with local codes of practice, guidelines and laws to ensure the strictest requirements are met

  • Disseminate important safety information to the healthcare profession as directed by the Medical Affairs or Research and Development teams or the Dear Healthcare Provider Letter (DHPL) process. Conduct scientific exchange for a GSK medicine that is on label or consistent with the label to inform and educate HCPs on the appropriate use of our medicines in patients. Deliver scientific / pipeline presentations to formulary committees and HCPs per documented unsolicited request

  • Maintain expertise in the evolving scientific / therapeutic area and in competitor medicines and vaccines.

  • Attend and contribute (if required) to medical portion of regional account planning/training sessions

  • Attend both national and regional scientific/medical meetings to gain medical voice of the customer on recent data being presented on products and disease states of interest to GSK

  • Support clinical development activities and programs including GSK and Investigator sponsored studies as well as collaborating with R&D staff to improve site performance. Provide general insight into GSK research interests and field inquiries regarding investigator sponsored scientific or clinical research projects.

  • Conduct individual discussions and meetings with steering committee members, advisory board members, consultants etc., on topics related to the work being conducted with GSK (e.g. for clinical research investigators, the conduct or publication of clinical research sponsored by GSK)

  • Provide scientific training for GSK sales representatives regarding GSK products and the conditions they treat utilizing approved Sales Training materials. Provide training to individual HCPs to prepare them to speak on behalf of GSK, and assist with GSK-sponsored speaker training events

  • Partner with matrix colleagues (e.g., sales, marketing, market access, etc.) to ensure strategies and business plans are both patient and business focused, and adding value to the external expert

Basic Qualifications:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  • PA, NP, MSN, or advanced degree (with a medical or clinical focus)

  • Two or more years' experience in pharmacology and pharmacotherapy in humans and has experience practically applying this knowledge in a clinical setting.

  • Must live within territory specified

Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Pharm. D or Ph. D, DNP, or MD (with a medical or clinical focus)

  • Residency of Post-Doctoral training in a clinical/pharmaceutical practice setting

  • Pharmaceutical industry experience or medical liaison experience, with specific therapeutic area experience a plus. Qualified candidates may be considered for Sr. MSL

  • Hepatitis B, Hep C, MASH, or other liver disease experience

  • Previous clinical experience in situations where direct/or indirect decision-making authority for patient care was demonstrated (e.g. direct patient care, treatment protocol development, drug therapy guidelines development, traditional clinical pharmacy practice settings)

  • Above average computer literacy, including experience with software applications
