title: Pricing Analyst
description:
We’re excited about your interest in pursuing the next step in your career with US Foods! Your continuous growth and development is critical to our success.

US Foods is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our US Foods Application Accommodation Line at 855-873-2468. You will be prompted to leave a message. Please state the specifics of the assistance needed and your contact information. A member of our HR department will return your call within two business days.

NOTE: Before you begin your internal job search, please review the criteria you will need to start the process.

BASIC PURPOSE
Execute pricing strategy at the distribution center (DC) level to support company margin goals and local "Go to Market" strategy. Identify margin improvement opportunities by managing area-wide Daily Sales Below Cost (DSBC) process.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Review and manage price deviations and exceptions for Territory Managers (TMs) aligned to designated DC. This includes evaluating requests for commission-based adjustments (CBAs), self-funded deviations, and price approvals.

Answer pricing queries escalated from Sales and other USF employees as required for the designated DC.

Analyze and develop pricing recommendations to support bids for local customers (e.g., excluding schools) and conduct special pricing reviews for new customer acquisition for the designated DC, in partnership with Strategic Pricing Manager.

Manage area DSBC reporting process to improve area margins. Identify costing errors and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve.

Execute weekly promotional pricing in designated DC.

Monitor and identify opportunities by analyzing and reporting on margin and market pricing. Work closely with District Sales Managers (DSMs) on auditing ongoing local self-funded deviations.

Utilize Merlin to identify product and category opportunities for pricing strategies. Complete ad-hoc pricing analysis as required by the Strategic Pricing Manager, Area President or Region Pricing Manager.

Manage and upload exceptions for vendor price list from local/regional suppliers.

Maintain customer pricing rationale (CPR) back-up for area.

SUPERVISION
None

RELATIONSHIPS
Internal: Pricing Manager; Region Pricing Manager; Area President; AVP of Merchandising and Marketing and area sales team (VP Sales, Sales Manager, DSMs, CSC, and TMs)

External: Customers, vendors

QUALIFICATIONS
Education/Training: Bachelor’s Degree, or minimum 3 years of pricing experience required.

Related Experience: Pricing experience within foodservice or food manufacturing companies highly desired. Strong quantitative and analytical skills required.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
• Proven experience working with and supporting sales teams; strong business acumen and interpersonal skills a must.
• Proficiency required in Microsoft Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, and Microsoft Outlook.
• Able to access information within established pricing databases and/or analyze data made available from analysts. Knowledge of the PRIME pricing system highly desired.

This role may also receive an annual incentive plan bonus.

​Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. To review available benefits, please click here: https://www.usfoods.com/careers/benefits.html.

Grade: 12

description:

title: Director Corporate Travel & Expense Management
description:
At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success. We are industry leaders due to the innumerable talents of our approximately 5000 strong professional team. Our people thrive in an entrepreneurial and culturally-diverse environment, where innovative thinking, collaboration and efficient execution are highly valued. Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.


Director, Global Travel & Expense Management

Location: Miami, FL (Hybrid)

Lead the Future of Global Travel at World Fuel

World Fuel is seeking an experienced travel leader to oversee and evolve our global travel and expense program.

As Director, Global Travel & Expense Management, you will be responsible for the strategy, governance, technology, supplier partnerships, traveler experience, policy management, and operational performance of a complex global program supporting employees across multiple countries and business units.

Reporting to the Head of Indirect Procurement, this highly visible leadership role will drive the ongoing transformation of World Fuel's travel and expense ecosystem while delivering a best-in-class experience for travelers, improving compliance, strengthening duty of care, and optimizing costs.

This is an exciting opportunity for a travel industry professional who enjoys driving change, leading global initiatives, partnering with senior executives, and building scalable programs that support business growth.

What You'll Do

Lead Our Global Travel Program

  • Own the strategy, governance, and performance of World Fuel's global travel program.
  • Serve as the executive point of contact for travel-related initiatives, escalations, and program enhancements.
  • Ensure travel services are cost-effective, compliant, traveler-focused, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Drive initiatives that improve traveler experience, support business needs, and increase program value.

Drive Travel Technology & Transformation

  • Lead ongoing optimization of travel and expense platforms, including implementation, governance, testing, adoption, and change management.
  • Partner with IT, Finance, HR, Security, and external providers to enhance system capabilities and user experience.
  • Identify opportunities to automate processes and improve efficiency across the travel ecosystem.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement across travel and expense technologies.

Own Travel Policy, Compliance & Duty of Care

  • Maintain and evolve the global travel policy and governance framework.
  • Partner with Security, HR, Risk, and business leaders to support traveler safety and crisis management programs.
  • Monitor policy compliance, exceptions, and adoption trends.
  • Ensure global travel practices align with company standards and regulatory requirements.

Manage Strategic Supplier Partnerships

  • Lead relationships with travel management companies, booking platforms, airlines, hotels, ground transportation providers, and travel payment partners.
  • Partner with Procurement to negotiate contracts and optimize supplier performance.
  • Establish service level expectations and measure supplier effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce costs, improve compliance, and maximize program benefits.

Leverage Data to Drive Better Decisions

  • Develop meaningful KPIs, management reporting, and governance processes.
  • Analyze travel spend, booking behavior, supplier performance, traveler satisfaction, policy compliance, and program utilization.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that improve business outcomes.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders to forecast travel demand and support long-term planning.

Lead Expense & Travel Payment Programs

  • Own the corporate card and travel payment strategy.
  • Manage card issuance, compliance, delinquency management, disputes, controls, and traveler support.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, and Accounts Payable to optimize payment solutions and reporting.
  • Evaluate emerging capabilities including virtual cards, automation, and enhanced payment technologies.

Provide Executive-Level Leadership

  • Serve as the trusted advisor to senior leaders on travel strategy, spend management, policy, and traveler experience.
  • Lead and develop global travel administration resources and supporting teams.
  • Influence stakeholders across business functions and geographies to drive successful outcomes.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience leading a global corporate travel program.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and managing:
    • Travel Management Companies (TMCs)
    • Online Booking Tools (Concur, Navan, or similar platforms)
    • Corporate card and travel payment programs
  • Proven experience leading travel technology implementations and transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of travel policy, governance, risk management, duty of care, and compliance.
  • Deep knowledge of airline, hotel, GDS, NDC, and travel supplier commercial models.
  • Exceptional supplier management, negotiation, and strategic sourcing capabilities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into business decisions.
  • Ability to effectively influence senior stakeholders across global organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing global travel programs within a complex multinational organization.
  • Experience with travel and expense transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading outsourced providers and global cross-functional teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Supply Chain, Travel Management, Finance, or a related field.

What Makes You Successful

We're looking for someone who:

  • Thinks strategically and executes effectively.
  • Builds strong partnerships across all levels of the organization.
  • Balances traveler experience, compliance, risk, and cost management.
  • Is energized by transformation and continuous improvement.

title: Patient Companion | Part-Time | Days
description:
Job Description Summary

Under the supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN), the Patient Companion performs a variety of patient care, patient safety monitoring, and clerical support duties to ensure the delivery of safe, quality, patient-centered care. This position serves as a Patient Safety Companion when assigned, providing continuous observation of patients who require close monitoring to maintain safety. When patient observation is not required, the employee functions as a Patient Care Technician (PCT) and/or Unit Secretary, supporting direct patient care activities and unit operations.

The employee demonstrates professional conduct, ethical behavior, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to maintaining a safe and therapeutic environment for patients, families, visitors, and staff.

Entity

Medical University Hospital Authority (MUHA)

Worker Type

Employee

Worker Sub-Type​

Regular

Cost Center

CC005694 LAN - Patient Sitter (LMC)

Pay Rate Type

Hourly

Pay Grade

Health-18

Scheduled Weekly Hours

24

Work Shift

Day (United States of America)

Job Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Patient Companion Responsibilities

  • Provides continuous one-to-one observation of assigned patients to ensure safety at all times.
  • Maintains constant visual contact with the patient and never leaves the patient unattended unless relieved by authorized staff.
  • Observes and reports changes in patient condition, behavior, or safety risks immediately to the Registered Nurse.
  • Assist patients with activities of daily living (ADLs), including toileting, feeding, ambulation, and repositioning as directed.
  • Promotes patient comfort while maintaining a safe environment.
  • Intervenes appropriately to prevent falls, self-harm, removal of medical devices, or other unsafe behaviors according to hospital policy.
  • Documents observations and activities as required.
  • Communicates effectively with nursing staff regarding patient status and concerns.
  • Maintains patient dignity, confidentiality, and privacy at all times.

Patient Care Technician (PCT) Responsibilities

  • Provides direct patient care under the supervision of a Registered Nurse.
  • Obtains and records vital signs, height, weight, intake and output, and other patient data as assigned.
  • Assists patients with bathing, grooming, dressing, feeding, mobility, and other personal care needs.
  • Assists with patient transport, transfers, and ambulation using proper body mechanics and safety techniques.
  • Collects specimens and performs delegated clinical tasks within scope of training and competency.
  • Maintains patient rooms, equipment, and supplies in a clean, organized, and safe condition.
  • Recognizes and reports changes in patient condition promptly to the Registered Nurse.
  • Assists with admission, discharge, and transfer procedures.
  • Supports a decentralized, patient-centered approach to care and contributes to achieving desired patient outcomes.

Unit Secretary Responsibilities

  • Processes physician orders accurately and timely according to hospital procedures.
  • Maintains patient charts, forms, and records in an organized and compliant manner.
  • Ensures patient charts contain required forms and documentation.
  • Answers telephones, relays messages, and communicates effectively with physicians, staff, patients, and visitors.
  • Performs clerical and data entry functions related to patient care and unit operations.
  • Orders and maintains adequate inventory of unit supplies through materials management.
  • Assists with scheduling, record maintenance, and other administrative functions as assigned.
  • Supports efficient workflow at the nurses' station and throughout the unit.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Cross-trains and functions in multiple roles based on departmental needs and staffing requirements.
  • Participates in orientation, ongoing education, competency validation, and performance improvement activities.
  • Adheres to hospital policies, procedures, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and organizational standards.
  • Demonstrates ethical, professional, and appropriate behavior at all times.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Additional Job Description

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

Experience

  • Previous healthcare experience preferred.
  • Experience as a Patient Care Technician, Nursing Assistant, Patient Sitter, Unit Secretary, or related healthcare role preferred.

Certifications/Licensure

  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification is required.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, lifting, pushing, and pulling.
  • Ability to lift and move patients and equipment in accordance with hospital safety guidelines.
  • Ability to remain alert and attentive during extended periods of patient observation.
  • Ability to perform duties requiring manual dexterity, visual acuity, and effective verbal communication.

Working Conditions

  • Works in patient care areas with potential exposure to infectious diseases, bodily fluids, and other healthcare-related hazards.
  • May be required to work weekends, holidays, evenings, nights, and on-call shifts as needed.
  • Must comply with all infection prevention and safety protocols.

Performance Expectations

  • Maintains patient safety as the highest priority.
  • Demonstrates compassion, respect, and excellent customer service.
  • Supports teamwork and collaboration across disciplines.
  • Consistently follows hospital policies, procedures, and standards of care.
  • Contributes to positive patient experiences and quality outcomes.

title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/19/2026

The successful applicant will be performing work on US Government classified environments, and therefore, must be a U.S. Person (i.e., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee). This position may also perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen on U.S. soil.

Meet the Team

Join the Splunk Vulnerability Management team, where we are dedicated to securing our products to protect the company and our global customers. We take a security-first approach to protecting the company, ensuring the integrity and resilience of the critical infrastructure our customers rely on to power their operations. We are a hardworking, collaborative group that balances a thorough, security-first attitude with a culture that values camaraderie and a good laugh. As we solve complex security challenges and commit to continuous learning in the face of evolving threats, we invite you to play a pivotal role in leading vulnerability assessments and setting new standards. If you are looking to foster an environment where security excellence meets multi-functional business collaboration, we would love to have you on our team.


Your Impact

You’ll be at the heart of keeping Splunk secure by turning complex security data into clear, actionable insights. You won’t just be digging through vulnerabilities or other weaknesses; you’ll be setting the standards that keep our platforms resilient against new threats. We want someone who enjoys partnering directly with engineering teams to address risks head-on and get critical fixes across the finish line. You’ll also be our go-to person for navigating audits and compliance, helping us focus on the spirit of security requirements rather than just blindly following the letter of the law. Ultimately, your goal is to cut through the noise, prioritize what actually matters, and be part of a defense strategy that keeps our company and our customers safe.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Vulnerability Management Lifecycle: 3+ years of experience in the vulnerability management lifecycle, including the assessment, prioritization, and hands-on remediation of security vulnerabilities within complex infrastructure.

  • Compliance & Standards: Proven experience in assessing or applying configuration compliance standards (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs) to harden infrastructure and cloud environments to meet regulatory requirements (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC2, HIPAA, FedRAMP)

  • Risk-Based Prioritization: Demonstrated experience utilizing threat modeling and CVSS scoring to prioritize vulnerabilities based on business impact and technical risk.

  • Container & Orchestration Security: Experience securing containerized environments and orchestration platforms, specifically Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Cloud & SaaS Architecture: Technical experience with cloud operational models and the security requirements of SaaS architectures built on microservices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Splunk & SPL Proficiency: Demonstrated experience using Splunk and Search Processing Language (SPL) to query output from tooling, visualize security data, and build automated reporting dashboards for vulnerability tracking.

  • CI/CD & IaC Security: Documented experience integrating or using security scanning tools in CI/CD pipelines and auditing Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to identify configuration errors prior to deployment.

  • Proactive Communication: Proven ability to translate complex technical security risks into actionable insights for both technical engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Self-Driven Growth: Demonstrated track record of self-motivation and continuous self-learning, with the ability to independently research and adapt to emerging security threats and technologies.

  • Hands-on configuration and management of enterprise scanning platforms (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7).

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Ethics Officer- P3
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

29 September 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 Central European Time (Rome)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

This position is based in HQ, Rome (Italy), in the Ethics Office (ETO) and reports to the Senior Ethics Officer.

JOB PURPOSE:

To support the enhancement of a robust ethical framework within the World Food Programme (WFP). The role involves managing conflict of interest disclosures, advising on policy development, supporting retaliation protection processes, and fostering internal and external relationships to promote a culture of ethics and accountability across the organization.

ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide substantive input to the definition and the implementation of the Ethics Office Strategy, and Work Plan
• Provide timely advice and guidance on ethics and standards of conduct to WFP employees and WFP management, and properly track and record all queries.
• Contribute to the management of the annual disclosure programme by reviewing disclosed conflicts of interest, providing advice and ensuring the smooth rollout of the programme
• Develop and deliver training programmes, e-learning modules, and/or train-the trainer modules on ethics, values, principles and standards by ensuring smooth facilitation
• Provide advice and review in the drafting of WFP policy documents, circulars, and regulations where ethical aspects are involved or whenever ETO is requested to provide advice by other departments.
• Provide advice and support to the review of requests for protection against retaliation, drafting memos and responses to complainants as necessary.
• Contribute to enhancing the presence of the Ethics Office on WFP internal and external websites or through other online channels or relevant publications.
• Provide analysis, draft and support as may be required for reporting on and promoting the overall work of the Ethics Office.

• Build positive and effective cooperation and relationships internally within WFP and externally across the United Nations and with the Rome-based agencies to align messages and activities, as appropriate.

• Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Ethics Officer in furtherance of the mandate of the Ethics Office and a strong culture of ethics and accountability.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:
Education:
Advanced university degree in law, ethics, public administration, international affairs, compliance, or other related fields.
Experience:
5 years of relevant progressively responsible experience in legal advice, compliance, riskassessment, ethics or other related areas.
Knowledge & Skills:
• Theoretical understanding of ethics, compliance and risk-assessment.
• Provide advice and guidance to a wide range of stakeholders on different ethical issues.
• Technical knowledge of whistleblower protection policies, with demonstrated ability to write legal memoranda and notes to the file.
• Act with integrity, independence and impartiality in line with the independent and confidential role of the Ethics Office and in the best interest of WFP.
• Excellent interpersonal skills to be able to work and respect other colleagues with different backgrounds.
• Demonstrated ability to deliver training to small and medium sized audiences.
• Ability to listen attentively to those seeking advice or otherwise seeking protection from retaliation.
Language:
Fluency (level C) in English language. Intermediate knowledge (level B) of a second official UN language: Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, and/or Portuguese (a WFP working language).

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

This position is classified as an International Professional role and is open to candidates of all nationalities.

Mobility is and continues to be a core contractual requirement in WFP. This position is however classified as “non-rotational” which means the incumbent shall not be subject to the regular reassignment process unless the position is reclassified as rotational. The selected candidate will be employed on a fixed-term contract with a probationary period of one year. This position is open to both internal and external candidates.

WFP offers an attractive compensation and benefits package in line with ICSC standards (http://icsc.un.org) including basic salary, post adjustment, relocation entitlement, visa, travel and shipment allowances, 30 days’ annual leave, home leave, an education grant for dependent children, a pension plan, and medical insurance.

The selected candidate will be required to relocate to Rome, Italy to take up this assignment.

WFP LEADERSHIP FRAMEWORK

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

Click here to access WFP Leadership Framework

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

NO FEE DISCLAIMER

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION

  • All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.

  • We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.

  • If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is only for technical issues with an application - unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply.

All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. title: Freight Handler
description:
Energy hits different on the dock.

Not built for desk jobs? Perfect.

Skip the gym. Move freight instead.

We’re looking for Freight Handlers who love being super active. At Roadrunner, you’ll help keep freight moving safely, efficiently, and on time in a fast-paced environment where hard work matters.

The Freight Handler is a mission‑critical contributor to our Operations team, ensuring freight moves through our network with precision, speed, and zero compromise to safety or quality. As our Smart Network™ continues to scale nationwide, the reliability of our dock operations directly impacts transit performance, customer satisfaction, and the integrity of our long‑haul model.

This role exists to keep freight flowing efficiently through the Nashville service center—executing high‑accuracy loading, unloading, tagging, and movement of shipments that power our metro‑to‑metro network. Success in this role means maintaining consistent throughput, minimizing rehandling, preventing damage, and supporting a clean, safe, and high‑performance dock environment.



What you’ll do

1. Execute high‑precision freight handling

  • Load, unload, stack, and secure freight with accuracy and care to prevent damage.
  • Follow work orders and verbal instructions to determine freight movement priorities.
  • Apply tags, labels, and documentation to ensure full shipment visibility.
  • Assemble and band freight bundles to maintain stability and compliance.

2. Operate equipment safely and efficiently

  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, hoists, and other industrial equipment to move freight.
  • Install blocking, bracing, and padding to secure freight in trailers.
  • Maintain equipment cleanliness and support routine operational upkeep.
  • Follow all safety rules, hazardous materials protocols, and operational procedures.

3. Maintain dock flow and operational readiness

  • Transport freight between dock areas, trailers, and designated storage zones.
  • Keep work areas clean, organized, and free of hazards to support continuous flow.
  • Assist machine operators and cross functional teams as needed.
  • Support proactive efforts to meet service center throughput and quality goals.

4. Support cross‑functional coordination

  • Communicate effectively with operations leadership and dock supervisors.
  • Surface issues, delays, or safety concerns with clarity and urgency.
  • Collaborate with team members to maintain a high performance dock environment.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment when navigating ambiguous or fast changing situations.

5. Uphold safety, accuracy, and performance standards

  • Prioritize tasks to meet operational timelines without sacrificing quality.
  • Manage multiple assignments simultaneously in a high velocity environment.
  • Ensure all freight is handled in alignment with company standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

What you bring

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1–3 months of related experience or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to read and interpret safety rules, operating instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Forklift driver qualification required.
  • Hazardous Material Training preferred.
  • Ability to perform basic math (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) using whole numbers, fractions, and decimals.
  • Experience in freight, logistics, warehouse, or LTL environments is a plus.
  • Proven ability to prioritize, multitask, and maintain composure in a fast paced setting.

How you operate

  • You think in systems, not tasks.
  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just activity.
  • You move with urgency while maintaining accuracy and safety.
  • You communicate clearly, directly, and respectfully.
  • You adapt quickly when priorities shift.
  • You solve problems with sound judgment, even when structure is limited.
  • You support your team and contribute to a high performance culture.

title: Director, Client Engagement – Maternity Leave Coverage
description:
About Us

David Yurman is a celebrated American jewelry company founded in New York by David Yurman, a sculptor, and his wife, Sybil, a painter and ceramicist. When the artists began collaborating, their goal was simply to make beautiful objects to wear. Led today by their son Evan, David Yurman creates timeless, yet contemporary collections for women and men defined by inspiration, innovation, consummate craftsmanship and cable – the brand’s artistic signature. David Yurman collections are available at retail stores throughout the United States, Canada, Hong Kong and France and at locations worldwide, through their exclusive authorized fine jewelry and timepiece network of retailers.

Our Values

At David Yurman, creativity, innovation and impeccable craftsmanship are at the core of everything we do. Fueled by the energy of our hometown, New York City, artistic passion informs each and every jewelry design. The Yurman family’s guiding vision continually defines and redefines what it means to be the preeminent American luxury jewelry brand. We are committed to responsible business and social practices and to the protection and advancement of human rights. We believe in partnering with others who share these values and understand their importance.

Job Description

Director, Client Engagement – Maternity Leave Coverage : November – April

Overview

David Yurman is seeking an experienced Director of Client Engagement to provide maternity leave coverage for the Client Engagement team. This temporary leadership role will ensure continuity of the Client Engagement function while advancing several key business priorities during the coverage period.

The Director will provide day-to-day leadership for the Client Engagement team and oversee the execution of David Yurman’s established clienteling strategy, with a focus on strengthening client relationships, driving repeat business, enabling sales teams, and increasing adoption of clienteling practices and tools.

This role will partner closely with Retail, Commercial, Marketing, Client Experience, Events, Learning & Transformation, Analytics, and Technology teams to ensure Client Engagement priorities are translated into meaningful and actionable programs for the sales organization.

In addition to overseeing the ongoing responsibilities of the function, the Director will be accountable for advancing a defined set of priority initiatives during the coverage period, including foundational clienteling programs, technology enhancements, and a coordinated Client Engagement activation calendar.

The ideal candidate is a strong operator, collaborative leader, and experienced clienteling practitioner who can quickly integrate into an established team, navigate a cross-functional organization, and balance day-to-day leadership with delivery against key initiatives.

Key Priorities During the Coverage Period

In addition to providing leadership and continuity for the Client Engagement function, the Director will be responsible for advancing three priority workstreams with defined milestones and deliverables during the maternity leave coverage period.

1. Clienteling Foundations & Retail Enablement

Partner closely with Retail leadership to execute foundational programs that strengthen clienteling behaviors, measurement, and enablement across the sales organization.

  • Lead the rollout and adoption of an enhanced Client Engagement measurement framework, creating greater visibility into clienteling activity, behaviors, and commercial outcomes.

  • Partner with Retail leadership to translate measurement insights into actionable priorities and opportunities for sales teams.

  • Support the launch and adoption of new devices and related capabilities designed to enable sales teams to more effectively execute clienteling activities.

  • Coordinate business readiness, communications, training, and feedback loops across Retail and cross-functional partners to support successful adoption.

  • Monitor early adoption and performance, identifying barriers and opportunities to optimize execution.

Coverage Period Outcome: Measurement framework operationalized in partnership with Retail; new device capabilities successfully launched and adopted; and clear mechanisms in place to monitor engagement, adoption, and impact.

2. Clienteling Technology Enhancements

Partner with Technology and key business stakeholders to advance priority enhancements to David Yurman’s Clienteling application, with an initial focus on appointment booking and loyalty tracking capabilities.

  • Serve as the Client Engagement business lead for defining and prioritizing requirements for appointment booking enhancements within the Clienteling application.

  • Lead business requirements for enhanced loyalty tracking capabilities, helping provide sales teams with greater visibility into client engagement and relationship-building opportunities.

  • Translate Retail and Client Engagement needs into clear business requirements, use cases, workflows, and success criteria.

  • Facilitate alignment across Retail, Technology, Analytics, and other stakeholders on scope, priorities, dependencies, and key decisions.

  • Participate in solution design, testing, business readiness, and rollout planning as appropriate based on project timelines.

  • Maintain clear documentation of decisions, requirements, milestones, and outstanding work to enable a seamless transition at the conclusion of the coverage period.

Coverage Period Outcome: Priority business requirements defined and aligned; technology enhancements advanced through agreed-upon project milestones; and a clear roadmap and handoff established for work extending beyond the coverage period.

3. Client Engagement Activation Calendar

Lead a structured calendar of communications, campaigns, and activities that provides sales teams with clear, actionable opportunities to consistently engage clients and strengthen relationships.

  • Develop and manage an integrated Client Engagement activation calendar aligned with key commercial, product, marketing, event, and client moments.

  • Translate business priorities into actionable clienteling opportunities, providing sales teams with clear direction on who to contact, why to engage, and recommended actions.

  • Partner with Retail, Marketing, Product, Events, and Client Experience teams to coordinate outreach opportunities and ensure an integrated approach to field communications.

  • Establish a consistent communication cadence that keeps Client Engagement priorities visible and actionable for sales teams and field leadership.

  • Incorporate client segmentation, product priorities, events, appointments, relationship milestones, and other relevant triggers into activation planning.

  • Measure participation and outcomes where possible and incorporate performance insights and field feedback into future activities.

Coverage Period Outcome: A consistent and actionable Client Engagement calendar is in market, providing sales teams with coordinated opportunities to build, maintain, and strengthen client relationships throughout the coverage period.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

While the priority initiatives above represent specific deliverables for the maternity leave coverage period, the Director will also provide ongoing leadership and oversight of the Client Engagement function and its core responsibilities.

Client Engagement Strategy & Execution

  • Lead the execution of established Client Engagement strategies and priorities across client segments, product categories, and sales channels.

  • Identify opportunities to optimize existing clienteling programs and drive client acquisition, engagement, retention, and repeat business.

  • Maintain established Client Engagement objectives and KPIs, monitoring performance and partnering with key stakeholders to address opportunities and gaps.

  • Champion a client-centric mindset and reinforce consistent clienteling behaviors across Commercial and Retail teams.

  • Partner with Client Experience on engagement opportunities, including events, experiences, gifting, VIC programming, and other relationship-building initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Media, Product, Events, and Marketing Strategy teams to incorporate Client Engagement opportunities into relevant campaigns, activations, and client journeys.

  • Support targeted client outreach and acquisition programs aligned with key product, category, and commercial priorities.

  • Provide Client Engagement leadership and perspective for seasonal, business-critical, and ad hoc initiatives.

Clienteling Tools & Adoption

  • Drive continued adoption of existing clienteling tools and practices across Commercial and Retail teams.

  • Partner with Retail leadership to reinforce effective client outreach behaviors and identify opportunities to improve field execution.

  • Support ongoing enhancements to CRM and clienteling tools in partnership with Technology and other cross-functional teams.

  • Gather feedback from the field and translate business needs into actionable recommendations for existing and future Client Engagement capabilities.

  • Maintain established clienteling frameworks, including client segmentation, outreach strategies, and measurement of clienteling activities.

  • Partner with Learning & Transformation and Product Education teams on communications, training, and materials that reinforce clienteling best practices.

Database, Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee Client Engagement reporting and performance measurement, including data capture, client retention, outreach, engagement, and customer care KPIs.

  • Maintain regular reporting cadences and provide actionable insights to Commercial and Retail leadership on Client Engagement performance and trends.

  • Partner with Analytics teams to evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of clienteling initiatives, including events, experiences, gifting, VIC programming, and targeted outreach.

  • Oversee established client list programs and support ad hoc client list needs tied to business development and commercial opportunities.

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Technology, and business stakeholders to ensure client data capture and engagement practices align with applicable US and Canadian privacy requirements.

  • Monitor Client Engagement budgets and planned activities during the coverage period, escalating risks and opportunities as appropriate.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, prioritization, and support to the Client Engagement team.

  • Establish clear priorities and ownership across ongoing projects and deliverables, ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Foster a collaborative, client-centric team culture and support the continued development and engagement of team members.

  • Build strong working relationships with Commercial and Retail leadership and key cross-functional partners to maintain alignment on priorities and execution.

  • Represent the Client Engagement function in relevant leadership, planning, and cross-functional forums.

  • Facilitate communication and knowledge sharing across teams, ensuring key decisions, risks, dependencies, and next steps are clearly documented and actioned.

  • Partner with Learning & Transformation to support ongoing Client Engagement training and reinforcement across the sales organization.

  • Ensure effective transitions at the beginning and conclusion of the maternity leave coverage period, including documentation of key decisions, project status, priorities, risks, and outstanding actions.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6+ years of experience in CRM, Client Engagement, Clienteling, Loyalty, Direct Marketing, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression of responsibility.

  • 3+ years of leadership experience, including experience managing and developing a team.

  • Retail experience required; luxury retail experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience working within an omnichannel Retail CRM and Client Engagement environment.

  • Demonstrated experience managing CRM, loyalty, clienteling, or customer engagement programs.

  • Experience partnering with Technology teams to define business requirements and advance enhancements to CRM, clienteling, or customer-facing platforms.

  • Strong understanding of client segmentation, targeting, retention, and relationship-building strategies.

  • Passion for understanding consumer behavior and demonstrated ability to translate client insights and data into actionable commercial strategies.

  • Proven ability to quickly understand an established business, lead existing programs, and advance priorities within a complex cross-functional organization.

  • Strong project and program management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, corporate partners, and field teams.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to frame business problems analytically and translate insights into action.

  • Strong understanding of commercial and financial metrics, including measurement of program effectiveness and ROI.

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Tableau or similar data visualization/reporting tools.

  • SQL experience is a plus.

Education

Bachelor’s degree required; quantitative or analytical field of study a plus.

Travel

Some travel may be required.

Compensation: $85-$100 per hour /40 hours per week

Assignment

This is a temporary position providing maternity leave coverage for the Director of Client Engagement. The role is designed to ensure continuity of leadership and day-to-day operations while advancing defined Client Engagement priorities during the coverage period.

Success in the assignment will be measured by the effective leadership of the Client Engagement function, continuity of core programs and partnerships, progress against the defined priority initiatives, and a seamless transition of responsibilities at the conclusion of the coverage period.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at David Yurman

As a company founded by artists, David Yurman champions self-expression in everything we do. We are committed to fostering a culture of openness and creative collaboration within our entire community, and we cherish the diversity of our employees’ backgrounds and perspectives. We will always advocate for equity and inclusion for all.

David Yurman is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to an individual’s age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender).

The Dual Rate Security Supervisor role consists of the primary position of Security Officer/Officer II and the secondary position of Security Supervisor. In the primary position of Security Officer/Officer II, they are responsible for executing security duties on an assigned shift, adequately protecting the life and property of guests, team members and Seneca Gaming Corporation property while maintaining guest service that meets the expectations of the Seneca Gaming Corporation. In the secondary position of Security Supervisor, they are responsible for supervising those in the position of Security Ambassador and Security Officer/Officer II and ensuring that they are meeting all expectations in regards to guest service, compliance, safety, etc. and providing on-the-job work direction to assigned personnel. All duties are to be performed within the guidelines of the Seneca Gaming Corporation’s policies and procedures, Internal Control Standards and objectives.

1. Ensure the safety of guests and team members while on the premises of the Seneca Gaming Corporation.
2. Have a complete working knowledge of the Security Ambassador position. At times, a Security Officer may be assigned to work positions normally assigned to a Security Ambassador or to carry out duties normally assigned to a Security Ambassador.
3. Assist guests and team members and respond to critical situations (Medical emergencies, conflict resolution for guest disputes, etc.).
4. Must have outstanding verbal communication skills to resolve or diffuse difficult situations such as guest conflicts, disputes, complaints, etc.

10. description:
Please use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox when accessing Candidate Home.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

Joining the American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

The American Red Cross is currently seeking a Gift Planning Officer to support our Tennessee and Mississippi/Alabama Regions. This is a work-from-home opportunity and can be located anywhere within the regions.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW:

The Gift Planning Unit at the American Red Cross seeks to secure planned gifts supporting any component of the organization’s mission and to establish the Red Cross as the charity of choice for such gifts. Reporting to the Director of Gift Planning, the Gift Planning Officer develops, designs, and implements the gift planning program within the Tennessee and Mississippi /Alabama Regions of the American Red Cross focusing on new gift commitments for the organization. This role includes identifying, qualifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding gift-planning prospects and donors in the Region. The Gift Planning Officer will be responsible for developing strategies to increase funding capacity and maximize donor relationships. This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.

WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE GOOD:

  • Develops and manages the gift planning strategy for a portfolio of prospects throughout the Regions to support Red Cross programs and services.
  • Develop, lead, and implement strategies to substantially grow membership of the Legacy Society.
  • Maintains and enhances a stewardship program for all planned giving donors. Raises and enhances the profile of the Legacy Society.
  • Deliver training as appropriate on gift planning to advance knowledge and foster opportunities in gift conversations and strategy development.
  • Remain current in gift planning trends and fundraising techniques by attending meetings and conferences and participating in training programs.
  • Provides technical assistance to the Region’s development team to increase its fundraising capacity to solicit planned and current gifts.
  • Cooperates with various local financial planning and estate planning associations to plan meetings that maximize the Red Cross position as the charity of choice for bequests, trusts, retirement funds, life insurance policies, and life income arrangements.
  • Supports the reporting by the Regions of all estate documents to the Office of General Counsel.
  • Communicates with the Director of Gift Planning on a regular basis about donor and gift activity. Utilizes development prospect management system to facilitate regular reporting of donor and gift activity and to manage achievements of fundraising and personal goals.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience is required and an advanced degree is preferred.
  • A minimum of five years in major gift or gift planning fundraising with successful cultivating and soliciting experience is preferred. Experience promoting and managing such programs is highly desirable. Experienced candidates from the financial, estate, and/or philanthropic planning, law, and trust administration fields are encouraged to apply.
  • Knowledge of the technical aspects of planned giving vehicles as well as an extensive knowledge of fundraising principles and techniques in a large organization is desired.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, and strong interpersonal skills are required.
  • Strong organizational skills and good attention to detail are essential. Demonstrated tact and diplomacy in difficult or sensitive situations is essential.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office is necessary. Training in PG Calc or Crescendo planned giving software is desirable.
  • Familiarity with Red Cross corporate culture is preferred.
  • Operational flexibility to meet sudden and unpredictable business needs and a moderate amount (20%-30%) of business travel are required. Must have your own transportation.
  • A valid driver’s license is required.

WHAT WILL GIVE YOU THE COMPETITIVE EDGE:

Significant gift-planning experience in Tennessee, Mississippi, and Alabama is a plus.

A certification in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred: CFRE, CFP, CAP, J.D., LLM.

SALARY INFORMATION:

The salary range for this position is $95,000-$114,000

Note that the American Red Cross sets salary ranges aligned to a specific geographic location in which the work is performed. The stated salary range in this posting is an average. The specific salary information will be shared at the time of phone screening based upon your location and qualifications.

BENEFITS FOR YOU:

As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:

  • Medical, Dental Vision plans
  • Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts
  • PTO: Starting 15 days a year; based on type of job and tenure
  • Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays
  • 401K with up to 6% match
  • Paid Family Leave Employee Assistance
  • Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term
  • Service Awards and recognition

Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to

make your career a force for good!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Field Superintendent
description:
Job Description

At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.

As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.

Job Summary:
Provides leadership in the planning, coordination, and execution of field operations for complex construction projects, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety requirements, and quality standards. Guides field execution by applying advanced superintendent knowledge and judgment to resolve complex construction challenges without formal people management responsibilities. Coordinates across project teams, trade partners, and self-perform work to maintain workflow continuity and mitigate risks. Influences project outcomes by identifying constructability improvements, sequencing efficiencies, and prefabrication opportunities. Contributes to continuous improvement by sharing field insights and leading practices with project teams.

Key Responsibilities:
Leads day-to-day field execution for assigned scopes of work on complex projects, ensuring safety, quality, and schedule adherence.
Coordinates with project managers, superintendents, self-perform teams, and trade partners to resolve complex field issues and maintain construction momentum.
Guides field logistics, site utilization, and work sequencing to optimize productivity and minimize disruptions.
Oversees implementation of safety plans and quality control measures, addressing elevated risks and escalating critical concerns as needed.
Reviews and validates field documentation, including daily reports, look-ahead plans, and coordination logs, ensuring accuracy and alignment with project requirements.
Identifies and supports integration of prefabrication and alternative construction methods to improve efficiency, safety, and quality.
Provides informal mentorship and technical guidance to field team members and peers without assuming formal management/coaching responsibilities.

Education Qualifications:
Associate's degree in construction management, engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience required.

Work Experience:
7 years of experience in field operations, construction supervision, or a related field required.
Experience supporting complex projects with multiple trade partners preferred.

Certifications and Licenses:
OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety certification preferred.
OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety certification within 6 months of hire required.
First Aid and CPR certification required.
OSHA 510 or OSHA 500 certification preferred.

$125,000.00- $165,000.00

  • Set up and testing of egg sanitizer prior to each egg pull; properly performs egg inventory practices and records egg pull inventory. (10%)
  • Observes eggs moving on conveyors through sanitizers; observes shell color/texture and external characteristics such as streaks, shadings, discolorations, cracks. (25%)

(10%)

title: Studio Coordinator - Tustin
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a Studio Coordinator (SC), you live your power by supporting the world class CorePower Yoga studio experience including coordinating studio operations and holding the studio to the highest health and safety standards. In alignment with our Core Values, you work alongside the Studio Manager to deliver results and sustained growth towards all current company and studio-level goals. In the SC role, you will learn the business and develop the skillset to operate a studio.

Studio Presence and Guiding the Student Experience

  • Act as an ambassador of the CorePower Yoga Core Values at all times and consistently inspire these values in others

  • Support the Studio Manager in achieving company and studio level goals, including membership growth, retail sales, community outreach, teacher and SET recruitment, and programming enrollment

  • Commit to flexible schedule of 18-29 hours per week in studio in support of operations coordination and teaching (if certified), include health and safety protocol execution, front desk guidance, and team support

  • Must be flexible with schedule availability within the hourly commitment in service of the studio and team

  • Responsibly run the studio, including by acting as the point of contact for students and staff when Studio Manager is not present, up to 20 hours per week

  • Support maintaining an appropriate level of studio supply inventory so that all provisions and amenities are available for students at all times including cleanliness inventory, locker room amenities, towels, programming materials, etc.

  • Engage and know your studio community consistently; greet students by name, serve as an ambassador of yoga both inside and outside of the studio, and spend quality time at the front desk fostering community

  • Support our teachers learning experience of working the POS and other pre/post class duties

Coordinate and Execute Health, Safety and Cleanliness Protocol in the Studio​

  • Uphold high standards for the studio and when on duty, ensure that the physical studio space meets the high CPY standards of cleanliness and functionality including a safe environment, optimum heat and humidity, inspiring music, and clean and clutter-free surroundings in all areas of the studio

  • Support communication around Smart Health Protocol to students upon entry and throughout their visit at CPY ​

  • Act as an extension of the Studio Experience Team (SET) including cleaning the studio, stocking amenities, and ensuring the CPY cleanliness protocol is always followed while on duty in the studio

  • Support the SET team by interviewing SET applicants, hiring SET employees, scheduling SET employee's shifts, stepping in for no call/no shows, training, and disciplining/terminating SET employees who have violated CPY's policies and standards

  • Lead Orientation for new Studio Experience Team members and train them on cleanliness protocol and role expectations

Coordinate Studio Systems

  • Act as a liaison between the Studio Manager and the teaching and SET teams in training, communicating, and coordinating studio operational systems including but not limited to:

  • Point of Sales System (POS); understand and efficiently navigate POS to sign students in, sell packages and memberships, and explore and correct problems with student accounts when at the desk

  • Online Reservation System; support administrative follow up of late cancel fees, waitlist, student support, etc

  • Subbing Application; support training and usage for teaching team

  • HRIS Application; support training and usage for teaching and SET team

  • Help Desk; Submit facilities tickets when on duty ​and communicate follow up needs to Studio Manager

Teaching Schedule

  • Support the studio class schedule by teaching a minimum of 6 classes per week of branded CorePower Yoga classes and support the studio through subbing additional classes as needed

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must demonstrate CorePower Yoga Core Value

  • Excellent oral communication skills, professionalism and exceptional interpersonal skills are required

  • Experience in Customer Service required

  • Completion of a Yoga Alliance certified 200-hour program is preferred

  • Yoga Sculpt teacher training is preferred

  • Familiar and comfortable in studio systems such as the HRIS, intranet, point of sale systems, company scheduling and payroll systems, etc.

  • Ability to build relationships with individuals with diverse personalities and styles and at different levels of seniority

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize while working under multiple deadlines

  • Proven self-starter with ability to take on new projects with enthusiasm

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel

  • Excellent Time Management skills

  • Ability to take initiative and prioritize

  • College (BA/BS) preferred

THE FINE PRINT

  • Availability must match the needs of the business and leadership zig-zag schedules – morning, evening, weekend and some holiday availability and flexibility required

  • Must be able to move around the studio space, crouch, reach, and lift up to 25 lbs.

  • If certified to teach, must be able to step in to teach class with little to no notice while scheduled in the studio

COMPENSATION

  • $24.50 per hour

THE PERKS

  • Free All Access Membership - use anytime, in studio or online

  • Free All Access Membership for a Plus One - bring someone along!

  • Retail Discounts

  • Continued Education Offerings

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 1.5x Holiday Pay: Earn time-and-a-half pay for hours worked on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

WHO WE ARE

At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.

As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

title: Software Engineering Technical Leader
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/10/2026

***We are looking for candidate local to San Jose as this is a hybrid role***

Meet the Team

The Site Reliability Engineering – Security team makes Cisco CX Engineering's software systems secure, resilient, and fast to build on. We own the security posture of production infrastructure and of the internal platforms engineers depend on every day — Kubernetes control planes, GitOps and CI/CD pipelines, observability stacks, and AI/ML operations. We sit at the intersection of Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, so our work shapes how hundreds of engineers ship software. We are a small, senior, high-autonomy team that values deep technical ownership, blameless learning, and automating our way out of toil. Our largest and newest platform is Cisco IQ, the AI-powered front door to all of Cisco's Customer Experience services, so the systems you secure carry customer inventory, vulnerability detection, and support data at Cisco scale.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer on the Site Reliability Engineering – Security team, you set the technical direction for how Cisco CX Engineering builds and operates secure infrastructure and developer platforms. You will design systems that are secure by default, drive Zero Trust adoption across infrastructure and internal tooling, and embed security signals into SRE observability and incident response so threats surface as quickly as outages do. You will advise engineering leadership and negotiate the trade-offs between security, velocity, and reliability on decisions that affect the entire organization. Success looks like measurably reduced attack surface, faster vulnerability remediation, and platforms that engineers can use safely by default without slowing down. This is a role for someone who wants their architectural decisions to outlive any single project.

  • Design and build secure, scalable infrastructure and developer platforms so that security controls are embedded by default rather than bolted on later.

  • Harden the platforms themselves — Kubernetes control planes, GitOps systems, CI/CD pipelines, and observability stacks — treating internal tooling as the high-value target it is.

  • Drive Zero Trust at scale through workload identity, continuous verification, and micro-segmentation so access is earned rather than assumed.

  • Own the reliability and security posture of critical services including secrets management, PKI, and IAM governance to keep the foundations of the environment trustworthy.

  • Lead cross-team incident response and blameless post-mortems that convert both reliability and security failures into permanent fixes.

  • Automate security and compliance through policy-as-code and automated evidence collection to reduce toil and shorten remediation time.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree + 12 years of related experience, or Master's degree + 8 years of related experience, or PhD + 5 years of related experience.

  • 5+ years of hands-on production experience operating and scaling at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including direct ownership of cloud security posture: advanced IAM, KMS/secrets management, network controls, and CSPM or equivalent tooling.

  • 3+ years building production automation and tooling in Python and/or Go applied to security use cases such as vulnerability management, secrets orchestration, compliance evidence collection, or detection integration.

  • 5+ years applying SRE practices in production, including defining SLIs/SLOs, managing error budgets, serving as incident commander, and running post-mortems that drive follow-up engineering work.

  • 5+ years applying security fundamentals in production environments: threat modeling, secure-by-default architecture, least-privilege and workload identity, secrets and certificate lifecycle management, and vulnerability management at scale.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on production Kubernetes security experience: RBAC at scale, Network Policies, Pod Security Standards, admission controllers, image signing and verification, control-plane hardening, and service mesh mTLS.

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) with policy-as-code (OPA, Kyverno, Checkov, tfsec), GitOps delivery (ArgoCD or Flux), and CI/CD security gates including SAST, SCA, image and secret scanning, SBOM generation, and artifact signing.

  • Deep experience with security observability and runtime detection tooling (Falco, eBPF-based detection, SIEM, CSPM/CNAPP platforms) integrated with Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience securing AI/ML workloads and MLOps pipelines, including training and inference pipeline security and model security, and applying AI/LLM capabilities to security automation with human-in-the-loop guardrails.

  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or AWS Certified Security – Specialty, paired with strong communication and influence skills and a track record of driving security and architectural decisions across organizational levels.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
