title: IT Support Analyst
description:
The Vacancy

Megger is seeking an experienced IT Support Analyst to provide hands-on technical support to users across our North American operations. This position is based in Dallas, TX, and provides support for multiple Megger locations and remote users throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico. This position requires someone with strong technical fundamentals who can independently troubleshoot and resolve user issues while providing a professional and responsive support experience. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can take ownership of an issue, research unfamiliar problems, use available documentation and technical resources, and work through troubleshooting steps before
escalating. This is not intended to be an entry-level IT role. The successful candidate should have demonstrated knowledge of desktop support, Windows, networking, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and general IT troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for users across multiple locations throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

  • Provide remote and hands-on support to employees across Megger's North American operations.

  • Independently troubleshoot hardware, software, network, account, and access-related issues.

  • Support Windows desktops and laptops, printers, mobile devices, and other end-user technology.

  • Administer and troubleshoot Active Directory user accounts, groups, permissions, and password related issues.

  • Support Microsoft 365 applications, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and related services.

  • Troubleshoot basic network connectivity, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN, and LAN connectivity.

  • Assist users with remote access and VPN-related issues.

  • Perform PC deployments, replacements, configuration, onboarding, and offboarding.

  • Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions in the IT ticketing system.

  • Follow existing SOPs and technical documentation while contributing improvements when needed.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with users throughout the support process.

  • Take ownership of assigned tickets and follow issues through resolution.

  • Escalate issues appropriately after completing reasonable troubleshooting.

  • Work with infrastructure and other IT team members on projects and more complex technical issues.

  • Assist with IT projects, deployments, and infrastructure initiatives across North American locations as needed.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong Windows 10/11 troubleshooting experience.

  • Working knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy.

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Outlook, and Teams.

  • Understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals.

  • Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi-Fi, and VPN concepts.

  • Experience troubleshooting desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals.

  • Experience with remote support tools and ticketing systems.

  • Ability to use PowerShell or command-line tools for basic troubleshooting is preferred.

  • Understanding of endpoint security, patching, and device management is preferred.

What We're Looking For

  • Technical knowledge is important, but the ability to troubleshoot independently is equally important.

  • Take an unfamiliar problem and logically work through it.

  • Apply previous coaching and technical knowledge to new situations.

  • Research issues independently using documentation and available technical resources.

  • Understand the underlying technical concepts behind a problem rather than relying only on step-by step instructions.

  • Know when to continue troubleshooting and when an issue should be escalated.

  • Learn new systems quickly and retain information from training and coaching.

  • Communicate technical information clearly to non-technical users.

  • Remain professional and customer-focused during difficult support situations.

  • Effectively support users remotely across multiple locations and time zones.

  • Manage multiple priorities without requiring constant direction.

  • Accept feedback and apply it to future work.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on IT support, desktop support, help desk, or systems support experience.

  • Demonstrated experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support in a business environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting and critical-thinking skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of an infrastructure and support team.

  • Experience supporting users across multiple locations is preferred.

  • Experience supporting geographically distributed or multi-site organizations is preferred.

  • Associate degree, technical certification, or equivalent hands-on IT experience preferred.

Preferred Certifications

  • Certifications are not required but are a plus:

  • CompTIA A+

  • CompTIA Network+

  • Microsoft 365 or Azure certifications

  • ITIL Foundation

Success in This Role
Success will be measured by the employee's ability to independently resolve support issues, provide a positive user experience, take ownership of assigned work, apply training and coaching, maintain accurate documentation, and effectively support users across Megger's locations throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico while collaborating with the broader IT team.

title: Blood Component Manufacturing Technician
description:
Please use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox when accessing Candidate Home.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

WHY CHOOSE US?
Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

What You Need to Know:

In this role, you will be manufacturing blood products and samples. You will be processing blood products after the units have been received from the donors. This will involve scanning in the units of blood, processing the units into transfusable components (red cells, platelets, and expressing plasma) and leukoreducing.

As a Red Cross Team member, you will take care of your team members – show up for every shift and give 100% while you’re there. Interact in a positive, proactive, and customer-focused manner with both internal and external customers, demonstrating care and compassion at all times

WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE FOR GOOD:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Meet the quality and quantity production goals, while prioritizing workload expectations and maintaining accurate documentation

  • Perform good inventory management practices throughout the manufacturing and distribution process.

  • Perform data entry and operate the computer programs associated with component production, labeling, storage, and sample tube management.

  • Analyze and make decisions based on visual inspection and information provided from other departments to meet time.

  • Perform complex manufacturing tasks such as pooled product manufacturing, freeze, wash, or deglycerolizing of blood products, and pathogen reduction.

  • Communicate effectively with internal customers, vendors, and volunteers.

  • May require flexibility to work a variable schedule that includes weekends & holidays to meet the needs of our hospitals

Standard Schedule: Tuesday-Saturday, 8:00am-4:30pm

Pay Information: $18-$19.79, plus applicable shift differential for working late nights, overnights, and on the weekends.

Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • High School or equivalent required.

  • Minimum 2 years of related experience in a regulatory, laboratory, or manufacturing environment or equivalent combination of education and related experience preferred.

  • Good computer skills, ability to use a wide variety of programs and laboratory equipment, attention to detail, accurate documentation, and good decision-making skills.

  • Good communication skills, with the ability to work on a team, as well as independently with minimal supervision

Physical Requirements:

Requires standing, stretching, stooping and bending for extended time periods. Lift, pull, push and move objects of up to 50 pounds. May work in walk-in refrigerator/freezers for periods of time. May be required to wear protective clothing such as lab coats, gloves, face shields, etc.


BENEFITS FOR YOU:

As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:

  • Medical, Dental Vision plans

  • Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts

  • PTO: Starting at 15 days a year; based on type of job and tenure

  • Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays

  • 401K with up to 6% match

  • Paid Family Leave

  • Employee Assistance

  • Service Awards and recognition

Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to

make your career a force for good!

title: Senior Director R&D Digital Transformation
description:
Job Description:

Job Purpose/Overview
The Senior Director – R&D Transformation is responsible for leading the strategic design, harmonization, and end-to-end transformation of Pet Nutrition’s global Idea to Market (I2M) operating model, ensuring it is agile, efficient, and future-ready. This pivotal role drives business value by seamlessly integrating robust business processes, progressive organizational capabilities, and cutting-edge digital/AI technologies.
This role is inherently cross-functional, spanning all functions and disciplines involved in the end-to-end Innovation and Renovation processes (including R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, and Supply). Beyond digital enablement, the role is highly focused on modernizing R&D processes, instilling strong process governance, and building a continuous-learning culture that upskills our talent. To maximize strategic alignment, build capability, and share best practices, the role requires developing and maintaining a strong collaborative network across the broader Petcare segment as well as other Mars business segments.
Key Responsibilities
1. Transformation Strategy & Capability Vision
  • Define and lead the multi-year transformation roadmap for Pet Nutrition’s global Idea to Market operating model, aligning priorities and investments with overall Pet Nutrition business growth, R&D strategy, and efficiency goals.
  • Establish a clear vision for "future-ready R&D capabilities," mapping out the shifting skills, tools, and mindsets required by R&D associates globally to remain industry leaders.
  • Cultivate and leverage a strong network across Petcare and other business segments to benchmark capabilities, share organizational learnings, and maximize segment-wide alignment.
2. End-to-End Process Architecture & Governance
  • Redesign, standardize, and simplify end-to-end Idea to Market workflows across all functions involved in the Innovation and Renovation pipelines (R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, Supply, and other cross-functional partners) to drive speed-to-market.
  • Establish and embed a robust Process Ownership & Governance Framework, clarifying decision rights, cross-functional accountabilities, and performance metrics (KPIs) to sustain process health.
  • Drive process excellence by removing operational friction and reducing cycle times, while maintaining maximum product quality, regulatory compliance, and business resilience.
3. Future-Ready Capability Building & Upskilling
  • Design and implement comprehensive organizational capability programs to transition the R&D team from traditional methodologies to modern, agile, and data-driven ways of working.
  • Partner with People & Organization (HR) and R&D leadership to identify critical skills gaps in advanced technologies, agile workflows, and data literacy, establishing upskilling curricula to address them.
  • Build internal capabilities for continuous improvement and design thinking, ensuring R&D associates are active participants and co-creators of the transformation.
4. Process-Centric AI, Digital & Data Enablement
  • Treat technology as an accelerator of process and capability; embed AI, advanced analytics, automation, and digital tools directly into streamlined, user-centric R&D workflows.
  • Direct the Product Owner and Data Senior Lead in defining an integrated, value-driven digital and data roadmap.
  • Ensure digital systems and tools are intuitive, improve the employee experience, and enforce "data-by-design" to drive high-quality decision-making.
5. cPLM Sponsorship & Process Integration
  • Provide executive governance, strategic sponsorship, and escalation support for the Pet Nutrition Core PLM program.
  • Line-manage the Global Process Owner for PLM, ensuring PLM software and process designs align with global standards and serve as a strong foundational database for R&D.
  • Integrate PLM data, workflows, and digital modules seamlessly into the broader Idea to Market transformation roadmap.
6. Transformation Delivery & Organizational Governance
  • Direct and manage the core transformation team, including the Product Owner, PMO, Business Process Senior Leads, and Data Senior Lead.
  • Own the transformation budget, resource allocation plans, project governance, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Maintain clear reporting on progress, business cases, return on investment (ROI), and capability adoption metrics to the Global Technical Leadership Team (GTLT).
7. Change Leadership, Culture & Cross-Segment Collaboration
  • Lead the cultural, mindset, and behavioral shifts required to transition the organization to faster, collaborative, and fail-forward ways of working.
  • Build high-trust relationships and secure active commitment/sponsorship from regional business units, global functions, and peer segments.
  • Navigate highly matrixed structures to ensure active cross-functional and cross-segment collaboration, establishing formal and informal feedback loops across all teams contributing to Innovation and Renovation.
Context and Scope
This role operates at a global level within the Pet Nutrition R&D function, collaborating closely with sub-functional leaders, Operational Excellence (OE) leads, and the Global Technical Leadership Team (GTLT). Reporting to the Global Pet Nutrition R&D VP, the role is highly cross-functional, bridging R&D with Supply, Commercial, Quality, and Enterprise Digital teams.
A critical dimension of this role is its cross-functional breadth across all stages of both the Innovation and Renovation processes, ensuring that product modifications and new product launches follow harmonized, lean paths to market. To avoid silos, drive enterprise-wide synergies, and ensure maximum strategic alignment, the job holder must build, leverage, and sustain a robust network across the wider Petcare segment and other business segments (e.g., Snacking, Food).
Success is measured not only by digital tool deployments, but by the measurable speed-to-market of Innovation and Renovation pipelines, the successful adoption of new operating models, and the verified uplift of digital and process competencies across the global R&D associate base.
Relevant Quantitative and Budget Information
  • Financial: TBC (Responsibility for the global transformation budget and cPLM integration funding).
  • Staff: 6 direct reports (Product Owner, PMO, Business Process Senior Leads, Data Senior Lead, and PLM Global Process Owner) with a broader temporary organization and contractor network supporting cPLM through 2030.
Job Specifications/Qualifications
Education & Professional Background – Minimum
  • Degree in a scientific, engineering, or business/operations discipline (e.g., Chemistry, Food Science, Engineering, Business Architecture, or Data Science).
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in R&D, product innovation, operating model transformation, or process engineering.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional organizational transformations, specifically demonstrating a balance of process redesign and capability building alongside digital tool adoption.
  • Strong established professional network or proven ability to rapidly build influence across multiple business units, functions, and segments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills within highly matrixed, global organizations.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Deep experience in Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food & Beverage, or Pet Care sectors.
  • Extensive experience in Business Process Management (BPM), operating model design, or organizational change management (e.g., Prosci, Agile, Lean Six Sigma).
  • Experience leading cross-functional operating models that span R&D, Supply, Quality, Portfolio Management, and Commercial operations.
Key Functional Competencies & Technical Skills
  • Operating Model & Process Design: Expertise in structural design, business capability mapping, process mapping, and establishing cross-functional RACIs across the end-to-end Innovation & Renovation lifecycles.
  • Large-Scale Transformation & Change Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multi-million-dollar program roadmaps, budgets, and change/communication plans.
  • Organizational Capability & Upskilling Frameworks: Skill in designing training, upskilling, and competence certification programs to raise workforce performance.
  • Digital & Data Enablement: Understanding of how PLM, AI, and advanced analytics serve as enablers for modern, streamlined R&D processes.
  • Preferred: Certification in Lean Six Sigma, Agile methodology (e.g., Scrum/SAFe), or Prosci Change Management.

title: Family Team Meeting & Permanency Round Table Facilitator- Senior Social Caseworker
description:
About Our Job

Note: This position is open to current City and County of Denver employees ONLY.

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver.

What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers a competitive salary commensurate with education and experience. The target pay range for this position is $66,000 - $71,000. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

  • A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
  • 457B Retirement Plan
  • 132 hours of PTO earned within first year + 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year
  • Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location

The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model. Employees work where needed, at a job site several days a week and off-site as needed. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their off-site days.

What You’ll Do

At Denver Human Services (DHS), we envision a healthy community where people are connected, supported, safe, and well. One in three people in Denver turn to DHS for support at all stages of life. Our employees help children, at-risk adults, families, and individuals navigate social and economic pressures by connecting them to services and experts who support their overall well-being.

About Protection & Prevention

Denver Human Services works to protect Denver's children, youth, adults, and at-risk adults by providing services and advocacy while promoting family stability, respecting diversity, and working to create and strengthen connections to community resources. We work to prevent abuse by providing education, resources, and support to parents, families, and community organizations.

Denver Human Services is seeking a passionate and well-rounded individual to serve as a Family Team Meeting & Permanency Round Table Facilitator within Child Welfare Services on the Family Engagement Services team. In this role, you will be responsible for facilitating up to three, 2-hour family meetings per day as well as regularly facilitating both Family Team Meeting (FTM) and Permanency Round Table (PRT) meetings. You will also be charged with scheduling those meetings, arranging the meeting spaces, conducting the meetings and producing written reports outlining the details of the meeting and the team decisions that come of them.

The Family Team Meeting (FTM) Team at DHS manages and facilitates the family engagement meeting process, including facilitating meetings that include internal staff, community members, family/clients, attorneys and other professional providers. The FTM Facilitator guides the meeting team in making decisions regarding the following: removal of the child from the home, change of placement, 90-day case reviews, permanency, reunification, and case closure.

The PRT (Permanency Round Table) Team manages and facilitates permanency focused, family meeting for cases that include children in out of home placement for over 12 months and/or those cases that have not yet achieved a permanency plan for the child or youth. The Permanency Round Table Facilitator ensures that the meeting team is avidly working toward permanent connections and/or permanent placement for the child.

Additionally, the FTM/PRT Facilitator:

  • Prepares for FTM and PRT meetings, including identifying and coordinating logistical and safety matters, and reviewing case summary if available
  • Conducts and facilitates FTM and PRT meetings, including setting ground rules and expected outcomes, leading brainstorming, and moving the group towards consensus
  • Manages and resolves high conflicts during FTM and PRT meetings and determines when additional intervention steps are required in the event consensus cannot be reached during FTM and PRT meetings
  • Will complete prep work and planning for the various stages of the PRT process
  • Works closely with supervisor and team members to ensure business needs are met.
  • Serves as professional support and resources for case workers during and after FTM and PRT meetings
  • Facilitates and participates in making decisions regarding removal, placement and reunification of children with the intent of preventing out-of-home removal or finding the least restrictive option
  • Utilizes extensive network of county community-based services, organizations and resources to effectively facilitate meetings and make immediate decisions on appropriate course of actions
  • Completes FTM and PRT meeting activity reports documenting situation, safety and risk concerns, and placement planning
  • Compiles and provides data and statistics for management to track success rates of FTM and PRT processes
  • Ensures work conforms to appropriate policies, regulations, procedures, standards and laws of State and Federal agencies
  • Effectively conducts both, in‑person and virtual facilitation
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

  • At least 3 years of child welfare case work experience
  • Facilitation experience
  • Ability to engage families and professionals, as well as manage high conflict and difficult behaviors
  • Demonstrate flexibility and adapt quickly to changing needs, using strong problem‑solving skills to resolve issues as they arise
  • In-depth knowledge of agency policy, Volume VII, and agency and community resources
  • Expertise in assisting the meeting team reach consensus and making quality decisions

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Requirements as set forth in Colorado Department of Human Services Volume 7 and/or Volume 30 regulations
  • Experience: Two (2) years of post-graduation professional social case work experience at the type and level of Social Case Worker and demonstrated mastery of essential duties described
  • Education & Experience Equivalency: No substitution of experience for education is permitted. Additional appropriate education may be substituted for experience requirements
  • Licensure & Certification: Requires a valid Driver’s License at the time of application. Licenses and certifications must be kept current as a condition of employment. Requires certification as a Social Case Worker in Child Welfare or Adult Protective Services in accordance with CDHS regulations

Additional Document
Please attach your official or unofficial transcripts of your completed undergraduate and/or graduate degree and list of professional references to your application in the required attachment section.

Application Deadline

This position is expected to stay open until September 16th, 2026. Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than September 16th at midnight to ensure consideration.

title: Civil Project Designer | Leesburg, VA
description:
Scope

The Civil Project Designer 1 will lead design efforts as a project manager or lead engineer for low to moderate complexity projects and collaborate with senior staff for the delivery of larger and high complexity projects. They will be responsible for working closely with a team of engineers and consultants to provide engineering solutions and advice to clients to ensure positive outcomes. Primary responsibilities will include engineering analysis, design field inspections, writing reports, preparing permit applications, site drainage & grading designs, and learning the Civil Engineering trade. This position will be expected to work within the project’s monetary budget, train, mentor, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet project goals and client expectations.

Principal Responsibilities

• Direct and train Civil Design Technicians to assist them in completing reports, exhibits, plans and specifications and permit applications as required by the project’s contractual scope
• Lead design efforts for the analysis of civil site design projects for commercial, residential, industrial projects etc.; Utilize engineering software and tools to create detailed designs, specifications, and calculations according to code requirements and IMEG standards
• Complete and oversee permit applications for a variety of municipalities in coordination with the team, Client, and reviewing jurisdiction
• Oversee projects through bidding and construction administration phase
• Interact with clients to understand their needs, gather project requirements, and communicate technical information effectively; Build and maintain client relationships through professional communication
• Work as part of a project team to support the execution of consulting projects; Lead efforts in project planning, budgeting, and scheduling tasks to meet project deadlines and objectives; Document design decisions and instructions from clients while monitoring project design progress as related to percent complete and fee expended
• Analyze engineering problems and propose innovative solutions; Collaborate with senior engineers and consultants to develop practical and efficient solutions
• Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in civil engineering; Contribute to research, development, and innovation efforts within IMEG
• Prioritize safety and regulatory compliance in all aspects of engineering work; Interpret state and local design criteria and apply it to the specific project needs
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including other engineers, architects, and project managers, to deliver integrated solutions that meet project goals
• Identify potential project problems and seek advice from the Project Manager

Required Skills/Abilities

• Knowledge of industry standard engineering software, primarily Civil 3D
• Proficient with pipe networking and road corridors.
• Proficiency in design techniques, tools, and concepts involved in the production of technical plans and specifications
• Strong technical and analytical skills including proficiency of principles in the civil engineering field
• Ability to train and mentor less experienced staff
• Able to lead teams with others that utilize industry standard software that assists with civil engineering analysis and design
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; Ability to clearly communicate in both oral and written communication to individuals or groups
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Eagerness to adapt to new challenges
• Proficient with MS Office Suite including but not limited to Word, Excel, and Outlook

• Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Civil Engineering, or equivalent required
• Engineer-In-Training (EIT) certification preferred
• 3 years of experience minimum required, 4 preferred, in the building design consulting industry

OR

• Associates degree, or certificate, in utilizing Autodesk Civil 3D or equivalent software tools or engineering preferred
• 7 years of experience minimum required, 8 preferred, in the building design consulting or construction industry

title: Public Safety Officer
description:
Current Saint Francis Colleagues - Please click HERE to login and apply.

JOB SUMMARY

Public Safety Officers patrol the entire medical center campus to promote a climate of safety for all persons and property. They must effectively interact with the general public, administration, all departments and colleagues, as well as local, state and federal law enforcement, civil defense, fire department and ambulance personnel.

Safety Officers respond to various requests for assistance to include reports of suspicious or criminal activity. They provide support to staff in handling disgruntled visitors as well as respond to other disturbances.

The Safety Officer also responds to combative patient calls as part of the STARR team. They work under OSHA Blood and Body Fluids Category 1 and use Protective Personal Equipment (PPE) to reduce exposure risks. They control external access and release of deceased patients from Pathology.

Safety Officers also investigate reports of motor vehicle accidents, property damage, and theft documenting events in detailed reports. They are proficient in the use video surveillance systems to monitor campus activity. They use various databases to access information needed to complete reports and/or investigations. They monitor fire safety and submit reports to ensure deficiencies are identified and corrected.

They conduct Fire and Child Abduction drills and submit staff evaluation reports. They perform preventive maintenance inspections on campus fire extinguishers and are familiar with required responses and operation of fire, child abduction, and panic alarms systems. They investigate safety mishaps such as falls or other incidents involving injuries and prepare reports of such events. They maintain commissions as Notary Publics and provide notary services to patients, physicians, and colleagues.

Safety Officers manage the inventory of Lost and Found Property and Patient Valuables. They perform courtesy services such as auto assists, escorts, and vehicle lockouts. They conduct hospital policy enforcement to include colleague parking and wear of identification badges.

JOB DETAILS AND REQUIREMENTS

Type: Full-time, 80 hours per 2 week pay period

Typical hours: 3:00p-11:00p, Rotating weekends/holidays

Education:

-High School Diploma or GED- required

Certification & Licensures:

-Must obtain a City of Cape Girardeau Security license within 90 days of hire or transfer into this position.

-Must gain BLS certification, provided by the medical center.

-BLS Certification- required within 90 days of hire

Experience:

One year in public safety sector preferred.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Why Work at Saint Francis?

Saint Francis Healthcare System began in 1875 when three courageous Franciscan Sisters answered a call to care for those in need. What started as a 12‑bed hospital has grown into the region’s leading healthcare system—recognized nationally for exceptional quality, safety, and patient experience.

Today, Saint Francis serves more than 715,000 people across five states. description:

Meet the Team

The Partner Solutions Engineering Team is a strategic technical team focused on enabling and scaling partner capabilities within the Americas ecosystem!

Your Impact

The Partner Solutions Engineering Leader will lead a team of Partner Solutions Engineers (PSEs) who act as the primary technical liaison between Splunk/Cisco and our partner ecosystem (System Integrators, Resellers, MSP, Service Providers, and Consultants). The mission is to mature our partners' technical practices, driving their progression through the Cisco Partner 360 program and ensuring they are fully equipped to deliver Splunk and Cisco solutions that drive revenue and customer outcomes.

To build and lead a high-performing Partner Solutions Engineering function that transforms our partners into independent, technically proficient authorities. Act as a force multiplier, turning ad-hoc partner support into a repeatable operating system of enablement, reference architectures, and joint-solution development that accelerates pipeline conversion and reduces technical risk in the field. Be the technical champion for Cisco’s Data Fabric strategy, using Data Intelligence and AI to help partners build differentiated, high-value practices.

  • Partner Program Advancement: Act as a technical catalyst to help partners move up the Cisco Partner 360 tiers. Lead initiatives to ensure partner sales, SE, SA, SP, and MSP staff achieve required Splunk Certifications and badges, directly influencing the partner’s Partner Value Index (PVI) score.
  • Strategic Technical Focus: Drive the adoption of Cisco’s Data Fabric strategy, using Data Intelligence and AI to help partners build differentiated practices.
  • Partner Practice Maturity: Assess partner technical capabilities and gaps; design multi-quarter enablement roadmaps to build partner capacity and technical maturity around Splunk/Cisco portfolios.
  • Strategic Enablement: Lead the design and delivery of technical training, workshops, and labs to accelerate partner readiness. Develop technical playbooks, reference architectures, and demo assets tailored to partner-led GTM priorities (Security, Observability, Cloud, Network, and AI).
  • Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partner engineering and product teams to co-develop joint solutions. Ensure these solutions align with platform strategies, security frameworks, and industry-specific compliance requirements.
  • Technical Advocacy & Liaison: Serve as the main technical point of contact for strategic partners, helping them navigate product roadmaps, resolve complex integration challenges, and advocate for partner-specific requirements back to internal Product and Engineering teams.
  • Sales & RFP Support: Partner with the channel sales team to provide technical input for RFPs and support high-stakes partner-led demonstrations or Proof of Concepts (POCs).
  • Operational Governance: Document partner engagements, track key performance metrics (e.g., partner technical maturity, PVI impact, solution deployments, and pipeline influence), and standardize enablement methodologies to ensure scalable support.
  • Leadership & Culture: Hire, coach, and develop a team of PSEs. Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer-first empathy, and partner-centric growth.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree + 8+ years demonstrated ability; OR Master’s degree + 5 years.
  • Technical Depth: 5+ years of broad/deep technical knowledge in Security, Observability, Event, or Network Management.
  • Leadership: 3+ years of people management experience leading technical pre-sales or partner-facing engineering teams.
  • Strategic Attitude: Consistent track record of building high-performing teams and developing talent across different career stages.
  • Business Acumen: Strong operational acumen, including experience with partner capacity planning, enablement roadmaps, and measuring business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco Ecosystem Fluency: Understanding of the Cisco Partner technical enablement to partner program requirements.
  • Strategic Vision: Experience articulating the value of Cisco Data Fabric, AI-driven observability, and Data Intelligence to partner leadership.
  • Certification Leadership: Demonstrable experience in driving technical certification programs and badge attainment within a channel or partner organization.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Experience leading Partner Solutions Engineering teams within the software or technology industry.
  • Technical Expertise: Solid understanding of data platforms, SIEM, observability, security operations, or related technologies; Splunk/Cisco ecosystem experience is a strong plus.
  • Consultative Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts for both C-Level executives and technical practitioners.
  • Operational Rigor: Experience leading organizational change and driving adoption of new strategies, processes, and technologies.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Description:

Har du lyst til at blive en del af en ambitiøs og energisk organisation med store internationale vækstambitioner for fremtiden?

Sikring af optimal og kontinuerlig drift

Du kommer til at indgå i anlæggets driftsteam og vagtordning samtidig med, at du har fokus på at sørge for, at anlægget hele tiden fungerer optimalt.

I tæt sammenspil med driftslederen, driftslederassistenten og de øvrige driftsassistenter sikrer du en stabil drift, hvor dine opgaver bl.a. vil være:

  • Vedligehold og optimering af biogasanlægget

  • Udskiftning af mekaniske og elektriske dele

  • Reparationer af procesudstyr

  • Mindre reparationer og ændringer på anlægget

  • Styring, regulering og overvågning af anlægget

  • Mekanisk og elektrisk fejlfinding

  • Laboratoriearbejde herunder prøveudtagning og analyse af biomasser

Din arbejdsplads bliver på vores anlæg På Trige, hvor du vil have din daglige gang. Det er et krav, at du ikke bor mere end 30 min. fra anlægget, da du indgår i vagtordning, hvor der er behov for at kunne træde til med kort varsel.

Anlægget ligger på Bjergagervej 4, 8380 Trige, hvor du vil referere direkte til driftsleder, Mikkel Rosengreen Jansen.

Driftsassistent med gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet som enten procestekniker, automatiktekniker, smed, landbrugsmekaniker, elektriker eller indenfor et andet håndværk. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med produktions- eller procesanlæg og erfaring med SCADA-systemer, samt har flair for it. Du kan alternativt også have en baggrund i fødevareindustrien, hvor du har været involveret i drift og overvågning af processen, hvor du kommer med praktisk erfaring og gerne vil have hænderne i mekanikken.

Vi leder efter en person med den rette indstilling og som har gå-på-mod. Det er vigtigt for os, at du værdsætter samarbejde og det gode kollegiale sammenhold.


Dertil skal det nævnes at sikkerhedskulturen på anlægget er under stor udvikling, hvilket betyder at du skal kunne se dig selv i en rolle hvor der stilles store krav til sikkerheden i det daglige.

Bliv en del af Shell Low Carbon Solutions Biogas (tidligere Nature Energy)

Som medarbejder i Shell Biogas bliver du en del af et yderst erfarent og ambitiøst team inden for den cirkulære økonomi. Vores fælles mål er at opbygge en bæredygtig fremtid for vores planet og samfund. Med hovedkontor i Odense, Danmark, er Shell Biogas europæisk markedsleder i at udvikle, designe, bygge og drifte store, industrielle biogasanlæg, som baner vejen for en bæredygtig fremtid ved at omdanne affald til værdi. title: Software Engineer Senior
description:
Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

Senior Software Engineer is responsible for delivering quality, well-tested software into Production. The ideal candidate will have printer and printer driver experiences, experiences in developing or testing Web, Windows, Android, iOS applications. This Engineer will be responsible for developing test tools and test code for Software product interfaces, SDK API and UI automation, creating & executing automated or manual test cases and analyzing test results. This engineer will provide guidance to junior level engineers to help analyze the problems and provide effective troubleshooting methods and solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Capable to use different programming languages, e.g. Java, Python to design and develop test tools and automation test code
  • Develop and maintain software test tools to support test execution, data analysis and problem solving.
  • Develop and maintain test code of automated integration test, interface test and UI automation test.
  • Participate in code reviews and identify bad sections early in the process and then recode them
  • Provide recommendations and solutions to problems using experience in multiple technical areas.
  • May influence and Coach junior level engineers at various stages of the design, development and test process.
  • Design test plans according to the project requirement and schedule
  • Develop test cases and create test procedures to address complex test issues.
  • Perform complex testing and quantitative technical analysis and perform complex root cause analysis
  • Maintain accurate and reliable records of tested projects (including test plans, data, analysis, engineering communications, and final summary reports).
  • Receive little instruction on day-to-day work and general instructions on new assignments.
  • Contribute ideas that will help improve our documentation, processes, and overall performance and reliability of our products.

Requirements:

  • Familiar with software developing and testing methodologies and processes on different OS, including Windows, iOS, Android, MacOS, Linux etc.
  • Familiar with printer products or printer related software products is preferred
  • Rich experiences in Software Test Tool development or SDK API test development and UI Automation Test development.
  • Master at least one or two programming languages, C#, Java is preferred
  • Experiences in Mobile Application Development with Android SDK, or developing automation test code with Selenium, Appium is preferred
  • Good planning and organization skills.
  • Has network background knowledge. Familiar with switch, wireless router and server configuration. Able to fix network related issue.
  • At least bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field.
  • 6-8 years or above experience in software testing, at least 3-5 years in test tool development or automation test code development.
  • Fluent oral and written English, should be able to communicate in English effectively

Benefits:

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. description:
Role Summary

Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) is a sophisticated SIEM built atop Splunk’s data platform with lots of moving parts. We help thousands of customers as they identify and protect their assets from cyber threats, all over the world. On any given day, our software needs to handle thousands of users, petabytes of data, and unique usage patterns across different deployment topologies.


Meet the Team

Are you ready to shape the future of AI-powered quality? We are seeking a software engineer to build test infrastructure for our AI-agentic Security Operations Center (SOC)! Together, we define the strategic direction that secures the absolute reliability and performance of our most complex systems. We work to mentor world-class engineering talent, drive the adoption of groundbreaking benchmarking, and catalyze the evolution of our quality ecosystems. Join us as we work to transform high-level challenges into scalable, high-impact solutions.

Your Impact

This role is designed for an engineer who translates quality challenges into technical solutions, driving engineering efficiency through evaluation strategies and implementation. In this role, you will collaborate with team members and implement benchmarking protocols that support our technical performance goals. Responsibilities include:

  • Technical Contribution: Contribute to the development of PQ foundations and evaluation frameworks, ensuring assessment capabilities for AI agents, workflows, and system processes.
  • Technical Collaboration & Support: Support the team by collaborating with members, participating in code and design reviews, and assisting in the validation of technical hypotheses.
  • Experimental Execution: Implement the lifecycle of proof-of-concepts (POCs), adhering to standards for experimentation and the validation of testing paradigms.
  • Quality Ecosystem Maintenance: Ensure that testing processes deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes, maintaining alignment with team quality goals.
  • Validation Execution: Implement validation techniques, including LLM-as-judge methodologies, tenant isolation probes, and behavioral regression suites.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams to implement contract testing, audit log validation, and security compliance, ensuring integration of quality across the development lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree plus 4+ years of experience in software development and test automation, including experience building large-scale testing ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience in programming, specifically Python and Go, with a proven ability to design scalable, maintainable, and high-performance testing infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience with security compliance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated experience with modern performance testing methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI to build automation (writing AI skills to build test automation).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Problem-Solving: Capacity to translate quality challenges into structured and actionable technical implementations.
  • Technical Vision: Ability to innovate within the AI/ML landscape, applying modern tooling to drive detection efficacy and system reliability.
  • Test Automation: Go, Python, Contract testing frameworks, Playwright.
  • Performance Testing: K6, Terra Virtual Machine (Security Suite), and JMeter.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

Joining the American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (Job Overview):

As a Community Disaster Program Manager, you will ensure effective collaboration with Volunteer Services; identify, mobilize, and engage partners in all communities in assigned geographic area; and determine current readiness resources, facilities, supplies, local vendors, and strategies for addressing gaps. You will work with volunteers to ensure that the communities you serve are ready to respond to disasters.

Join us in meeting the needs of continuous disaster response! Regional disaster employees are required to deploy to disaster relief operations outside of their region at a minimum of once a year. Deployments contribute to skill building, career development and exposure to different types of disasters. Allowances may be provided for personal circumstances and local response activity. Employees must meet all training and physical capacity requirements for deployment.

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.

WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE FOR GOOD (Key Responsibilities):

  • Empower Volunteers: Lead and support a diverse volunteer team responsible for the implementation of volunteer-led disaster cycle services programming throughout the assigned geographic area, or functional activities throughout the region. Functional activities include mass care, response, community preparedness, recovery, planning, and readiness.

  • Lead the Program: Implement either disaster cycle services activities within assigned geographic area or specific functional activities within the region

  • Mission Capacity Building: Develop and support disaster volunteers who are the primary workforce, and representative of the communities they serve, both culturally and linguistically Cultivate and develop Disaster Leadership Volunteers, including volunteer partners, to meet specific responsibilities as part of their work in disaster readiness, preparedness, response, and recovery.

  • Engage Community: Lead and coordinate efforts in assigned geographic area to prepare and mobilize communities and engage partners with specific functional expertise and assets to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters and emergencies.

  • Manage in a Matrix: Build relationships and collaborate in the matrix management environment with internal partners, including employees and volunteers.

  • Know Your Communities: Act as the Red Cross disaster subject matter expert within the assigned geographic area, to maximize Red Cross presence and community engagement and mobilization. Prospect and partner with organizations and leaders supporting frontline communities and community resiliency before, during and after disasters.

  • Ready to Respond: Initiate and coordinate disaster relief operations in the assigned geographic area, or functional activities in the region in alignment with the Disaster Cycle Services Concept of Operations.

  • Diverse Community: Identify, build trust in, and increase access to disaster services in diverse, historically underserved communities. Build relationships and partnerships with trusted and diverse organizations within assigned priority communities to extend the reach and trust of the Red Cross.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required, or equivalent combination of education and related experience required.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of related experience with building, mobilizing, leading and developing volunteer teams to execute a social services program or service.

  • A current valid driver's license and good driving record is required.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrated analytical and decision-making skills to interpret program trends, results, formulate recommendations, and develop creative processes for continuous program or service improvements.

  • Proven record of accomplishment of collaboration with diverse groups and individual’s representative of all the demographics of this community, managing multiple priorities, facilitation, problem solving, marketing, leadership, and partnership management.

  • Intermediate level proficiency with Microsoft Office software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Ability to work outside of regular duty hours including nights and weekends.

RESIDENCY REQUIREMENTS

  • Chapter-based positions: Geographic Community Disaster employees are expected to work daily in their assigned geographic area to engage and mobilize communities and support volunteers.

  • Regional positions: Regional leadership and functional employees are expected to work daily within their region's geographic area to provide leadership and functional support, engage and mobilize communities, and support volunteers.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel; and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 15 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. The work environment will consist of moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phones and printers, light traffic). The employee must have the ability to work in a small cubicle and have the ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time.

WHAT WILL GIVE YOU THE COMPETITIVE EDGE (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is highly preferred

  • Experience in recruiting volunteers is a plus

description:
GENERAL SUMMARY

Support the Emergency Preparedness (EP) function by preparing and conducting Emergency Response Organization (ERO) program administration, training, and evaluation including drills/exercises, maintaining a cordial interface with internal and external organizations, developing and conducting training and evaluating ERO members as assigned, and maintaining EP related documents and facilities in a current state of readiness.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

Conduct emergency drills and exercises in accordance with Energy Northwest, Oregon and Washington states, and participating county and federal requirements including controller/evaluator duties in area of responsibility. Ensure individual and organizational improvement areas are identified through a thorough critique process. Implement actions as required to improve performance.

Interact and coordinate with off-site agencies to facilitate their support of the Energy Northwest ERO function and the off-site agency’s emergency preparedness mission related to Columbia Generating Station (CGS).

Interface with federal agencies and senior plant personnel to maintain effective working relationships on matters related to the EP Program.

Perform administrative functions which may include addressing and managing corrective action process assignments and maintaining EP-related documents and facilities in a current state of readiness.

Develop and conduct initial and advanced emergency preparedness training for assigned areas of responsibility, including the development of training materials consistent with a Systematic Approach to Training (SAT).

Conduct emergency drills and exercises as a controller/evaluator for assigned emergency center(s). Ensure individual and organizational improvement areas are identified using a thorough critique process. Implement actions as required to improve performance.

Perform assigned EP functions (e.g., emergency center readiness evaluations, on-call emergency planner duties, self-assessments, and benchmarking activities).

Incumbents may be assigned specific areas of focus that will result in varying time allocations.

REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Emergency Planner II

Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a Business Administration, Physical Science, Emergency Management, or Engineering related field from an accredited college or university and eight years of experience in one or more of the following areas: nuclear plant operations, operations training, engineering, health physics, nuclear security leadership or emergency preparedness;

OR an Associate’s degree in a training, emergency management, or technical field from an accredited college or university and ten years of experience in one or more of the following areas: nuclear plant operations, operations training, engineering, health physics, nuclear security leadership or emergency preparedness;

OR a high school diploma or GED and twelve years of experience in one or more of the following areas: nuclear plant operations, operations training, engineering, health physics, nuclear security or emergency preparedness.

Current or prior RO/SRO license may count for two years of experience

Emergency Planner I

Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a Business Administration, Physical Science, Emergency Management, or Engineering related field from an accredited college or university and five years of experience in one or more of the following areas: nuclear plant operations, operations training, engineering, health physics, nuclear security emergency preparedness other appropriate fields;

OR an Associate’s degree in a training, emergency management, or technical field from an accredited college or university and six years of experience in one or more of the following areas: nuclear plant operations, operations training, engineering, health physics, nuclear security emergency preparedness or other appropriate fields;

OR a high school diploma or GED and eight years of experience in one or more of the following areas: nuclear plant operations, operations training, engineering, health physics, nuclear security emergency preparedness or other appropriate fields

PAY RANGE

Emergency Planner II Salary Range: $126,362 - $189,542

Midpoint: $157,952

Emergency Planner I Salary Range: $109,870 - $164,806

Midpoint: $137,338


The salary listed represents the pay range for this position. Starting pay is calculated from the minimum of the salary range and actual individual placement within the range is determined based on the candidate's experience, education, skills, and abilities related to the role. The level and final offer will also take into account the candidate's overall qualifications.


Offers will be negotiated based on each candidate's qualifications.


INCENTIVE COMPENSATION


This role may be eligible to participate in our annual incentive plan. Incentives are earned based on employee performance against defined metrics and company goals.


BENEFITS


Energy Northwest (EN) provides a phenomenal benefits package. Washington State also has no state income tax, and the Tri-Cities provides a cost-of-living lower than the national average.

EN offers substantial retirement benefits through three retirement programs including the Washington State Public Employees' Retirement System pension plan (PERS), a 401(k) savings plan with an employer match component, and a 457(b) savings plan. EN also offers multiple options for medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance coverage. Other voluntary benefits may include flexible spending accounts (FSAs), tuition reimbursement, student loan repayment, childcare subsides, health reimbursement arrangement (HRA VEBA), health savings account (HSA), supplemental life insurances, credit monitoring/identity theft insurance, and more! Qualifying employees will typically start a personal time accrual rate of 160 hours per year and EN provides nine paid holidays throughout the Calander year; personal time accruals grow significantly at various service intervals.

title: Leader, Solutions Engineer (AI & Agentic Systems)
description:
Meet The Team

Cisco is no longer just the networking company the world knows. We are building the critical infrastructure and trusted operating model for the agentic AI era — from silicon (Silicon One) through to unified platforms (Cisco Cloud Control), security (AI Defense + DefenseClaw), and observability (Splunk-powered agent monitoring).

We are looking for a high-energy Presales / Solution Architect Manager to lead and grow our solutions engineering teams across Greater China and Japan. This is a rare opportunity to shape how the most ambitious enterprises in these markets move from AI pilots to production-scale agentic systems — securely, observably, and without hyperscaler lock-in.

Your Impact

You will lead a multi-country team of Solutions Engineers and Architects who sit at the centre of Cisco’s AI transformation in Northeast Asia. Your mission is to turn Cisco’s full AI stack into winning architectures and sustained revenue growth:

  • Own the technical sales strategy for AI and agentic workloads across the region. Align Cisco architectures (Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA, Cloud Control + AgenticOps, Silicon One-powered fabrics, Isovalent/Cilium, Splunk AI observability, AI Defense / DefenseClaw) with the real business problems of banks, manufacturers, telcos, governments and hyperscale-adjacent customers.

  • Lead high-stakes customer engagements. Spend meaningful time with CXOs, CTOs and AI leaders on multi-year transformation journeys. Help them design flexible, future-proof agentic systems that avoid lock-in, incorporate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns, and deliver measurable outcomes in performance, security and governance.

  • Build and coach a high-performing regional team. Direct managers and senior Solutions Engineers across Greater China, Korea and Japan. Raise the technical bar, develop the next generation of AI solution leaders, and create a culture that is both deeply technical and commercially sharp.

  • Drive demand and market expansion. Design and execute technical events, workshops, and proof-of-concept programmes that showcase what’s actually possible with Cisco’s agentic platform, NVIDIA collaboration, and open, hybrid approaches. Turn emerging technology conversations into concrete pipeline and multi-year deals.

  • Operate as the connective tissue. Work closely with Engineering, Customer Experience, partners, marketing and the broader APJC AI practice so that customer feedback shapes product direction and that our teams stay ahead of the curve on agentic security, observability and infrastructure.

Sales cycles are often long and complex — exactly the kind of work where deep technical credibility and sustained relationship-building win.

What success looks like

  • Clear growth in AI-related revenue and market share across Greater China, Korea and Japan

  • Higher win rates on strategic and competitive deals through superior architecture and proof points

  • A stronger, more capable and more cohesive solutions organisation that customers trust as true advisors

  • Visible contribution to Cisco’s position as the trusted infrastructure and operating platform for agentic AI in the region

Qualifications:

You combine strong technical depth in AI infrastructure, networking, security and observability with the ability to lead and inspire teams across cultures and geographies. You are comfortable in the boardroom and in the architecture workshop. You understand both the promise and the real risks of agentic systems, and you know how to turn that understanding into trusted customer outcomes.

Minimum qualifications

Bachelor’s degree + 12 years relevant experience, Master’s + 8 years, or PhD + 5 years, plus at least 2 years of people leadership experience.

This role is for someone who wants to help define what “AI-ready enterprise infrastructure” actually means in one of the world’s most dynamic markets — and to do it with the company that already powers some of the most demanding AI workloads on the planet.

If that sounds like the next chapter you want to write, let’s talk.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: AI/ML Engineer - Controllable Biology
description:
Business Introduction
At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
Find out more:
Our approach to R&D

Job Title: AI/ML Engineer - Controllable Biology

At GSK, we see a world in which advanced applications of machine learning and AI will allow us to develop novel therapies for existing diseases and quickly respond to emerging or changing diseases with personalized drugs, driving better outcomes at reduced cost and with fewer side effects. It is an ambitious vision that will require the development of products and solutions at the cutting edge of machine learning and AI. If that excites you, we'd love to chat.

Job Purpose:

The AI/ML Controllable Biology Team applies machine learning and AI methods to biological networks and sequence data from large-scale human genetic, functional genomic, and single-cell experiments. Models that control biological networks have the potential to be transformative in drug discovery, empowering us to find new life-saving medicines.

We're looking for a highly accomplished AI/ML Engineer to help us make this vision a reality. Competitive candidates will have breadth of knowledge across machine learning methods, as well as depth in at least one area. You should be able to execute and deliver full AI/ML-driven solutions, from sourcing training data to designing and implementing SOTA machine learning models, testing, and benchmarking.

The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a related field (e.g. computer science, mathematics or natural sciences).

  • Knowledge of machine learning, software engineering and agentic development best practices.

  • Proficiency with standard deep learning algorithms and model architectures.

  • Experience with Python and PyTorch, or equivalent languages and machine learning frameworks.

  • Experience working with biological sequence and network data, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, gene regulatory networks or related biological datasets.

Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Advanced degree (master's or PhD) in a quantitative or computational field.

  • Knowledge of systems biology, disease biology, molecular biology and biochemistry.

  • Peer-reviewed publications in major AI conferences.

  • Track record of contributing to open-source projects.

#GSK-LI

Work Arrangements:

The role is hybrid, requiring on-site work 2 days per week. Remote or fully home-working arrangements are not available for this role.

How to apply
Please submit your CV and a short cover letter that explains how your experience maps to the role and what you hope to learn. We welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds and career stages. If you need an adjustment during the application process, tell us and we will work with you. We look forward to hearing from you.


Skills

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Director, Software Engineering (Security Business Group)
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/14/2026

Meet the Team


Cisco’s Cloud Security organization is at the forefront of securing the modern workforce, protecting users, data, and applications wherever they reside. As the cornerstone of Cisco’s Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) strategy, we deliver cloud-native protection for users, data, and application no matter where they reside.



Cisco’s Cloud Security team is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead an engineering team working on our market-leading Security Service Edge (SSE) products. In this role, you will drive the strategy, execution, and delivery of multiple management/control plane services of Cisco secure Access including policy and access control, cloud control plane and service reliability, behavior analytics and security data platform, AI enabled assistant and intelligent automation, and similar services.



You will lead multiple engineering teams building scalable, high-performance systems that protect millions of users around the world as they access the internet and cloud applications. This is a pivotal leadership role that requires strong technical depth, cloud platform expertise, and the ability to implement at scale in a fast-paced environment.


Your Impact


As the Director of Software Engineering, you will:

  • Lead and Inspire: Manage and mentor a high-performing engineering teams responsible for full development cycle of multiple management/ control plane services.

  • Strategic Direction: Set technical direction and vision for cloud security services, collaborating with Product Management, UX, and Security stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure solutions.

  • Execution Excellence: Drive end-to-end software development, from design through deployment, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Team Development: Attract, hire, and retain top engineering talent; foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and diversity.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with architecture, operations, and customer success teams to ensure seamless integration, high reliability, and outstanding user experience.

  • Continuous Improvement: Champion process and technology improvements, leveraging metrics and customer feedback to optimize products and engineering practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading managers and global teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.

  • Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), distributed systems, micro service architecture, multi-tenant services or similar data platforms, AI/ML systems, and observability, record delivering enterprise cloud software or SaaS platforms with demanding availability, scale, security, and data-consistency requirements.

  • Experience with modern software development practices, including CI/CD and DevOps, with experience building agentic systems and employing AI to improve productivity across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Preferred Qualifications

Job Title

Product Finance & Analytics Business Partner

Position Overview

Shaw Industries Group, Inc. is a leader in flooring and other surface solutions designed for residential housing, commercial spaces and outdoor environments. Leveraging strengths in design, innovation and operational excellence, the company takes a people-centered, customer-focused, and growth-minded approach to meet diverse market needs.
